```{r prep-codingpts-cancers, message = FALSE, eval = FALSE, include = FALSE}
#                                                              levels = unique(solecancer_just_coding_pts_propor_softtissues_ggplot$Cancer))

#add column saying all, mult, or sole pts with number of samples so that can make barcharts of all coding (all, mult, sole) and all noncoding (all, mult, sole) for all cancers and within breast, brain, and soft tissues
origdbdefcancer_just_coding_pts_propor_ggplot$Patient_Type <- paste0("All (",
                                                                     format(n_distinct(origdbdefcancer_just_coding_pts$Tumor_ID),
                                                                            big.mark = ",",
                                                                            trim = TRUE),
                                                                     " samples)")

origdbdefcancer_just_coding_pts_propor_breast_ggplot$Patient_Type <- paste0("All (",
                                                                            format(as.numeric(origdbdefcancer_just_coding_pts_propor_breast_ggplot_prep[nrow(origdbdefcancer_just_coding_pts_propor_breast_ggplot_prep), "num_distinct_samples"]),
                                                                                   big.mark = ",",
                                                                                   trim = TRUE),
                                                                            " samples)")

origdbdefcancer_just_coding_pts_propor_brain_ggplot$Patient_Type <- paste0("All (",
                                                                           format(as.numeric(origdbdefcancer_just_coding_pts_propor_brain_ggplot_prep[nrow(origdbdefcancer_just_coding_pts_propor_brain_ggplot_prep), "num_distinct_samples"]),
                                                                                  big.mark = ",",
                                                                                  trim = TRUE),
                                                                           " samples)")

origdbdefcancer_just_coding_pts_propor_softtissues_ggplot$Patient_Type <- paste0("All (",
                                                                                 format(as.numeric(origdbdefcancer_just_coding_pts_propor_softtissues_ggplot_prep[nrow(origdbdefcancer_just_coding_pts_propor_softtissues_ggplot_prep), "num_distinct_samples"]),
                                                                                        big.mark = ",",
                                                                                        trim = TRUE),
                                                                                 " samples)")

multcancer_just_coding_pts_propor_ggplot$Patient_Type <- paste0("Multiple Cancers (",
                                                                format(n_distinct(origdbmultcancer_just_coding_pts$Tumor_ID),
                                                                       big.mark = ",",
                                                                       trim = TRUE),
                                                                " samples)")

multcancer_just_coding_pts_propor_breast_ggplot$Patient_Type <- paste0("Multiple Cancers (",
                                                                       format(as.numeric(multcancer_just_coding_pts_propor_breast_ggplot_prep[nrow(multcancer_just_coding_pts_propor_breast_ggplot_prep), "num_distinct_samples"]),
                                                                              big.mark = ",",
                                                                              trim = TRUE),
                                                                       " samples)")

multcancer_just_coding_pts_propor_brain_ggplot$Patient_Type <- paste0("Multiple Cancers (",
                                                                      format(as.numeric(multcancer_just_coding_pts_propor_brain_ggplot_prep[nrow(multcancer_just_coding_pts_propor_brain_ggplot_prep), "num_distinct_samples"]),
                                                                             big.mark = ",",
                                                                             trim = TRUE),
                                                                      " samples)")

multcancer_just_coding_pts_propor_softtissues_ggplot$Patient_Type <- paste0("Multiple Cancers (",
                                                                            format(as.numeric(multcancer_just_coding_pts_propor_softtissues_ggplot_prep[nrow(multcancer_just_coding_pts_propor_softtissues_ggplot_prep), "num_distinct_samples"]),
                                                                                   big.mark = ",",
                                                                                   trim = TRUE),
                                                                            " samples)")

solecancer_just_coding_pts_propor_ggplot$Patient_Type <- paste0("One Cancer (",
                                                                format(n_distinct(origdbsolecancer_just_coding_pts$Tumor_ID),
                                                                       big.mark = ",",
                                                                       trim = TRUE),
                                                                " samples)")

solecancer_just_coding_pts_propor_breast_ggplot$Patient_Type <- paste0("One Cancer (",
                                                                       format(as.numeric(solecancer_just_coding_pts_propor_breast_ggplot_prep[nrow(solecancer_just_coding_pts_propor_breast_ggplot_prep), "num_distinct_samples"]),
                                                                              big.mark = ",",
                                                                              trim = TRUE),
                                                                       " samples)")

solecancer_just_coding_pts_propor_brain_ggplot$Patient_Type <- paste0("One Cancer (",
                                                                      format(as.numeric(solecancer_just_coding_pts_propor_brain_ggplot_prep[nrow(solecancer_just_coding_pts_propor_brain_ggplot_prep), "num_distinct_samples"]),
                                                                             big.mark = ",",
                                                                             trim = TRUE),
                                                                      " samples)")

solecancer_just_coding_pts_propor_softtissues_ggplot$Patient_Type <- paste0("One Cancer (",
                                                                            format(as.numeric(solecancer_just_coding_pts_propor_softtissues_ggplot_prep[nrow(solecancer_just_coding_pts_propor_softtissues_ggplot_prep), "num_distinct_samples"]),
                                                                                   big.mark = ",",
                                                                                   trim = TRUE),
                                                                            " samples)")

# now combine all same type of tissues into 1 df each so that barchart has each Individual type in 1 df
just_coding_pts_propor_ggplot <- do.call(rbind, 
                                         list(origdbdefcancer_just_coding_pts_propor_ggplot,
                                              multcancer_just_coding_pts_propor_ggplot,
                                              solecancer_just_coding_pts_propor_ggplot))

just_coding_pts_propor_breast_ggplot <- do.call(rbind, 
                                                list(origdbdefcancer_just_coding_pts_propor_breast_ggplot,
                                                     multcancer_just_coding_pts_propor_breast_ggplot,
                                                     solecancer_just_coding_pts_propor_breast_ggplot))

just_coding_pts_propor_brain_ggplot <- do.call(rbind, 
                                               list(origdbdefcancer_just_coding_pts_propor_brain_ggplot,
                                                    multcancer_just_coding_pts_propor_brain_ggplot,
                                                    solecancer_just_coding_pts_propor_brain_ggplot))

just_coding_pts_propor_softtissues_ggplot <- do.call(rbind, 
                                                     list(origdbdefcancer_just_coding_pts_propor_softtissues_ggplot,
                                                          multcancer_just_coding_pts_propor_softtissues_ggplot,
                                                          solecancer_just_coding_pts_propor_softtissues_ggplot))


# combine coding and noncoding ggplot dfs with extra column indicating coding or noncoding, so that can combine on same barchart and facet grid based on coding or noncoding
just_coding_pts_propor_ggplot$mut_type <- "coding"
just_coding_pts_propor_breast_ggplot$mut_type <- "coding"
just_coding_pts_propor_brain_ggplot$mut_type <- "coding"
just_coding_pts_propor_softtissues_ggplot$mut_type <- "coding"

coding_and_noncoding_pts_propor_ggplot <- do.call(rbind,
                                                  list(just_noncoding_pts_propor_ggplot,
                                                       just_coding_pts_propor_ggplot)) %>% 
  arrange(-Proportion)

coding_and_noncoding_pts_propor_breast_ggplot <- do.call(rbind,
                                                         list(just_noncoding_pts_propor_breast_ggplot,
                                                              just_coding_pts_propor_breast_ggplot)) %>% 
  arrange(-Proportion)

coding_and_noncoding_pts_propor_brain_ggplot <- do.call(rbind,
                                                        list(just_noncoding_pts_propor_brain_ggplot,
                                                             just_coding_pts_propor_brain_ggplot)) %>% 
  arrange(-Proportion)

coding_and_noncoding_pts_propor_softtissues_ggplot <- do.call(rbind,
                                                              list(just_noncoding_pts_propor_softtissues_ggplot,
                                                                   just_coding_pts_propor_softtissues_ggplot)) %>% 
  arrange(-Proportion)

# redo factoring based on how cancers are in merged dfs
coding_and_noncoding_pts_propor_ggplot$Cancer <- factor(coding_and_noncoding_pts_propor_ggplot$Cancer,
                                                        levels = unique(coding_and_noncoding_pts_propor_ggplot$Cancer))

coding_and_noncoding_pts_propor_breast_ggplot$Cancer <- factor(coding_and_noncoding_pts_propor_breast_ggplot$Cancer,
                                                               levels = unique(coding_and_noncoding_pts_propor_breast_ggplot$Cancer))

coding_and_noncoding_pts_propor_brain_ggplot$Cancer <- factor(coding_and_noncoding_pts_propor_brain_ggplot$Cancer,
                                                              levels = unique(coding_and_noncoding_pts_propor_brain_ggplot$Cancer))

coding_and_noncoding_pts_propor_softtissues_ggplot$Cancer <- factor(coding_and_noncoding_pts_propor_softtissues_ggplot$Cancer,
                                                                    levels = unique(coding_and_noncoding_pts_propor_softtissues_ggplot$Cancer))
```

# **Cancer Spectra of Individuals with One Cancer 0-19 yo** {#cancerspectrasole0-19yo .hidden .unlisted .unnumbered}

$~$

```{r prep-soleteens-cancers, message = FALSE, eval = FALSE, include = FALSE}
# subset dataset to just teen sole cancers
origdbsolecancer_teens <- origdbsolecancer %>% 
  subset(Individual_code %in% (solepts_ages_sex %>% 
                                 subset(Age_stratum %in% c("0-9",
                                                           "10-19")) %>% 
                                 pull(Individual_code))) %>% 
  distinct()

# count num distinct patients in teen sole cancers and make as pivot tables, along with indiv breakdowns of otherwise unspecified brain and soft tissues
solecancer_teens0to9_pivot <- origdbsolecancer_teens %>% 
  group_by(Short_topo,
           Sex,
           Age_stratum) %>% 
  summarize(num_distinct_pts = n_distinct(Individual_code)) %>% 
  arrange(-num_distinct_pts) %>% 
  subset(Age_stratum == "0-9") %>% 
  pivot_wider(id_cols = Short_topo,
              names_from = Sex,
              values_from = num_distinct_pts) %>% 
  replace_na(list(M = 0,
                  `F` = 0)) %>% 
  adorn_totals(where = "row")

solecancer_teens0to9_pivot_brain <- origdbsolecancer_teens %>% 
  group_by(Short_topo,
           Sex,
           Age_stratum,
           Morphology) %>% 
  summarize(num_distinct_pts = n_distinct(Individual_code)) %>% 
  arrange(-num_distinct_pts) %>% 
  subset(Age_stratum == "0-9" & Short_topo == "BRAIN") %>% 
  pivot_wider(id_cols = Morphology,
              names_from = Sex,
              values_from = num_distinct_pts) %>% 
  replace_na(list(M = 0,
                  `F` = 0)) %>% 
  adorn_totals(where = "row")

solecancer_teens0to9_pivot_softtissues <- origdbsolecancer_teens %>% 
  group_by(Short_topo,
           Sex,
           Age_stratum,
           Morphology) %>% 
  summarize(num_distinct_pts = n_distinct(Individual_code)) %>% 
  arrange(-num_distinct_pts) %>% 
  subset(Age_stratum == "0-9" & Short_topo == "SOFT TISSUES") %>% 
  pivot_wider(id_cols = Morphology,
              names_from = Sex,
              values_from = num_distinct_pts) %>% 
  replace_na(list(M = 0,
                  `F` = 0)) %>% 
  adorn_totals(where = "row")

solecancer_teens10to19_pivot <- origdbsolecancer_teens %>% 
  group_by(Short_topo,
           Sex,
           Age_stratum) %>% 
  summarize(num_distinct_pts = n_distinct(Individual_code)) %>% 
  arrange(-num_distinct_pts) %>% 
  subset(Age_stratum == "10-19") %>% 
  pivot_wider(id_cols = Short_topo,
              names_from = Sex,
              values_from = num_distinct_pts) %>% 
  replace_na(list(M = 0,
                  `F` = 0)) %>% 
  adorn_totals(where = "row")

solecancer_teens10to19_pivot_brain <- origdbsolecancer_teens %>% 
  group_by(Short_topo,
           Sex,
           Age_stratum,
           Morphology) %>% 
  summarize(num_distinct_pts = n_distinct(Individual_code)) %>% 
  arrange(-num_distinct_pts) %>% 
  subset(Age_stratum == "10-19" & Short_topo == "BRAIN") %>% 
  pivot_wider(id_cols = Morphology,
              names_from = Sex,
              values_from = num_distinct_pts) %>% 
  replace_na(list(M = 0,
                  `F` = 0)) %>% 
  adorn_totals(where = "row")

solecancer_teens10to19_pivot_softtissues <- origdbsolecancer_teens %>% 
  group_by(Short_topo,
           Sex,
           Age_stratum,
           Morphology) %>% 
  summarize(num_distinct_pts = n_distinct(Individual_code)) %>% 
  arrange(-num_distinct_pts) %>% 
  subset(Age_stratum == "10-19" & Short_topo == "SOFT TISSUES") %>% 
  pivot_wider(id_cols = Morphology,
              names_from = Sex,
              values_from = num_distinct_pts) %>% 
  replace_na(list(M = 0,
                  `F` = 0)) %>% 
  adorn_totals(where = "row")

# calculate vertical proportions dividing down males and females and for any cancers with <= 2% proportion in males and females (or in individual tissues, only 1 Individual has it), put OTHER instead
solecancer_teens0to9_pivot_prep <- solecancer_teens0to9_pivot %>% 
  transform(Male = M/as.numeric(solecancer_teens0to9_pivot[nrow(solecancer_teens0to9_pivot), "M"])) %>% 
  transform(Female = `F`/as.numeric(solecancer_teens0to9_pivot[nrow(solecancer_teens0to9_pivot), "F"])) %>%
  transform(Cancer = ifelse(Male <= 0.02 & Female <= 0.02,
                            "OTHER",
                            Short_topo)) %>% 
  subset(Short_topo != "Total") 

solecancer_teens10to19_pivot_prep <- solecancer_teens10to19_pivot %>% 
  transform(Male = M/as.numeric(solecancer_teens10to19_pivot[nrow(solecancer_teens10to19_pivot), "M"])) %>% 
  transform(Female = `F`/as.numeric(solecancer_teens10to19_pivot[nrow(solecancer_teens10to19_pivot), "F"])) %>%
  transform(Cancer = ifelse(Male <= 0.02 & Female <= 0.02,
                            "OTHER",
                            Short_topo)) %>% 
  subset(Short_topo != "Total")

solecancer_teens0to9_pivot_brain_prep <- solecancer_teens0to9_pivot_brain %>% 
  transform(Male = M/as.numeric(solecancer_teens0to9_pivot_brain[nrow(solecancer_teens0to9_pivot_brain), "M"])) %>% 
  transform(Female = `F`/as.numeric(solecancer_teens0to9_pivot_brain[nrow(solecancer_teens0to9_pivot_brain), "F"])) %>%
  transform(Cancer = ifelse(M < 2 & `F` < 2,
                            "OTHER",
                            Morphology)) %>% 
  subset(Morphology != "Total")

solecancer_teens10to19_pivot_brain_prep <- solecancer_teens10to19_pivot_brain %>% 
  transform(Male = M/as.numeric(solecancer_teens10to19_pivot_brain[nrow(solecancer_teens10to19_pivot_brain), "M"])) %>% 
  transform(Female = `F`/as.numeric(solecancer_teens10to19_pivot_brain[nrow(solecancer_teens10to19_pivot_brain), "F"])) %>%
  transform(Cancer = ifelse(M < 2 & `F` < 2,
                            "OTHER",
                            Morphology)) %>% 
  subset(Morphology != "Total")

solecancer_teens0to9_pivot_softtissues_prep <- solecancer_teens0to9_pivot_softtissues %>% 
  transform(Male = M/as.numeric(solecancer_teens0to9_pivot_softtissues[nrow(solecancer_teens0to9_pivot_softtissues), "M"])) %>% 
  transform(Female = `F`/as.numeric(solecancer_teens0to9_pivot_softtissues[nrow(solecancer_teens0to9_pivot_softtissues), "F"])) %>%
  transform(Cancer = ifelse(M < 2 & `F` < 2,
                            "OTHER",

  subset(Morphology != "Total")

solecancer_teens10to19_pivot_softtissues_prep <- solecancer_teens10to19_pivot_softtissues %>% 
  transform(Male = M/as.numeric(solecancer_teens10to19_pivot_softtissues[nrow(solecancer_teens10to19_pivot_softtissues), "M"])) %>% 
  transform(Female = `F`/as.numeric(solecancer_teens10to19_pivot_softtissues[nrow(solecancer_teens10to19_pivot_softtissues), "F"])) %>%
  transform(Cancer = ifelse(M < 2 & `F` < 2,
                            "OTHER",
                            Morphology)) %>% 
  subset(Morphology != "Total")

# melt dfs for stacked barchart 
solecancer_teens0to9_pivot_melt <- solecancer_teens0to9_pivot_prep %>% 
  dplyr::select(-c(Short_topo,
                   M,
                   `F`)) %>% 
  reshape2::melt() %>% 
  dplyr::rename(Sex = variable,
                Proportion = value)

just_soleteens_pivot_propor_ggplot <- do.call(rbind,

                                                                                     arrange(-Proportion) %>%
                                                                                     pull(Cancer) %>%
                                                                                     unique()) != "OTHER"],
                                                                     "OTHER"))
```

# **Analyses of All Individuals with Adrenal Cortical Carcinoma** {#allACCpts}

$~$

$~$

```{r allACCpts, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
# subset dataset of all sole and first mult to just ACC
origdb_allACC_mult_pts <- origdbjustmultcancersover100 %>% 
  subset(Short_topo == "Adrenal cortical carcinoma") %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  remove_rownames()

origdb_allACC_sole_pts <- origdbjustsolecancersover100 %>% 
  subset(Short_topo == "Adrenal cortical carcinoma") %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  remove_rownames()

# create pivot of number of female and male pts with ACC in each age stratum of diagnosis, replace any NA with 0, add total number of pts in each age stratum to new column pasted with ages, and make anything with 1 individual singular indication of patients
ACC_mult_agestrata_sex <- PivotTable$new()
ACC_mult_agestrata_sex$addData(origdb_allACC_mult_pts)
ACC_mult_agestrata_sex$addRowDataGroups("Age_stratum")
ACC_mult_agestrata_sex$addColumnDataGroups("Sex") 
ACC_mult_agestrata_sex$defineCalculation(calculationName = "Count of distinct patients", 
                                         summariseExpression = "n_distinct(Individual_code)")
ACC_mult_agestrata_sex$sortColumnDataGroups(levelNumber = 1, 
                                            orderBy = "calculation", 
                                            sortOrder = "desc")
ACC_mult_agestrata_sex$sortRowDataGroups(levelNumber = 1, 
                                         orderBy = "calculation", 
                                         sortOrder = "desc")
ACC_mult_agestrata_sex$evaluatePivot() #doing this instead of renderPivot() which takes too long as it shows an actual pivot table, but we need this as a dataframe anyways for calculations later so we don't need to print a pivot table
ACC_mult_agestrata_sex_pivot <- ACC_mult_agestrata_sex$asDataFrame(rowGroupsAsColumns = TRUE) %>% 
  mutate(across(everything(),
                ~ replace_na(.,
                             0))) %>%
  transform(Age = paste0(Age_stratum,
                         " (", 
                         Total,
                         " individuals)")) %>% 
  transform(Age = ifelse(Total == 1,
                         gsub("individuals", 
                              "individual",
                              Age),
                         Age)) %>% 
  remove_rownames()

ACC_sole_agestrata_sex <- PivotTable$new()
ACC_sole_agestrata_sex$addData(origdb_allACC_sole_pts)
ACC_sole_agestrata_sex$addRowDataGroups("Age_stratum")
ACC_sole_agestrata_sex$addColumnDataGroups("Sex") 
ACC_sole_agestrata_sex$defineCalculation(calculationName = "Count of distinct patients", 
                                         summariseExpression = "n_distinct(Individual_code)")
ACC_sole_agestrata_sex$sortColumnDataGroups(levelNumber = 1, 
                                            orderBy = "calculation", 
                                            sortOrder = "desc")

                                                                                                                                       colnames(ACC_sole_agestrata_pos_pivot_damage)[5]])) %>%
  dplyr::select(c(Mutation,
                  tail(names(.),
                       4))) %>%
  subset(Mutation %in% unique(as.vector(solecancerpivotpos_melted_over0.01$Mutation))) 

colnames(ACC_sole_agestrata_pos_pivot_calc) <- colnames(ACC_sole_agestrata_pos_pivot_damage)[1:5]

# melt pos pivot tables and add number of individuals to sex or age strata listed, already do >= 1% proportion 
ACC_mult_sex_pos_pivot_melted <- reshape2::melt(ACC_mult_sex_pos_pivot_calc) %>%
  dplyr::rename(Sex = variable,
                Proportion = value) %>%
  arrange(-Proportion) %>%
  transform(Sex = ifelse(Sex == "F",
                         paste0("Female (",
                                as.numeric(ACC_mult_sex_pos_pivot_damage[nrow(ACC_mult_sex_pos_pivot_damage), "Female"]),
                                " individuals)"),
                         as.character(Sex))) %>%
  transform(Sex = ifelse(Sex == "M",
                         paste0("Male (",
                                as.numeric(ACC_mult_sex_pos_pivot_damage[nrow(ACC_mult_sex_pos_pivot_damage), "Male"]),
                                " individuals)"),
                         Sex)) %>%
  transform(Sex = ifelse(grepl("\\(1 ", 
                               Sex),
                         gsub("individuals", 
                              "individual",
                              Sex),
                         Sex)) %>%
  subset(Mutation %in% (reshape2::melt(ACC_mult_sex_pos_pivot_calc) %>%
                          dplyr::rename(Sex = variable,
                                        Proportion = value) %>%
                          arrange(-Proportion) %>%
                          subset(Proportion >= 0.01) %>%
                          pull(Mutation) %>%
                          unique() %>%
                          as.vector())) %>%
  remove_rownames()
```

```{r distribution-cutoff-ACC-sole-agestrata-pos, fig.height = 5.5, fig.width = 7.5, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
# vectors for pie chart of how most muts are chosen anyways for heatmap
prop <- n_distinct(ACC_sole_agestrata_pos_pivot_melted$Mutation) / n_distinct(ACC_sole_agestrata_pos_pivot$Mutation[ACC_sole_agestrata_pos_pivot$Mutation != "Total"])
vec <- c(prop,
         1 - prop)
raw <- c(n_distinct(ACC_sole_agestrata_pos_pivot_melted$Mutation),
         n_distinct(setdiff(unique(ACC_sole_agestrata_pos_pivot$Mutation[ACC_sole_agestrata_pos_pivot$Mutation != "Total"]),
                            unique(ACC_sole_agestrata_pos_pivot_melted$Mutation))))

# make prevalence waterfall plots (base R barplots + abline at 1%) of all muts in ACC to justify why 1% chosen for cutting off
barplot(height = sort(as.numeric(ACC_sole_agestrata_pos_pivot %>% 
                                   dplyr::select(-c(Num_Individuals)) %>% # divide down
                                   mutate(across(where(is.numeric), 
                                                 ~ .x/last(.x))) %>% 
                                   subset(Mutation != "Total") %>% 
                                   reshape2::melt() %>% 
                                   pull(value) %>% replace_na(., 0)),
                      decreasing = TRUE),
        xaxs = "i", # remove space between left side of bars and y axis
        ylab = "Proportion of distinct individuals with cancer", 
        xlab = "p53 mutation",
        main = "Prevalence of p53 Mutations in Distinct Individuals with Cancer",
        ylim = c(0, plyr::round_any(max(ACC_sole_agestrata_pos_pivot %>% 
                                          dplyr::select(-c(Num_Individuals)) %>% # divide down
                                          mutate(across(where(is.numeric), 
                                                        ~ .x/last(.x))) %>% 
                                          subset(Mutation != "Total") %>% 
                                          reshape2::melt() %>% 
                                          pull(value),
                                        na.rm = TRUE),
                                    0.1,
                                    f = ceiling)),
        col = ifelse(ACC_sole_agestrata_pos_pivot$Mutation[ACC_sole_agestrata_pos_pivot$Mutation != "Total"] %in% ACC_sole_agestrata_pos_pivot_melted$Mutation,
                     "black",
                     "grey"),
        font.lab = 2,
        las = 1,
        space = 0,
        border = NA)
abline(h = 0.01,
       col = "red",
       lty = 2,
       lwd = 2)
legend("right",
       legend = c("Subset", 
                  "Other"),
       col = c("black", 
               "gray"),
       bty = "n", # no border around legend
       pch = 15, # filled square shape
       pt.cex = 1.75) # increase shape size in legend

# pie chart
pie(vec,
    main = "Prevalence of p53 Mutations in Distinct Individuals with Cancer",
    labels = paste0(plyr::round_any(vec * 100,
                                    0.1),
                    "% (",
                    format(raw, 
                           big.mark = ",", 
                           trim = TRUE),
                    " mutations)"),
    col = c("black", "grey"),
    border = NA,
    clockwise = TRUE)
```

# **Analyses of All Individuals with Brain Cancers** {#allbrainpts}

```{r allbrainpts, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
# subset dataset of all sole and first mult to just brain
origdb_allbrain_mult_pts <- origdbjustmultcancersover100 %>% 
  subset(Short_topo == "BRAIN") %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  remove_rownames()

origdb_allbrain_sole_pts <- origdbjustsolecancersover100 %>% 
  subset(Short_topo == "BRAIN") %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  remove_rownames()

# create pivot of number of female and male pts with brain in each age stratum of diagnosis, replace any NA with 0, add total number of pts in each age stratum to new column pasted with ages, and make anything with 1 individual singular indication of patients
brain_mult_agestrata_sex <- PivotTable$new()
brain_mult_agestrata_sex$addData(origdb_allbrain_mult_pts)

brain_mult_agestrata_sex$addColumnDataGroups("Sex")

                                           summariseExpression = "n_distinct(Individual_code)")
brain_mult_agestrata_sex$sortColumnDataGroups(levelNumber = 1,

                                              sortOrder = "desc")
brain_mult_agestrata_sex$sortRowDataGroups(levelNumber = 1,

                                           sortOrder = "desc")
brain_mult_agestrata_sex$evaluatePivot() #doing this instead of renderPivot() which takes too long as it shows an actual pivot table, but we need this as a dataframe anyways for calculations later so we don't need to print a pivot table
brain_mult_agestrata_sex_pivot <- brain_mult_agestrata_sex$asDataFrame(rowGroupsAsColumns = TRUE) %>% 
  mutate(across(everything(),
                ~ replace_na(.,
                             0))) %>%
  transform(Age = paste0(Age_stratum,

                         Total,
                         " individuals)")) %>% 
  transform(Age = ifelse(Total == 1,
                         gsub("individuals", 
                              "individual",

                         Age)) %>% 
  remove_rownames()

                Proportion = value)

brain_mult_sex_pos$addColumnDataGroups("Sex")

  transform(`F` = as.numeric(Female)/as.numeric(brain_mult_sex_pos_pivot_damage[nrow(brain_mult_sex_pos_pivot_damage), "Female"])) %>%
  transform(`M` = as.numeric(Male)/as.numeric(brain_mult_sex_pos_pivot_damage[nrow(brain_mult_sex_pos_pivot_damage), "Male"])) %>%
  dplyr::select(c(Mutation,
                  `F`,
                  `M`)) %>%
  subset(Mutation %in% unique(as.vector(multcancerpivotpos_melted_over0.01$Mutation)))

  transform(`F` = as.numeric(Female)/as.numeric(brain_sole_sex_pos_pivot_damage[nrow(brain_sole_sex_pos_pivot_damage), "Female"])) %>%
  transform(`M` = as.numeric(Male)/as.numeric(brain_sole_sex_pos_pivot_damage[nrow(brain_sole_sex_pos_pivot_damage), "Male"])) %>%

# melt pos pivot tables and add number of individuals to sex or age strata listed, already do >= 1% proportion 
brain_mult_sex_pos_pivot_melted <- reshape2::melt(brain_mult_sex_pos_pivot_calc) %>%
  dplyr::rename(Sex = variable,
                Proportion = value) %>%
  arrange(-Proportion) %>%
  transform(Sex = ifelse(Sex == "F",
                         paste0("Female (",
                                as.numeric(brain_mult_sex_pos_pivot_damage[nrow(brain_mult_sex_pos_pivot_damage), "Female"]),
                                " individuals)"),
                         as.character(Sex))) %>%
  transform(Sex = ifelse(Sex == "M",
                         paste0("Male (",
                                as.numeric(brain_mult_sex_pos_pivot_damage[nrow(brain_mult_sex_pos_pivot_damage), "Male"]),
                                " individuals)"),
                         Sex)) %>%
  transform(Sex = ifelse(grepl("\\(1 ", 
                               Sex),
                         gsub("individuals", 
                              "individual",
                              Sex),
                         Sex)) %>%
  subset(Mutation %in% (reshape2::melt(brain_mult_sex_pos_pivot_calc) %>%
                          dplyr::rename(Sex = variable,
                                        Proportion = value) %>%
                          arrange(-Proportion) %>%
                          subset(Proportion >= 0.01) %>%
                          pull(Mutation) %>%
                          unique() %>%
                          as.vector())) %>%
  remove_rownames()
```

```{r distribution-cutoff-brain-sole-agestrata-pos, fig.height = 5.5, fig.width = 7.5, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
# vectors for pie chart of how most muts are chosen anyways for heatmap
prop <- n_distinct(brain_sole_agestrata_pos_pivot_melted$Mutation) / n_distinct(brain_sole_agestrata_pos_pivot$Mutation[brain_sole_agestrata_pos_pivot$Mutation != "Total"])
vec <- c(prop,
         1 - prop)
raw <- c(n_distinct(brain_sole_agestrata_pos_pivot_melted$Mutation),
         n_distinct(setdiff(unique(brain_sole_agestrata_pos_pivot$Mutation[brain_sole_agestrata_pos_pivot$Mutation != "Total"]),
                            unique(brain_sole_agestrata_pos_pivot_melted$Mutation))))

# make prevalence waterfall plots (base R barplots + abline at 1%) of all muts in brain to justify why 1% chosen for cutting off
barplot(height = sort(as.numeric(brain_sole_agestrata_pos_pivot %>% 
                                   dplyr::select(-c(Num_Individuals)) %>% # divide down
                                   mutate(across(where(is.numeric), 
                                                 ~ .x/last(.x))) %>% 
                                   subset(Mutation != "Total") %>% 
                                   reshape2::melt() %>% 
                                   pull(value) %>% replace_na(., 0)),
                      decreasing = TRUE),
        xaxs = "i", # remove space between left side of bars and y axis
        ylab = "Proportion of distinct individuals with cancer", 
        xlab = "p53 mutation",
        main = "Prevalence of p53 Mutations in Distinct Individuals with Cancer",
        ylim = c(0, plyr::round_any(max(brain_sole_agestrata_pos_pivot %>% 
                                          dplyr::select(-c(Num_Individuals)) %>% # divide down
                                          mutate(across(where(is.numeric), 
                                                        ~ .x/last(.x))) %>% 
                                          subset(Mutation != "Total") %>% 
                                          reshape2::melt() %>% 
                                          pull(value),
                                        na.rm = TRUE),
                                    0.1,
                                    f = ceiling)),
        col = ifelse(brain_sole_agestrata_pos_pivot$Mutation[brain_sole_agestrata_pos_pivot$Mutation != "Total"] %in% brain_sole_agestrata_pos_pivot_melted$Mutation,
                     "black",
                     "grey"),
        font.lab = 2,
        las = 1,
        space = 0,
        border = NA)
abline(h = 0.01,
       col = "red",
       lty = 2,
       lwd = 2)
legend("right",
       legend = c("Subset", 
                  "Other"),
       col = c("black", 
               "gray"),
       bty = "n", # no border around legend
       pch = 15, # filled square shape
       pt.cex = 1.75) # increase shape size in legend

# pie chart
pie(vec,
    main = "Prevalence of p53 Mutations in Distinct Individuals with Cancer",
    labels = paste0(plyr::round_any(vec * 100,
                                    0.1),
                    "% (",
                    format(raw, 
                           big.mark = ",", 
                           trim = TRUE),
                    " mutations)"),
    col = c("black", "grey"),
    border = NA,
    clockwise = TRUE)
```

```{r allosteosarcomapts, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
# subset dataset of all sole and first mult to just osteosarcoma
origdb_allosteosarcoma_mult_pts <- origdbjustmultcancersover100 %>% 
  subset(Short_topo == "Osteosarcoma") %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  remove_rownames()

origdb_allosteosarcoma_sole_pts <- origdbjustsolecancersover100 %>% 
  subset(Short_topo == "Osteosarcoma") %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  remove_rownames()

# create pivot of number of female and male pts with osteosarcoma in each age stratum of diagnosis, replace any NA with 0, add total number of pts in each age stratum to new column pasted with ages, and make anything with 1 individual singular indication of patients
osteosarcoma_mult_agestrata_sex <- PivotTable$new()
osteosarcoma_mult_agestrata_sex$addData(origdb_allosteosarcoma_mult_pts)
osteosarcoma_mult_agestrata_sex$addRowDataGroups("Age_stratum")
osteosarcoma_mult_agestrata_sex$addColumnDataGroups("Sex") 
osteosarcoma_mult_agestrata_sex$defineCalculation(calculationName = "Count of distinct patients", 
                                                  summariseExpression = "n_distinct(Individual_code)")
osteosarcoma_mult_agestrata_sex$sortColumnDataGroups(levelNumber = 1, 
                                                     orderBy = "calculation", 
                                                     sortOrder = "desc")
osteosarcoma_mult_agestrata_sex$sortRowDataGroups(levelNumber = 1, 
                                                  orderBy = "calculation", 
                                                  sortOrder = "desc")
osteosarcoma_mult_agestrata_sex$evaluatePivot() #doing this instead of renderPivot() which takes too long as it shows an actual pivot table, but we need this as a dataframe anyways for calculations later so we don't need to print a pivot table
osteosarcoma_mult_agestrata_sex_pivot <- osteosarcoma_mult_agestrata_sex$asDataFrame(rowGroupsAsColumns = TRUE) %>% 
  mutate(across(everything(),
                ~ replace_na(.,
                             0))) %>%
  transform(Age = paste0(Age_stratum,
                         " (", 
                         Total,
                         " individuals)")) %>% 
  transform(Age = ifelse(Total == 1,
                         gsub("individuals", 
                              "individual",
                              Age),
                         Age)) %>% 
  remove_rownames()

# melt pos pivot tables and add number of individuals to sex or age strata listed, already do >= 1% proportion 
osteosarcoma_mult_sex_pos_pivot_melted <- reshape2::melt(osteosarcoma_mult_sex_pos_pivot_calc) %>%
  dplyr::rename(Sex = variable,
                Proportion = value) %>%
  arrange(-Proportion) %>%
  transform(Sex = ifelse(Sex == "F",
                         paste0("Female (",
                                as.numeric(osteosarcoma_mult_sex_pos_pivot_damage[nrow(osteosarcoma_mult_sex_pos_pivot_damage), "Female"]),
                                " individuals)"),
                         as.character(Sex))) %>%
  transform(Sex = ifelse(Sex == "M",
                         paste0("Male (",
                                as.numeric(osteosarcoma_mult_sex_pos_pivot_damage[nrow(osteosarcoma_mult_sex_pos_pivot_damage), "Male"]),
                                " individuals)"),
                         Sex)) %>%
  transform(Sex = ifelse(grepl("\\(1 ", 
                               Sex),
                         gsub("individuals", 
                              "individual",
                              Sex),
                         Sex)) %>%
  subset(Mutation %in% (reshape2::melt(osteosarcoma_mult_sex_pos_pivot_calc) %>%
                          dplyr::rename(Sex = variable,
                                        Proportion = value) %>%
                          arrange(-Proportion) %>%
                          subset(Proportion >= 0.01) %>%
                          pull(Mutation) %>%
                          unique() %>%
                          as.vector())) %>%
  remove_rownames()
```

```{r distribution-cutoff-osteosarcoma-sole-agestrata-pos, fig.height = 5.5, fig.width = 7.5, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
# vectors for pie chart of how most muts are chosen anyways for heatmap
prop <- n_distinct(osteosarcoma_sole_agestrata_pos_pivot_melted$Mutation) / n_distinct(osteosarcoma_sole_agestrata_pos_pivot$Mutation[osteosarcoma_sole_agestrata_pos_pivot$Mutation != "Total"])
vec <- c(prop,
         1 - prop)
raw <- c(n_distinct(osteosarcoma_sole_agestrata_pos_pivot_melted$Mutation),
         n_distinct(setdiff(unique(osteosarcoma_sole_agestrata_pos_pivot$Mutation[osteosarcoma_sole_agestrata_pos_pivot$Mutation != "Total"]),
                            unique(osteosarcoma_sole_agestrata_pos_pivot_melted$Mutation))))

# make prevalence waterfall plots (base R barplots + abline at 1%) of all muts in osteosarcoma to justify why 1% chosen for cutting off
barplot(height = sort(as.numeric(osteosarcoma_sole_agestrata_pos_pivot %>% 
                                   dplyr::select(-c(Num_Individuals)) %>% # divide down
                                   mutate(across(where(is.numeric), 
                                                 ~ .x/last(.x))) %>% 
                                   subset(Mutation != "Total") %>% 
                                   reshape2::melt() %>% 
                                   pull(value) %>% replace_na(., 0)),
                      decreasing = TRUE),
        xaxs = "i", # remove space between left side of bars and y axis
        ylab = "Proportion of distinct individuals with cancer", 
        xlab = "p53 mutation",
        main = "Prevalence of p53 Mutations in Distinct Individuals with Cancer",
        ylim = c(0, plyr::round_any(max(osteosarcoma_sole_agestrata_pos_pivot %>% 
                                          dplyr::select(-c(Num_Individuals)) %>% # divide down
                                          mutate(across(where(is.numeric), 
                                                        ~ .x/last(.x))) %>% 
                                          subset(Mutation != "Total") %>% 
                                          reshape2::melt() %>% 
                                          pull(value),
                                        na.rm = TRUE),
                                    0.1,
                                    f = ceiling)),
        col = ifelse(osteosarcoma_sole_agestrata_pos_pivot$Mutation[osteosarcoma_sole_agestrata_pos_pivot$Mutation != "Total"] %in% osteosarcoma_sole_agestrata_pos_pivot_melted$Mutation,
                     "black",
                     "grey"),
        font.lab = 2,
        las = 1,
        space = 0,
        border = NA)
abline(h = 0.01,
       col = "red",
       lty = 2,
       lwd = 2)
legend("right",
       legend = c("Subset", 
                  "Other"),
       col = c("black", 
               "gray"),
       bty = "n", # no border around legend
       pch = 15, # filled square shape
       pt.cex = 1.75) # increase shape size in legend

# pie chart
pie(vec,
    main = "Prevalence of p53 Mutations in Distinct Individuals with Cancer",
    labels = paste0(plyr::round_any(vec * 100,
                                    0.1),
                    "% (",
                    format(raw, 
                           big.mark = ",", 
                           trim = TRUE),
                    " mutations)"),
    col = c("black", "grey"),
    border = NA,
    clockwise = TRUE)
```

```{r allsofttissuespts, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
# subset dataset of all sole and first mult to just soft tissues
origdb_allsofttissues_mult_pts <- origdbjustmultcancersover100 %>% 
  subset(Short_topo == "SOFT TISSUES") %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  remove_rownames()

origdb_allsofttissues_sole_pts <- origdbjustsolecancersover100 %>% 
  subset(Short_topo == "SOFT TISSUES") %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  remove_rownames()

# create pivot of number of female and male pts with softtissues in each age stratum of diagnosis, replace any NA with 0, add total number of pts in each age stratum to new column pasted with ages, and make anything with 1 individual singular indication of patients
softtissues_mult_agestrata_sex <- PivotTable$new()
softtissues_mult_agestrata_sex$addData(origdb_allsofttissues_mult_pts)
softtissues_mult_agestrata_sex$addRowDataGroups("Age_stratum")
softtissues_mult_agestrata_sex$addColumnDataGroups("Sex") 
softtissues_mult_agestrata_sex$defineCalculation(calculationName = "Count of distinct patients", 
                                                 summariseExpression = "n_distinct(Individual_code)")
softtissues_mult_agestrata_sex$sortColumnDataGroups(levelNumber = 1, 
                                                    orderBy = "calculation", 
                                                    sortOrder = "desc")
softtissues_mult_agestrata_sex$sortRowDataGroups(levelNumber = 1, 
                                                 orderBy = "calculation", 
                                                 sortOrder = "desc")
softtissues_mult_agestrata_sex$evaluatePivot() #doing this instead of renderPivot() which takes too long as it shows an actual pivot table, but we need this as a dataframe anyways for calculations later so we don't need to print a pivot table
softtissues_mult_agestrata_sex_pivot <- softtissues_mult_agestrata_sex$asDataFrame(rowGroupsAsColumns = TRUE) %>% 
  mutate(across(everything(),
                ~ replace_na(.,
                             0))) %>%
  transform(Age = paste0(Age_stratum,
                         " (", 
                         Total,
                         " individuals)")) %>% 
  transform(Age = ifelse(Total == 1,
                         gsub("individuals", 
                              "individual",
                              Age),
                         Age)) %>% 
  remove_rownames()

  remove_rownames()

# melt pos pivot tables and add number of individuals to sex or age strata listed, already do >= 1% proportion 
softtissues_mult_sex_pos_pivot_melted <- reshape2::melt(softtissues_mult_sex_pos_pivot_calc) %>%
  dplyr::rename(Sex = variable,
                Proportion = value) %>%
  arrange(-Proportion) %>%
  transform(Sex = ifelse(Sex == "F",
                         paste0("Female (",
                                as.numeric(softtissues_mult_sex_pos_pivot_damage[nrow(softtissues_mult_sex_pos_pivot_damage), "Female"]),
                                " individuals)"),
                         as.character(Sex))) %>%
  transform(Sex = ifelse(Sex == "M",
                         paste0("Male (",
                                as.numeric(softtissues_mult_sex_pos_pivot_damage[nrow(softtissues_mult_sex_pos_pivot_damage), "Male"]),
                                " individuals)"),
                         Sex)) %>%
  transform(Sex = ifelse(grepl("\\(1 ", 
                               Sex),
                         gsub("individuals", 
                              "individual",
                              Sex),
                         Sex)) %>%
  subset(Mutation %in% (reshape2::melt(softtissues_mult_sex_pos_pivot_calc) %>%
                          dplyr::rename(Sex = variable,
                                        Proportion = value) %>%
                          arrange(-Proportion) %>%
                          subset(Proportion >= 0.01) %>%
                          pull(Mutation) %>%
                          unique() %>%
                          as.vector())) %>%
  remove_rownames()
```

```{r distribution-cutoff-softtissues-sole-agestrata-pos, fig.height = 5.5, fig.width = 7.5, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
# vectors for pie chart of how most muts are chosen anyways for heatmap
prop <- n_distinct(softtissues_sole_agestrata_pos_pivot_melted$Mutation) / n_distinct(softtissues_sole_agestrata_pos_pivot$Mutation[softtissues_sole_agestrata_pos_pivot$Mutation != "Total"])
vec <- c(prop,
         1 - prop)
raw <- c(n_distinct(softtissues_sole_agestrata_pos_pivot_melted$Mutation),
         n_distinct(setdiff(unique(softtissues_sole_agestrata_pos_pivot$Mutation[softtissues_sole_agestrata_pos_pivot$Mutation != "Total"]),
                            unique(softtissues_sole_agestrata_pos_pivot_melted$Mutation))))

# make prevalence waterfall plots (base R barplots + abline at 1%) of all muts in soft tissues to justify why 1% chosen for cutting off
barplot(height = sort(as.numeric(softtissues_sole_agestrata_pos_pivot %>% 
                                   dplyr::select(-c(Num_Individuals)) %>% # divide down
                                   mutate(across(where(is.numeric), 
                                                 ~ .x/last(.x))) %>% 
                                   subset(Mutation != "Total") %>% 
                                   reshape2::melt() %>% 
                                   pull(value) %>% replace_na(., 0)),
                      decreasing = TRUE),
        xaxs = "i", # remove space between left side of bars and y axis
        ylab = "Proportion of distinct individuals with cancer", 
        xlab = "p53 mutation",
        main = "Prevalence of p53 Mutations in Distinct Individuals with Cancer",
        ylim = c(0, plyr::round_any(max(softtissues_sole_agestrata_pos_pivot %>% 
                                          dplyr::select(-c(Num_Individuals)) %>% # divide down
                                          mutate(across(where(is.numeric), 
                                                        ~ .x/last(.x))) %>% 
                                          subset(Mutation != "Total") %>% 
                                          reshape2::melt() %>% 
                                          pull(value),
                                        na.rm = TRUE),
                                    0.1,
                                    f = ceiling)),
        col = ifelse(softtissues_sole_agestrata_pos_pivot$Mutation[softtissues_sole_agestrata_pos_pivot$Mutation != "Total"] %in% softtissues_sole_agestrata_pos_pivot_melted$Mutation,
                     "black",
                     "grey"),
        font.lab = 2,
        las = 1,
        space = 0,
        border = NA)
abline(h = 0.01,
       col = "red",
       lty = 2,
       lwd = 2)
legend("right",
       legend = c("Subset", 
                  "Other"),
       col = c("black", 
               "gray"),
       bty = "n", # no border around legend
       pch = 15, # filled square shape
       pt.cex = 1.75) # increase shape size in legend

# pie chart
pie(vec,
    main = "Prevalence of p53 Mutations in Distinct Individuals with Cancer",
    labels = paste0(plyr::round_any(vec * 100,
                                    0.1),
                    "% (",
                    format(raw, 
                           big.mark = ",", 
                           trim = TRUE),
                    " mutations)"),
    col = c("black", "grey"),
    border = NA,
    clockwise = TRUE)
```

```{r distribution-cutoff-softtissues-sole-sex-pos, fig.height = 5.5, fig.width = 7.5, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
                                   dplyr::select(-c(Num_Individuals)) %>% # divide down
                                   mutate(across(where(is.numeric), 
                                                 ~ .x/last(.x))) %>% 
                                   subset(Mutation != "Total") %>% 
                                   reshape2::melt() %>% 
                                   pull(value) %>% replace_na(., 0)),
                      decreasing = TRUE),
        xaxs = "i", # remove space between left side of bars and y axis
        ylab = "Proportion of distinct individuals with cancer", 
        xlab = "p53 mutation",
        main = "Prevalence of p53 Mutations in Distinct Individuals with Cancer",
        ylim = c(0, plyr::round_any(max(softtissues_sole_sex_pos_pivot %>% 
                                          dplyr::select(-c(Num_Individuals)) %>% # divide down
                                          mutate(across(where(is.numeric), 
                                                        ~ .x/last(.x))) %>% 
                                          subset(Mutation != "Total") %>% 
                                          reshape2::melt() %>% 
                                          pull(value),
                                        na.rm = TRUE),
                                    0.1,
                                    f = ceiling)),
        col = ifelse(softtissues_sole_sex_pos_pivot$Mutation[softtissues_sole_sex_pos_pivot$Mutation != "Total"] %in% softtissues_sole_sex_pos_pivot_melted$Mutation,
                     "black",
                     "grey"),
        font.lab = 2,
        las = 1,
        space = 0,
        border = NA)
abline(h = 0.01,
       col = "red",
       lty = 2,
       lwd = 2)
legend("right",
       legend = c("Subset", 
                  "Other"),
       col = c("black", 
               "gray"),
       bty = "n", # no border around legend
       pch = 15, # filled square shape
       pt.cex = 1.75) # increase shape size in legend

# pie chart
pie(vec,
    main = "Prevalence of p53 Mutations in Distinct Individuals with Cancer",
    labels = paste0(plyr::round_any(vec * 100,
                                    0.1),
                    "% (",
                    format(raw, 
                           big.mark = ",", 
                           trim = TRUE),
                    " mutations)"),
    col = c("black", "grey"),
    border = NA,
    clockwise = TRUE)
```

```{r mut-rescued-hematological-grid, fig.height = 11, fig.width = 22, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE}
mut_rescued_hematological_gridprep <- condformat(origdbjustsolecancersover100 %>% 
                                                   subset(Short_topo == "HEMATOP. SYSTEM") %>%
                                                   mutate(Sex = dplyr::case_when(Sex == "M" ~ "Male",
                                                                                 Sex == "F" ~ "Female",
                                                                                 TRUE ~ Sex)) %>% 
                                                   dplyr::select(c(Short_topo,
                                                                   Morphology,
                                                                   #Population, 
                                                                   #Region,
                                                                   Sex,
                                                                   Age_stratum,
                                                                   Effect,
                                                                   ProtDescription,
                                                                   Domain,
                                                                   Residue_function,
                                                                   SIFTClass,
                                                                   DNE_LOFclass)) %>% 
                                                   arrange(abs(parse_number(ProtDescription))) %>% 
                                                   arrange(Morphology) %>% 
                                                   # mutate(ProtDescription = gsub("\\?-0-splice",
                                                   #                               "Intronic",
                                                   #                               ProtDescription)) %>% 
                                                   # mutate(ProtDescription = gsub("\\?",
                                                   #                               "",
                                                   #                               ProtDescription)) %>%
                                                   mutate(across(everything(), 
                                                                 ~ replace(., 
                                                                           . %in% c("NA", NA),
                                                                           ""))) %>% 
                                                   dplyr::rename(System = Short_topo,
                                                                 Cancer = Morphology,
                                                                 `Age stratum` = Age_stratum,
                                                                 Type = Effect,
                                                                 Mutation = ProtDescription,
                                                                 `Feature` = Residue_function,
                                                                 `SIFT` = SIFTClass,
                                                                 `DNE` = DNE_LOFclass) %>% 
                                                   remove_rownames()) %>% 
  rule_text_color(Mutation,
                  ifelse(Mutation %in% mut_rescued,
                         "red",
                         "")) %>%
  rule_text_bold(Mutation,
                 expression = Mutation %in% mut_rescued) %>%
  theme_grob(rows = NULL, 
             theme = ttheme_default(base_size = 10,
                                    core = list(padding = unit(c(15, 4), "mm")))) %>%
  condformat2grob(draw = FALSE)

mut_rescued_hematological_grid <- grid.arrange(mut_rescued_hematological_gridprep,
                                               top = textGrob("Individuals with Hematological Cancers and Germline TP53 Mutations",
                                                              hjust = 0.5,
                                                              gp = gpar(fontface = "bold")))
```

```{r mut-rescued-splice-soleotherpivotpos-grid, fig.height = 7, fig.width = 16.5, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
                                           dplyr::rename(System = Short_topo
                                                         #,
                                                         #Intronic = `?-0-splice`
                                           ) %>%
                                           remove_rownames()) %>%
  # rule_text_bold(Total,
  #                expression = Total > 0) %>%
  # rule_fill_discrete(Total,
  #                    expression = Total > 0,
  #                    colours = c("TRUE" = "grey80")) %>% # also adds unremovable black borders
  theme_grob(rows = NULL, 
             theme = ttheme_default(base_size = 10,
                                    core = list(padding = unit(c(15, 4), "mm")
                                                #,
                                                # fg_params = list(fontface = c(rep("plain", 
                                                #                                   nrow(solecancerpivotpos %>% subset(Total < 40)) - 1), 
                                                #                               "bold"))
                                                #                                         ,
                                                # bg_params = list(fill = c(rep(c("grey95", "grey90"),
                                                #                             length.out = (nrow(solecancerpivotpos %>% subset(Total < 40)) - 1)),
                                                #                  "grey80")))
                                    ))) %>%
  condformat2grob(draw = FALSE)

soleotherpivotpos_grid <- grid.arrange(soleotherpivotpos_gridprep,
                                       top = textGrob("Selected Mutations of Individuals with Less Prevalent Cancers and Germline TP53 Mutations",
                                                      hjust = 0.5,
                                                      gp = gpar(fontface = "bold")))
```

```{r mannwhitney-boxplot-composition, include = FALSE}
# to test for significance in boxplot of core first vs other first pts composition of cancers, do mann whitney test which is a nonparametric (not normally distributed data) test for unpaired samples whether the central tendencies of 2 groups are similar or not
# although ggpubr will also calculate p val, doing it this way to ensure p val on plot is accurate
# wilcox.test(cancersperpt_pivot_list_df %>% 
#               subset(V1 == 1) %>% 
#               pull(mean), 
#             cancersperpt_pivot_list_df %>% 
#               subset(V1 != 1) %>% 
#               pull(mean), 
#             paired = FALSE,
#             alternative = "two.sided") # no directionality here
# 
# wilcox.test(cancersperpt_pivot_list_df %>% 
#               subset(V1 == 1) %>% 
#               pull(mean), 
#             cancersperpt_pivot_list_df %>% 
#               subset(V1 != 1) %>% 
#               pull(mean),
```

# **Drawing Cancer Breakdown Stacked Barcharts** {#breakdownbarcharts .hidden .unlisted .unnumbered}

# **Drawing Color-Coded Cancer Sequence Map** {#colorcodedmap .hidden .unlisted .unnumbered}

$~$

Now that the cancers per Individual data has been set up in a table and has properly formatted annotation colors, I can create a visual representation of the sequence of cancers in the `r format(c(length(unique(multpts$Individual_code))), big.mark = ",", trim = TRUE)` patients with at least 2 cancers. Here I have set it up as patients as columns and cancer incidence as rows.

$~$

```{r cancerseqmap, fig.height = 5.5, fig.width = 28, include = FALSE}
#create color-coded map of cancer sequence for each Individual
cancerseqmap <- ggplot(cancersperpt,
                       aes(x = Individual_code, 
                           y = cancer_incidence)) +
  geom_tile(aes(fill = Short_topo_modif)) +
  ggtitle(paste0("Cancer Sequence in Individuals with Multiple Cancers (",
                 length(unique(cancersperpt$Individual_code)),
                 " individuals)")) +
  xlab("individual") +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(title = "Tissue")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = annotationcolornamedgeomtile[["Tissue"]]) +
  scale_x_discrete(position = "top") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        axis.title.y = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks = element_blank(),
        axis.line = element_blank(),
        axis.title = element_text(color = "black",
                                  size = 14),
        axis.text = element_text(color = "black",
                                 size = 14),
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold",
                                  color = "black",
                                  hjust = 0.5,
                                  size = 16),
        plot.title.position = "plot",
        legend.title = element_text(face = "bold",
                                    color = "black",
                                    size = 14),
        legend.text = element_text(color = "black",
                                   size = 14),
        legend.position = "bottom", 
        legend.direction = "vertical")
cancerseqmap
```

$~$

```{r sexindication, fig.width = 28, fig.height = 1.6, include = FALSE}
sexindication <- ggplot(cancersperpt,
                        aes(x = Individual_code, 
                            y = cancer_incidence)) +
  geom_tile(data = subset(cancersperpt,
                          cancer_incidence == "Cancer 1"),
            aes(fill = Sex)) +
  scale_x_discrete(position = "top") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text = element_blank(),
        axis.title = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks = element_blank(),
        axis.line = element_blank(),
        legend.title = element_text(face = "bold",
                                    color = "black",
                                    size = 14),
        legend.text = element_text(color = "black",
                                   size = 14),
        legend.position = "bottom", 
        legend.direction = "vertical")
sexindication
```

$~$

```{r cancerseqandsex, fig.height = 7.5, fig.width = 28, include = FALSE}
cancerseqandsex <- ggarrange(cancerseqmap,
```

```{r stackedbarchart-mult, warning = FALSE, fig.width = 6.5, fig.height = 7, eval = FALSE, include = FALSE}
#sort cancers by lowest to highest missense mutation or breast proportion for stacked barchart
multcancerbarchartorder = multcancerpivottype_melted[multcancerpivottype_melted$Mutation == 'missense',]
multcancerpivottype_melted$Cancer_Label = factor(multcancerpivottype_melted$Cancer_Label, 
                                                 levels = multcancerbarchartorder$Cancer_Label[order(multcancerbarchartorder$Proportion)])

multcancerbarchartorder_age = multcancerpivotage_type_melted[multcancerpivotage_type_melted$Mutation == 'missense',]
multcancerpivotage_type_melted$Age = factor(multcancerpivotage_type_melted$Age, 
                                            levels = multcancerbarchartorder_age$Age[order(multcancerbarchartorder_age$Proportion)])

# multcancerbarchartorder_age_tissue = multcancerpivotage_melted[multcancerpivotage_melted$Cancer_Label == 'BREAST',]
# multcancerpivotage_melted$Age = factor(multcancerpivotage_melted$Age, 
#                                        levels = multcancerbarchartorder_age_tissue$Age[order(multcancerbarchartorder_age_tissue$Proportion)])

multcancerpivotage_melted$Cancer_Label <- factor(multcancerpivotage_melted$Cancer_Label,
                                                 levels = c((sort(unique(multcancerpivotage_melted$Cancer_Label)))[(sort(unique(multcancerpivotage_melted$Cancer_Label))) != "OTHER"], 
                                                            "OTHER"))

multcancerbarchartorder_sex = multcancerpivotsex_type_melted[multcancerpivotsex_type_melted$Mutation == 'missense',]
multcancerpivotsex_type_melted$Sex = factor(multcancerpivotsex_type_melted$Sex, 
                                            levels = multcancerbarchartorder_sex$Sex[order(multcancerbarchartorder_sex$Proportion)])

# multcancerbarchartorder_sex_tissue = multcancerpivotsex_melted[multcancerpivotsex_melted$Cancer_Label == 'BREAST',]
# multcancerpivotsex_melted$Sex = factor(multcancerpivotsex_melted$Sex, 
#                                        levels = multcancerbarchartorder_sex_tissue$Sex[order(multcancerbarchartorder_sex_tissue$Proportion)])

multcancerpivotsex_melted$Cancer_Label <- factor(multcancerpivotsex_melted$Cancer_Label,
                                                 levels = c((sort(unique(multcancerpivotsex_melted$Cancer_Label)))[(sort(unique(multcancerpivotsex_melted$Cancer_Label))) != "OTHER"], 
                                                            "OTHER"))


# make 100% stacked barchart with ggplot2 with reversed missense order i.e. highest to lowest
multcancer_ggplotstackedbarchart <- ggplot(multcancerpivottype_melted %>%
                                             subset(!str_detect(Cancer_Label, 
                                                                "OTHER")), 
                                           aes(x = Cancer_Label, 
                                               y = Proportion, 
                                               fill = Mutation)) + 
  geom_bar(position = "fill", 
           stat = "identity") + 
  ggtitle("Mutation Types vs. First Cancers of \nIndividuals with Multiple Cancers \nand Germline p53 Mutations") + # distinct individuals/ \n# total distinct individuals
  xlab("First cancer diagnosed") +
  ylab("Proportion of distinct individuals") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(), 
                     expand = c(0,0), 
                     breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 6)) +
  scale_x_discrete(limits = rev(levels(multcancerpivottype_melted$Cancer_Label)[!str_detect(levels(multcancerpivottype_melted$Cancer_Label), 
                                                                                            "OTHER")]), 
                   expand = c(0,0)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#009E73",
                               "#000000",
                               "#CC79A7",
                               "#0072B2",
                               "#E69F00",
                               "#999999",
                               "#56B4E9",
                               "lightgray",
                               "#D55E00",
                               "#F0E442")) +
  theme_classic() + 
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, 
                                   hjust = 1, 
                                   vjust = 1), 
        axis.text = element_text(color = "black",
                                 size = 12), 
        axis.title = element_text(color = "black",
                                  face = "bold",
                                  size = 14),
        axis.title.x = element_text(margin = unit(c(5,0,0,0), units = "mm")),
        axis.title.y = element_text(margin = unit(c(0,5,0,0), units = "mm")),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5,
                                  face = "bold",
                                  color = "black",
                                  size = 16,
                                  margin = margin(0,0,5,0, "mm")),
        # plot.title.position = "plot",
        legend.text = element_text(color = "black",
                                   size = 12),
        legend.title = element_text(color = "black",
                                    face = "bold",
                                    size = 14),
        plot.margin = margin(0,0,0,35, "mm"))
multcancer_ggplotstackedbarchart
```

```{r stackedbarchart-sole, warning = FALSE, fig.width = 5.75, fig.height = 7.25}
#sort cancers by lowest to highest missense mutation or breast proportion for stacked barchart
solecancerbarchartorder = solecancerpivottype_melted[solecancerpivottype_melted$Mutation == 'missense',]
solecancerpivottype_melted$Cancer_Label = factor(solecancerpivottype_melted$Cancer_Label, 
                                                 levels = solecancerbarchartorder$Cancer_Label[order(solecancerbarchartorder$Proportion)])

solecancerbarchartorder_age = solecancerpivotage_type_melted[solecancerpivotage_type_melted$Mutation == 'missense',]
solecancerpivotage_type_melted$Age = factor(solecancerpivotage_type_melted$Age, 
                                            levels = solecancerbarchartorder_age$Age[order(solecancerbarchartorder_age$Proportion)])

solecancerpivotage_melted$Cancer_Label <- factor(solecancerpivotage_melted$Cancer_Label,
                                                 levels = as.character(c((sort(unique(solecancerpivotage_melted$Cancer_Label)))[(sort(unique(solecancerpivotage_melted$Cancer_Label))) != "OTHER"], 
                                                                         "OTHER")))

solecancerbarchartorder_sex = solecancerpivotsex_type_melted[solecancerpivotsex_type_melted$Mutation == 'missense',]

                                             subset(!str_detect(Cancer_Label,
                                                                "OTHER")), 
                                           aes(x = Cancer_Label, 
                                               y = Proportion, 
                                               fill = Mutation)) + 
  geom_bar(position = "fill", 
           stat = "identity") + 
  ggtitle("Mutation Types vs. Cancers of \nIndividuals with One Cancer \nand Germline p53 Mutations") + # distinct individuals/ \n# total distinct individuals
  xlab("Cancer") +
  ylab("Proportion of distinct individuals") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(), 
                     expand = c(0,0), 
                     breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 6)) +
  scale_x_discrete(limits = rev(levels(solecancerpivottype_melted$Cancer_Label)[!str_detect(levels(solecancerpivottype_melted$Cancer_Label), 
                                                                                            "OTHER")]), 
                   expand = c(0,0)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#009E73",
                               "#000000",
                               "#0072B2",
                               "#CC79A7",
                               "#999999",
                               "#E69F00",
                               "lightgray",
                               "#56B4E9",
                               "#D55E00",
                               "#F0E442")) +   
  theme_classic() + 
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45,

                                   vjust = 1), 
        axis.text = element_text(color = "black",
                                 size = 12), 
        axis.title = element_text(color = "black",
                                  face = "bold",
                                  size = 14),
        axis.title.x = element_text(margin = unit(c(5,0,0,0), units = "mm")),
        axis.title.y = element_text(margin = unit(c(0,5,0,0), units = "mm")),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5,
                                  face = "bold",

        # plot.title.position = "plot",
        legend.text = element_text(color = "black",
                                   size = 12),
        legend.title = element_text(color = "black",
                                    face = "bold",
                                    size = 14),
        plot.margin = margin(0,0,0,8, "mm"))
```

```{r barchart-facet-age-tissue-sole, fig.height = 9.5, fig.width = 11, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
# to minimize above crowding, make faceted barchart of age vs number of pts per cancer
barchart_facet_age_tissue_sole <- ggplot(solecancerpivotage %>%
                                           subset(Age_stratum != "Total") %>%
                                           mutate(Age_stratum = paste0(Age_stratum,
                                                                       " (",
                                                                       format(Total, 
                                                                              big.mark = ",", 
                                                                              trim = TRUE),
                                                                       " individuals)")) %>%
                                           dplyr::select(-c(Total
                                                            #,
                                                            #OTHER
                                           )) %>% 
                                           mutate(across(everything(), 
                                                         ~ replace_na(.x, 0))) %>%
                                           reshape2::melt() %>% 
                                           dplyr::rename(Age = Age_stratum,
                                                         Cancer = variable, 
                                                         Num_Distinct_Pts = value),
                                         aes(x = factor(Cancer,
                                                        levels = 
                                                          c(
                                                            sort(unique(colnames(solecancerpivotage %>% 
                                                                                   dplyr::select(-c(
                                                                                     OTHER,
                                                                                     Total, 
                                                                                     Age_stratum)))))
                                                            ,
                                                            "OTHER")
                                         ),
                                         y = Num_Distinct_Pts,
                                         fill = factor(Cancer,
                                                       levels = 
                                                         c(
                                                           sort(unique(colnames(solecancerpivotage %>% 
                                                                                  dplyr::select(-c(
                                                                                    OTHER,
                                                                                    Total, 
                                                                                    Age_stratum)))))
                                                           ,
                                                           "OTHER")
                                         ))) + 
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", 
           position = position_dodge2()) + # to keep some space b/t barcharts in same mut
  geom_text(aes(label = Num_Distinct_Pts,
                vjust = -1),
            color = "black",
            fontface = "bold",
            size = 3.5,
            alpha = 0.5) + # add num pts above each bar
  ggtitle("Cancers vs. Ages of Cancer Diagnoses in Individuals with Germline p53 Mutations") +
  xlab("Cancer") +
  ylab("Number of distinct individuals") +
  labs(fill = "Cancer") +
  facet_wrap2(. ~ Age,
              #strip.position = "right",
              #labeller = labeller(groupwrap = label_wrap_gen(10)), # wrap labels on right based on characters
              ncol = 3,
              axes = "all", # show internal axes but without x labels
              remove_labels = "x") + # show internal axes but without x labels
  guides(fill = guide_legend(ncol = 1)) + 
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0,0)
                     #,
                     #n.breaks = 7
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, (solecancerpivotage %>%
                                 subset(Age_stratum != "Total") %>%
                                 dplyr::select(-c(Total
                                                  #,
                                                  #OTHER
                                 )) %>%
                                 reshape2::melt() %>%
                                 pull(value) %>%
                                 na.omit() %>%
                                 max() %>%
                                 plyr::round_any(50,
                                                 ceiling)))) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#CC79A7",
                               "#E69F00",
                               "#009E73",
                               "#56B4E9",
                               "#999999"
                               ,
                               "#000000"
                               #,
                               #"#F0E442",
                               #"#0072B2",
                               #"#D55E00"
  )) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, 
                                   hjust = 1, 
                                   vjust = 1), 
        axis.text = element_text(color = "black",
                                 size = 12), 
        axis.title = element_text(color = "black",
                                  face = "bold",
                                  size = 14),
        axis.title.x = element_text(margin = unit(c(10,0,0,0), units = "mm")),
        axis.title.y = element_text(margin = unit(c(0,10,0,0), units = "mm")),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5,
                                  face = "bold",
                                  color = "black",
                                  size = 16,
                                  margin = margin(0,0,10,0, "mm")),
        legend.text = element_text(color = "black",
                                   size = 12),
        legend.title = element_text(color = "black",
                                    face = "bold",
                                    size = 14),
        legend.box.spacing = margin(30), # increase space between legend and plot
        legend.position = c(0.97, 0.1), # make legend occupy bottom right empty space
        legend.justification = c(0.97, 0), # make legend occupy bottom right empty space
        strip.background = element_blank(),
        strip.text = element_text(color = "black",
                                  size = 14,
                                  face = "bold",
                                  margin = margin(0,0,5,0, "mm")),
        panel.spacing.y = unit(-4, "lines"),
        panel.spacing.x = unit(2.8, "lines"),
        plot.margin = margin(0,2,0,10, unit = "mm"))
```
