```{r barchart-facet-inheri-sole, fig.height = 9.5, fig.width = 11, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
                                       reshape2::melt() %>% 
                                       dplyr::rename(Cancer = variable, 
                                                     Num_Distinct_Pts = value),
                                     aes(x = factor(Cancer,
                                                    levels = 
                                                      c(
                                                        sort(unique(solecancerpivotinheri %>%
                                                                      subset(!str_detect(Cancer_Label,
                                                                                         "OTHER|Total")) %>% 
                                                                      pull(Cancer_Label)))
                                                        ,
                                                        "OTHER")
                                     ),
                                     y = Num_Distinct_Pts,
                                     fill = factor(Cancer,
                                                   levels = 
                                                     c(
                                                       sort(unique(solecancerpivotinheri %>%
                                                                     subset(!str_detect(Cancer_Label,
                                                                                        "OTHER|Total")) %>% 
                                                                     pull(Cancer_Label)))
                                                       ,
                                                       "OTHER")
                                     ))) + 
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", 
           position = position_dodge2()) + # to keep some space b/t barcharts in same mut
  geom_text(aes(label = Num_Distinct_Pts,
                vjust = -1),
            color = "black",
            fontface = "bold",
            size = 3.5,
            alpha = 0.5) + # add num pts above each bar
  ggtitle("Cancers vs. Inheritances in Individuals with Germline p53 Mutations") +
  xlab("Cancer") +
  ylab("Number of distinct individuals") +
  labs(fill = "Cancer") +
  facet_wrap2(. ~ factor(Inheritance,
                         levels = (solecancerpivotinheri %>% 
                                     column_to_rownames("Cancer_Label") %>%
                                     dplyr::rename(`Maternal` = M,
                                                   `Paternal` = P,
                                                   `De novo` = `de novo`,
                                                   `De novo, mosaic` = `de novo, mosaic`,
                                                   `Not listed` = `NA`) %>%
                                     t() %>%
                                     as.data.frame() %>% 
                                     rownames_to_column("Inheritance") %>%
                                     subset(Inheritance != "Total") %>%
                                     mutate(Inheritance = paste0(Inheritance,
                                                                 " (",
                                                                 format(Total, 
                                                                        big.mark = ",", 
                                                                        trim = TRUE),
                                                                 " individuals)")) %>%
                                     mutate(Inheritance_temp = gsub(" \\(.*", 
                                                                    "",
                                                                    Inheritance)) %>%
                                     mutate(Inheritance_temp = factor(Inheritance_temp,
                                                                      levels = c('Maternal',
                                                                                 'Paternal',
                                                                                 'De novo',
                                                                                 'De novo, mosaic',
                                                                                 'Not listed'))) %>% 
                                     arrange(Inheritance_temp) %>% 
                                     pull(Inheritance) %>% 
                                     unique())),
              #strip.position = "right",
              labeller = label_wrap_gen(), # wrap labels on right based on characters
              ncol = 3,
              axes = "all", # show internal axes but without x labels
              remove_labels = "x") + # show internal axes but without x labels
  guides(fill = guide_legend(ncol = 1)) + 
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0,0)
                     #,
                     #n.breaks = 7
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, (solecancerpivotinheri %>% 
                                 subset(Cancer_Label != "Total") %>%
                                 dplyr::select(c(-Total)) %>% 
                                 column_to_rownames("Cancer_Label") %>% 
                                 max(na.rm = TRUE) %>%
                                 plyr::round_any(100,
                                                 ceiling)) * 1.00001)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#CC79A7",
                               "#E69F00",
                               "#009E73",
                               "#56B4E9",
                               "#999999"
                               ,
                               "#000000"
                               #,
                               #"#F0E442",
                               #"#0072B2",
                               #"#D55E00"
  )) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, 
                                   hjust = 1, 
                                   vjust = 1), 
        axis.text = element_text(color = "black",
                                 size = 12), 
        axis.title = element_text(color = "black",
                                  face = "bold",
                                  size = 14),
        axis.title.x = element_text(margin = unit(c(10,0,0,0), units = "mm")),
        axis.title.y = element_text(margin = unit(c(0,10,0,0), units = "mm")),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5,
                                  face = "bold",
                                  color = "black",
                                  size = 16,
                                  margin = margin(0,0,10,0, "mm")),
        legend.text = element_text(color = "black",
                                   size = 12),
        legend.title = element_text(color = "black",
                                    face = "bold",
                                    size = 14),
        legend.box.spacing = margin(30), # increase space between legend and plot
        legend.position = c(0.97, 0.1), # make legend occupy bottom right empty space
        legend.justification = c(0.97, 0), # make legend occupy bottom right empty space
        strip.background = element_blank(),
        strip.text = element_text(color = "black",
                                  size = 14,
                                  face = "bold",
                                  margin = margin(0,0,5,0, "mm")),
        panel.spacing.y = unit(-4, "lines"),
        panel.spacing.x = unit(3, "lines"),
        plot.margin = margin(0,2,0,12, unit = "mm"))
barchart_facet_inheri_sole
```

```{r stackedbarchart-cancerseq, warning = FALSE, fig.height = 5, fig.width = 4.5}
# sort by highest to lowest tissue proportion which is breast
cancerspertimeorder <- cancerspertime_melted[cancerspertime_melted$Tissue_modif == 'BREAST',]
cancerspertime_melted$Sequence <- factor(cancerspertime_melted$Sequence, 
                                         levels = cancerspertimeorder$Sequence[order(cancerspertimeorder$Proportion)])
cancerspertime_melted$Tissue_modif <- factor(cancerspertime_melted$Tissue_modif,
                                             levels = rev(unique(cancerspertime_melted$Tissue_modif)))

# make 100% stacked barchart with ggplot2 with reversed tissue order i.e. highest to lowest
cancerseqbarchart <- ggplot(cancerspertime_melted, 
                            aes(x = Sequence, 
                                y = Proportion, 
                                fill = Tissue_modif)) + 
  geom_bar(position = "fill", 
           stat = "identity") + 
  ggtitle("# cancers/# pts") + 
  guides(fill = guide_legend(title = "Tissue",
                             reverse = TRUE)) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(), 
                     expand = c(0,0), 
                     breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 6)) +
  scale_x_discrete(limits = rev(levels(cancerspertime_melted$Sequence)), 
                   expand = c(0,0)) +
  theme_classic() + 
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45,
                                   hjust = 1,
                                   vjust = 1), 
        axis.text = element_text(color = "black",
                                 size = 12), 
        axis.title = element_text(color = "black",
                                  face = "bold",
                                  size = 14),
        axis.title.x = element_text(margin = unit(c(5, 0, 0, 0), "mm")),
        axis.title.y = element_text(margin = unit(c(0, 5, 0, 0), "mm")),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5,
                                  face = "bold",
                                  color = "black",
                                  size = 16,
                                  margin = margin(0,0,5,0, "mm")),
        plot.title.position = "plot",
        legend.text = element_text(color = "black",
                                   size = 12),
        legend.title = element_text(color = "black",
                                    face = "bold",
                                    size = 14))
```

```{r softtissues-sole-agestrata-sex-barchart, fig.height = 6.25, fig.width = 5.25}
  ylab("Proportion of distinct individuals") +
  labs(fill = "Sex") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(),
                     expand = c(0,0),
                     breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 6)) +
  scale_x_discrete(expand = c(0,0)) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45,
                                   hjust = 1,
                                   vjust = 1),
        axis.text = element_text(color = "black",
                                 size = 12),
        axis.title = element_text(color = "black",
                                  face = "bold",
                                  size = 14),
        axis.title.x = element_text(margin = margin(5,0,0,0,"mm")),
        axis.title.y = element_text(margin = margin(0,5,0,0,"mm")),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5,
                                  face = "bold",
                                  color = "black",
                                  size = 16,
                                  margin = margin(0,0,5,0, "mm")),
        # plot.title.position = "plot",
        plot.margin = margin(0,0,0,4, "mm"),
        legend.text = element_text(color = "black",
                                   size = 12),
        legend.title = element_text(color = "black",
                                    face = "bold",
                                    size = 14),
        # strip.background = element_blank(),
        # strip.text = element_text(color = "black",
        #                           size = 11),
        # panel.spacing.x = unit(1.5, "lines")
  )
softtissues_sole_agestrata_sex_barchart
```

# **Drawing Plots to Justify Cutoffs** {#justifyplots}

$~$

$~$

```{r justify-p53mut-40pts-sole, fig.height = 5.5, fig.width = 7.5, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
# proportion of how 40+ pts cutoff captures most pts with p53 muts
solepropor_over40muts <- (solecancerpivottype %>%
                            subset(Short_topo %in% origdbcancersover100$Short_topo) %>%
                            pull(Total) %>%
                            sum()) / n_distinct(origdbsolecancer$Individual_code)

zed <- origdbsolecancer %>%
  group_by(Short_topo) %>%
  summarise(n = n_distinct(Individual_code)) %>%
  arrange(-n)

vec <- c(solepropor_over40muts,
         1 - solepropor_over40muts)

raw <- c(solecancerpivottype %>%
           subset(Short_topo %in% origdbcancersover100$Short_topo) %>%
           pull(Total) %>%
           sum(),
         solecancerpivottype %>%
           subset(Short_topo == "OTHER") %>%
           pull(Total))

barplot(height = sort(as.numeric(zed$n),
                      decreasing = TRUE),
        xaxs = "i", # remove space between left side of bars and y axis
        ylab = "Number of distinct individuals", 
        xlab = "Cancer",
        main = "Prevalence of Distinct Individuals with p53-Mutant Cancers",
        ylim = c(0, plyr::round_any(max(as.numeric(zed$n)),
                                    10, 
                                    f = ceiling)),
        col = ifelse(zed$Short_topo %in% origdbcancersover100$Short_topo,
                     "black",
                     "grey"),
        font.lab = 2,
        las = 1,
        space = 0,
        border = NA) 
abline(h = 40,
       col = "red",
       lty = 2,
       lwd = 2)
legend("right",
       legend = c("Subset", 
                  "Other"),
       col = c("black", 
               "gray"),
       bty = "n", # no border around legend
       pch = 15, # filled square shape
       pt.cex = 1.75) # increase shape size in legend

pie(vec,
    main = "Prevalence of Distinct Individuals with p53-Mutant Cancers",
    labels = paste0(plyr::round_any(vec * 100,
                                    0.1),
                    "% (",
                    format(raw, 
                           big.mark = ",", 
                           trim = TRUE),
                    " individuals)"),
    col = c("black", "grey"),
    border = NA,
    clockwise = TRUE)
```

$~$

```{r justify-sole-cancer-prevalence-barchart, fig.height = 7.5, fig.width = 17.5, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE}
# make df of prevalence of cancers in entire sole dataset
df_prev <- zed %>%
  adorn_totals() %>%
  mutate(prop = n/last(n)) %>% 
  subset(Short_topo != "Total") %>% 
  dplyr::rename(Cancer = Short_topo) %>% 
  mutate(Cancer_Label = paste0(Cancer,
                               " (",
                               format(n, 
                                      big.mark = ",", 
                                      trim = TRUE),
                               " individuals)")) %>% 
  mutate(Cancer_Label = ifelse(n == 1,
                               gsub("individuals",
                                    "individual",
                                    Cancer_Label),
                               Cancer_Label)) %>% 
  mutate(coloring = ifelse(Cancer %in% core_LFS_tumors,
                           "subset",
                           "cancer"))

# make barchart
justify_sole_cancer_prevalence_barchart <- ggplot(df_prev,
                                                  aes(x = factor(Cancer_Label,
                                                                 levels = unique(df_prev$Cancer_Label)),
                                                      y = prop,
                                                      fill = relevel(as.factor(coloring),
                                                                     ref = "subset"))) + 
  geom_bar(position = position_dodge2(), 
           stat = "identity") + 
  ggtitle("Proportion of Cancers in Individuals with Germline Mutations in TP53") + 
  xlab("Cancer") +
  ylab("Proportion of distinct individuals") +
  labs(fill = "Type") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(), 
                     expand = c(0,0), 
                     breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 5),
                     limits = c(0, plyr::round_any(max(df_prev$prop),
                                                   0.1,
                                                   f = ceiling) * 1.0000001)) +
  scale_x_discrete(expand = c(0,0)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#0072B2",
                               "skyblue")) +
  theme_classic() + 
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, 
                                   hjust = 1, 
                                   vjust = 1), 
        axis.text = element_text(color = "black",
                                 size = 12), 
        axis.title = element_text(color = "black",
                                  face = "bold",
                                  size = 14),
        axis.title.x = element_text(margin = unit(c(10,0,0,0), units = "mm")),
        axis.title.y = element_text(margin = unit(c(0,10,0,0), units = "mm")),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5,
                                  face = "bold",
                                  color = "black",
                                  size = 16,
                                  margin = margin(0,0,10,0, "mm")),
        legend.text = element_text(color = "black",
                                   size = 12),
        legend.title = element_text(color = "black",
                                    face = "bold",
                                    size = 14),
        plot.margin = margin(0,0,0,20, "mm"))
justify_sole_cancer_prevalence_barchart
```

$~$

```{r justify-sole-cancer-prevalence-barchart-horiz, fig.height = 16, fig.width = 11.5, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE}
# make horiz stacked barchart
justify_sole_cancer_prevalence_barchart_horiz <- ggplot(df_prev,
                                                        aes(x = factor(Cancer_Label,
                                                                       levels = unique(df_prev$Cancer_Label)),
                                                            y = prop,
                                                            fill = relevel(as.factor(coloring),
                                                                           ref = "subset"))) + 
  geom_bar(position = position_dodge2(),
           stat = "identity") +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(plyr::round_any(prop * 100,
                                               0.1
                                               #,
                                               #f = ceiling
  ),
  "%")),
  position = position_dodge2(),
  color = "black",
  size = 4.5,
  fontface = "bold",
  alpha = 0.5, # level of transparency (lower is more transparent)
  vjust = 0.5,
  hjust = -0.25) +
  ggtitle("Proportion of Cancers in Individuals with Germline Mutations in TP53") + 
  xlab("Cancer") +
  ylab("Proportion of distinct individuals") +
  labs(fill = "Type") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(), 
                     expand = c(0,0), 
                     breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 5),
                     position = "right") +
  scale_x_discrete(expand = c(0,0),
                   limits = rev) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#0072B2",
                               "skyblue")) +
  theme_classic() + 
  coord_flip(ylim = c(0, plyr::round_any(max(df_prev$prop),
                                         0.1,
                                         f = ceiling) * 1.0000001)) + # calls coord_cartesian to set axis limits to zoom in on percentages
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, 
                                   hjust = 0.5), 
        axis.text = element_text(color = "black",
                                 size = 12), 
        axis.title = element_text(color = "black",
                                  face = "bold",
                                  size = 14),
        axis.title.x.top = element_text(margin = unit(c(0,0,10,0), units = "mm")),
        axis.title.y = element_text(margin = unit(c(0,10,0,0), units = "mm")),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5,
                                  face = "bold",
                                  color = "black",
                                  size = 16,
                                  margin = margin(0,0,10,0, "mm")),
        legend.box.spacing = margin(30),
        legend.justification = "top", # put legend in top right of plot
        legend.text = element_text(color = "black",
                                   size = 12),
        legend.title = element_text(color = "black",
                                    face = "bold",
                                    size = 14),
        axis.text.y = element_text(vjust = 0.5))
justify_sole_cancer_prevalence_barchart_horiz
```

# **Drawing Clustered Heatmaps** {#heatmaps}

$~$

Next, I drew clustered heatmaps for mutation types and positions vs. cancers or no cancer, ages, or sexes. In all cases I have at least clustered cancers and ages, while I have also clustered mutation categories when depicted. I have not clustered mutated positions to preserve numeric order and p53 domains, and they would cluster at hotspots first anyways followed by more dispersed arrangements.

```{r complexheatmap-multcancerpos, fig.height = 6, fig.width = 26, eval = FALSE, include = FALSE}
# x <- scale(x) # scale and center columns
# x <- t(scale(t(x))) # scale and center rows

complexhm_multcancerpos <- ComplexHeatmap::Heatmap(t(scale(t(multcancerpos_matrix_ordered))),
                                                   # multcancerpos_matrix_ordered,
                                                   # col = origdb_color,
                                                   col = circlize::colorRamp2(c(plyr::round_any(min(t(scale(t(multcancerpos_matrix_ordered))), na.rm = TRUE), 0.1, f = floor),
                                                                                0,
                                                                                plyr::round_any(max(t(scale(t(multcancerpos_matrix_ordered))), na.rm = TRUE), 0.1, f = ceiling)),
                                                                              c("blue", 
                                                                                "white",
                                                                                "red")),
                                                   name = "Row Z-Score",
                                                   # name = "Proportion",
                                                   na_col = "white",
                                                   row_names_side = "left",
                                                   column_names_side = "top",
                                                   row_dend_side = "left",
                                                   column_dend_side = "top",
                                                   clustering_distance_rows = "euclidean",
                                                   clustering_method_rows = "complete",
                                                   clustering_distance_columns = "euclidean",
                                                   clustering_method_columns = "complete",
                                                   # cluster_columns = FALSE,
                                                   column_title = "# distinct individuals/# total distinct individuals, ≥ 1% proportion",
                                                   column_title_side = "top",
                                                   column_title_gp = gpar(fontface = "bold"),
                                                   row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10),
                                                   row_names_max_width = max_text_width(rownames(multcancerpos_matrix_ordered), 
                                                                                        gp = gpar(fontsize = 10)),
                                                   column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10),
                                                   top_annotation = column_ha_mult,
                                                   left_annotation = row_ha_mult,
                                                   heatmap_legend_param = list(at = c( plyr::round_any(min(t(scale(t(multcancerpos_matrix_ordered))), na.rm = TRUE), 0.1, f = floor),
                                                                                       0,
                                                                                       plyr::round_any(max(t(scale(t(multcancerpos_matrix_ordered))), na.rm = TRUE), 0.1, f = ceiling))
                                                                               
                                                   ))
draw(complexhm_multcancerpos,
     heatmap_legend_side = "bottom",
     annotation_legend_side = "bottom",
     legend_grouping = "original",
     merge_legend = TRUE)
```

```{r complexheatmap-ACC-mult-sex-pos, message = FALSE, results = 'hide', fig.height = 4.9, fig.width = 7.9, eval = FALSE, include = FALSE}
# make matrix for complexheatmap
ACC_mult_sex_pos_matrix <- ACC_mult_sex_pos_pivot_melted %>% 
  reshape2::acast(Sex ~ Mutation, 
                  value.var = 'Proportion', 
                  fill = '0')
class(ACC_mult_sex_pos_matrix) <- "numeric"

# get annotations of domain and residue function
ACC_mult_sex_pos_info_annotate <- multcancermutinfo %>% 
  subset(ProtDescription %in% ACC_mult_sex_pos_pivot_melted$Mutation) %>%
  dplyr::select(-c(Codon_number, 
                   ProtDescription, 
                   Domain_function))

# define domains and residue functions as factors to order them properly in complexheatmap
unique(ACC_mult_sex_pos_info_annotate$Domain) #to find list of domains in order to use as factors
ACC_mult_sex_pos_info_annotate$Domain <- factor(ACC_mult_sex_pos_info_annotate$Domain, 
                                                levels = c("DBD", 
                                                           "DBD L1 loop", 
                                                           "DBD L2 loop", 
                                                           "DBD L3 loop", 
                                                           "OD", 
                                                           "NA"))

sort(as.vector(unique(ACC_mult_sex_pos_info_annotate$Residue_function))) #to find list of residue functions in order to use as factors
ACC_mult_sex_pos_info_annotate$Residue_function <- factor(ACC_mult_sex_pos_info_annotate$Residue_function, 
                                                          levels = c("Buried", 
                                                                     "DNA binding", 
                                                                     "Partially exposed", 
                                                                     "Ubiquitination site",
                                                                     "NA"))

ACC_mult_sex_pos_info_annotate$Rescuable <- factor(ACC_mult_sex_pos_info_annotate$Rescuable, 
                                                 levels = sort(as.vector(unique(ACC_mult_sex_pos_info_annotate$Rescuable)),
                                                               decreasing = TRUE))

ACC_mult_sex_pos_info_annotate$SIFTClass <- factor(ACC_mult_sex_pos_info_annotate$SIFTClass,
                                                   levels = c("Damaging",
                                                              "Tolerated",
                                                              "NA"))

ACC_mult_sex_pos_info_annotate$DNE_LOFclass <- factor(ACC_mult_sex_pos_info_annotate$DNE_LOFclass,
                                                      levels = c("DNE_LOF",   
                                                                 "notDNE_LOF",
                                                                 "notDNE_notLOF",
                                                                 "NA"))


# create named annotations with colors for complexheatmap, rcolorbrewer numbers may not be right but doesn't matter as the named vector is what colors actually are assigned to what annotations
# annotationcolorACCmultsexpos <- list(Domain = longercolorSet2, 
#                                      Residue_function = RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(n = 12, name = "Paired"),
#                                      Rescuable = c("forestgreen", "ivory2"),
#                                      SIFTClass = c("hotpink3", "aliceblue", "dimgray"),
#                                      DNE_LOFclass = c("maroon", "sienna1", "slategray1", "darkslategray"))
annotationcolornamedACCmultsexpos <- list(
  Domain = c(DBD = "#FFD92F",
             `DBD L1 loop` = "#FC8D62", 
             `DBD L2 loop` = "#8DA0CB", 
             `DBD L3 loop` = "brown",
             OD = "#D3D3D3",
             `NA` = "black"), 
  Residue_function = c(Buried = "#FF10F0", 
                       `DNA binding` = "#6A3D9A", 
                       `Partially exposed` = "#A6CEE3", 
                       `Ubiquitination site` = "lightpink",
                       `NA` = "#5A5A5A"),
  Rescuable = c(`Rescuable by ATO` = "forestgreen",
              `Not documented` = "ivory2"),
  SIFTClass = c(`Damaging` = "hotpink3", 
                `Tolerated` = "aliceblue",
                `NA` = "dimgray"),
  DNE_LOFclass = c(`DNE_LOF` = "maroon",    
                   `notDNE_LOF` = "sienna1",
                   `notDNE_notLOF` = "slategray1",
                   `NA` = "darkslategray"))

# order matrix for complexheatmap based on annotations for codon
ACC_mult_sex_pos_matrix_ordered <- ACC_mult_sex_pos_matrix[,rownames(ACC_mult_sex_pos_info_annotate)]

# create heatmap annotation object for columns i.e. codons
column_ha_ACCmultsexpos <- ComplexHeatmap::columnAnnotation(df = ACC_mult_sex_pos_info_annotate, 
                                                            col = annotationcolornamedACCmultsexpos, 
                                                            annotation_label = c("Domain", "Feature", "SIFT", "DNE", "Rescuable"), 
                                                            na_col = "white", 
                                                            show_annotation_name = TRUE, 
                                                            annotation_name_side = c("left", "left", "left", "left", "left"), 
                                                            annotation_name_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10,
                                                                                      fontface = "bold"))

# make complexheatmap with mut annotations
# x <- scale(x) # scale and center columns
# x <- t(scale(t(x))) # scale and center rows

complexhm_ACC_mult_sex_pos <- ComplexHeatmap::Heatmap(t(scale(t(ACC_mult_sex_pos_matrix_ordered))),
                                                      # ACC_mult_sex_pos_matrix_ordered,
                                                      # col = origdb_color,
                                                      col = circlize::colorRamp2(c(plyr::round_any(min(t(scale(t(ACC_mult_sex_pos_matrix_ordered))), na.rm = TRUE), 0.1, f = floor),
                                                                                   0,
                                                                                   plyr::round_any(max(t(scale(t(ACC_mult_sex_pos_matrix_ordered))), na.rm = TRUE), 0.1, f = ceiling)),
                                                                                 c("blue",
                                                                                   "white",
                                                                                   "red")),
                                                      name = "Row Z-Score",
                                                      # name = "Proportion",
                                                      na_col = "white",
                                                      row_names_side = "left",
                                                      column_names_side = "top",
                                                      row_dend_side = "left",
                                                      column_dend_side = "top",
                                                      clustering_distance_rows = "euclidean",
                                                      clustering_method_rows = "complete",
                                                      clustering_distance_columns = "euclidean",
                                                      clustering_method_columns = "complete",
                                                      # cluster_columns = FALSE,
                                                      cluster_rows = FALSE,
                                                      column_title = "# distinct individuals/# total distinct individuals, ≥ 1% proportion",
                                                      column_title_side = "top",
                                                      column_title_gp = gpar(fontface = "bold"),
                                                      row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10),
                                                      row_names_max_width = max_text_width(rownames(ACC_mult_sex_pos_matrix_ordered), 
                                                                                           gp = gpar(fontsize = 10)),
                                                      column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10),
                                                      top_annotation = column_ha_ACCmultsexpos,
                                                      heatmap_legend_param = list(at = c( plyr::round_any(min(t(scale(t(ACC_mult_sex_pos_matrix_ordered))), na.rm = TRUE), 0.1, f = floor),
                                                                                          0,
                                                                                          plyr::round_any(max(t(scale(t(ACC_mult_sex_pos_matrix_ordered))), na.rm = TRUE), 0.1, f = ceiling)))
)
draw(complexhm_ACC_mult_sex_pos,
     heatmap_legend_side = "bottom",
     annotation_legend_side = "bottom",
     legend_grouping = "original",
     merge_legend = TRUE)
```

```{r complexheatmap-ACC-sole-sex-pos, message = FALSE, results = 'hide', fig.height = 4.3, fig.width = 14, include = FALSE}
# make matrix for complexheatmap
```

```{r complexheatmap-ACC-mult-agestrata-pos, message = FALSE, results = 'hide', fig.height = 5.1, fig.width = 7.9, eval = FALSE, include = FALSE}
                  fill = '0')
class(ACC_mult_agestrata_pos_matrix) <- "numeric"

# get annotations of domain and residue function
ACC_mult_agestrata_pos_info_annotate <- multcancermutinfo %>% 
  subset(ProtDescription %in% ACC_mult_agestrata_pos_pivot_melted$Mutation) %>%
  dplyr::select(-c(Codon_number, 
                   ProtDescription, 
                   Domain_function))

# define domains and residue functions as factors to order them properly in complexheatmap
unique(ACC_mult_agestrata_pos_info_annotate$Domain) #to find list of domains in order to use as factors
ACC_mult_agestrata_pos_info_annotate$Domain <- factor(ACC_mult_agestrata_pos_info_annotate$Domain, 
                                                      levels = c("DBD", 
                                                                 "DBD L1 loop", 
                                                                 "DBD L2 loop", 
                                                                 "DBD L3 loop", 
                                                                 "OD", 
                                                                 "NA"))

sort(as.vector(unique(ACC_mult_agestrata_pos_info_annotate$Residue_function))) #to find list of residue functions in order to use as factors
ACC_mult_agestrata_pos_info_annotate$Residue_function <- factor(ACC_mult_agestrata_pos_info_annotate$Residue_function, 
                                                                levels = c("Buried", 
                                                                           "DNA binding", 
                                                                           "Partially exposed", 
                                                                           "Ubiquitination site",
                                                                           "NA"))

ACC_mult_agestrata_pos_info_annotate$Rescuable <- factor(ACC_mult_agestrata_pos_info_annotate$Rescuable, 
                                                       levels = sort(as.vector(unique(ACC_mult_agestrata_pos_info_annotate$Rescuable)),
                                                                     decreasing = TRUE))

ACC_mult_agestrata_pos_info_annotate$SIFTClass <- factor(ACC_mult_agestrata_pos_info_annotate$SIFTClass,
                                                         levels = c("Damaging",

ACC_mult_agestrata_pos_info_annotate$DNE_LOFclass <- factor(ACC_mult_agestrata_pos_info_annotate$DNE_LOFclass,

                                                                       "notDNE_notLOF",
                                                                       "NA"))

# create named annotations with colors for complexheatmap, rcolorbrewer numbers may not be right but doesn't matter as the named vector is what colors actually are assigned to what annotations

annotationcolornamedACCmultagestratapos <- list(
  Domain = c(DBD = "#FFD92F",
             `DBD L1 loop` = "#FC8D62", 
             `DBD L2 loop` = "#8DA0CB", 
             `DBD L3 loop` = "brown",
             OD = "#D3D3D3",
             `NA` = "black"), 
  Residue_function = c(Buried = "#FF10F0", 
                       `DNA binding` = "#6A3D9A", 
                       `Partially exposed` = "#A6CEE3", 
                       `Ubiquitination site` = "lightpink",
                       `NA` = "#5A5A5A"),
  Rescuable = c(`Rescuable by ATO` = "forestgreen",
              `Not documented` = "ivory2"),
  SIFTClass = c(`Damaging` = "hotpink3", 
                `Tolerated` = "aliceblue",
                `NA` = "dimgray"),
  DNE_LOFclass = c(`DNE_LOF` = "maroon",    
                   `notDNE_LOF` = "sienna1",
                   `notDNE_notLOF` = "slategray1",
                   `NA` = "darkslategray"))

                                                                  col = annotationcolornamedACCmultagestratapos, 
                                                                  annotation_label = c("Domain", "Feature", "SIFT", "DNE", "Rescuable"), 
                                                                  na_col = "white", 
                                                                  show_annotation_name = TRUE, 
                                                                  annotation_name_side = c("left", "left", "left", "left", "left"),

                                                                                            fontface = "bold"))

# make complexheatmap with mut annotations

                                                            # ACC_mult_agestrata_pos_matrix_ordered,
                                                            # col = origdb_color,
                                                            col = circlize::colorRamp2(c(plyr::round_any(min(t(scale(t(ACC_mult_agestrata_pos_matrix_ordered))), na.rm = TRUE), 0.1, f = floor),
                                                                                         0,

                                                                                       c("blue",
                                                                                         "white",
                                                                                         "red")),
                                                            name = "Row Z-Score",
                                                            # name = "Proportion",
                                                            na_col = "white",
                                                            row_names_side = "left",
                                                            column_names_side = "top",
                                                            row_dend_side = "left",
                                                            column_dend_side = "top",
                                                            clustering_distance_rows = "euclidean",
                                                            clustering_method_rows = "complete",
                                                            clustering_distance_columns = "euclidean",
                                                            clustering_method_columns = "complete",
                                                            # cluster_columns = FALSE,
                                                            column_title = "# distinct individuals/# total distinct individuals, ≥ 1% proportion",
                                                            column_title_side = "top",
                                                            column_title_gp = gpar(fontface = "bold"),
                                                            row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10),
                                                            row_names_max_width = max_text_width(rownames(ACC_mult_agestrata_pos_matrix_ordered), 
                                                                                                 gp = gpar(fontsize = 10)),
                                                            column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10),
                                                            top_annotation = column_ha_ACCmultagestratapos,
                                                            heatmap_legend_param = list(at = c( plyr::round_any(min(t(scale(t(ACC_mult_agestrata_pos_matrix_ordered))), na.rm = TRUE), 0.1, f = floor),
                                                                                                0,
                                                                                                plyr::round_any(max(t(scale(t(ACC_mult_agestrata_pos_matrix_ordered))), na.rm = TRUE), 0.1, f = ceiling)))
)
draw(complexhm_ACC_mult_agestrata_pos,
```

```{r complexheatmap-brain-sole-sex-pos, message = FALSE, results = 'hide', fig.height = 4.4, fig.width = 9.5, include = FALSE}
brain_sole_sex_pos_info_annotate$SIFTClass <- factor(brain_sole_sex_pos_info_annotate$SIFTClass,

brain_sole_sex_pos_info_annotate$DNE_LOFclass <- factor(brain_sole_sex_pos_info_annotate$DNE_LOFclass,

             HD = "#A6D854", 
             OD = "#D3D3D3",
             `NA` = "black"), 
  Residue_function = c(Buried = "#FF10F0", 
                       `DNA binding` = "#6A3D9A", 
                       Exposed = "#1F78B4",
                       `Partially exposed` = "#A6CEE3", 
                       `Zn binding` = "#E30B5C", 
                       `NA` = "#5A5A5A"),
  Rescuable = c(`Rescuable by ATO` = "forestgreen",

  SIFTClass = c(`Damaging` = "hotpink3", 
                `Tolerated` = "aliceblue",
                `NA` = "dimgray"),
  DNE_LOFclass = c(`DNE_LOF` = "maroon",

                                                                                     0,

                                                        column_dend_side = "top",

                                                        clustering_method_columns = "complete",

                                                        cluster_rows = FALSE,
                                                        column_title = "# distinct individuals/# total distinct individuals, ≥ 1% proportion",
                                                        column_title_side = "top",
                                                        column_title_gp = gpar(fontface = "bold"),
                                                        row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10),
                                                        row_names_max_width = max_text_width(rownames(brain_sole_sex_pos_matrix_ordered),

                                                        heatmap_legend_param = list(at = c( plyr::round_any(min(t(scale(t(brain_sole_sex_pos_matrix_ordered))), na.rm = TRUE), 0.1, f = floor),
                                                                                            0,
                                                                                            plyr::round_any(max(t(scale(t(brain_sole_sex_pos_matrix_ordered))), na.rm = TRUE), 0.1, f = ceiling)))
)
draw(complexhm_brain_sole_sex_pos,
```

```{r complexheatmap-softtissues-mult-sex-pos, message = FALSE, results = 'hide', fig.height = 4.45, fig.width = 12.05, eval = FALSE, include = FALSE}
# make matrix for complexheatmap
softtissues_mult_sex_pos_matrix <- softtissues_mult_sex_pos_pivot_melted %>% 
  reshape2::acast(Sex ~ Mutation, 
                  value.var = 'Proportion', 
                  fill = '0')
class(softtissues_mult_sex_pos_matrix) <- "numeric"

# get annotations of domain and residue function
softtissues_mult_sex_pos_info_annotate <- multcancermutinfo %>% 
  subset(ProtDescription %in% softtissues_mult_sex_pos_pivot_melted$Mutation) %>%
  dplyr::select(-c(Codon_number, 
                   ProtDescription, 
                   Domain_function))

# define domains and residue functions as factors to order them properly in complexheatmap
unique(softtissues_mult_sex_pos_info_annotate$Domain) #to find list of domains in order to use as factors
softtissues_mult_sex_pos_info_annotate$Domain <- factor(softtissues_mult_sex_pos_info_annotate$Domain, 
                                                        levels = c("PRD",
                                                                   "DBD",  
                                                                   "DBD L2 loop", 
                                                                   "DBD L3 loop", 
                                                                   "HD",
                                                                   "OD", 
                                                                   "NA"))

sort(as.vector(unique(softtissues_mult_sex_pos_info_annotate$Residue_function))) #to find list of residue functions in order to use as factors
softtissues_mult_sex_pos_info_annotate$Residue_function <- factor(softtissues_mult_sex_pos_info_annotate$Residue_function, 
                                                                  levels = c("Buried", 
                                                                             "DNA binding", 
                                                                             "Exposed",
                                                                             "Partially exposed", 
                                                                             "Phosphorylation site",
                                                                             "S-glutathionylation site",
                                                                             "Tetramerisation",
                                                                             "Ubiquitination site",
                                                                             "Zn binding",
                                                                             "NA"))

softtissues_mult_sex_pos_info_annotate$Rescuable <- factor(softtissues_mult_sex_pos_info_annotate$Rescuable, 
                                                         levels = sort(as.vector(unique(softtissues_mult_sex_pos_info_annotate$Rescuable)),
                                                                       decreasing = TRUE))

softtissues_mult_sex_pos_info_annotate$SIFTClass <- factor(softtissues_mult_sex_pos_info_annotate$SIFTClass,
                                                           levels = c("Damaging",
                                                                      "Tolerated",
                                                                      "NA"))

softtissues_mult_sex_pos_info_annotate$DNE_LOFclass <- factor(softtissues_mult_sex_pos_info_annotate$DNE_LOFclass,
                                                              levels = c("DNE_LOF",   
                                                                         "notDNE_LOF",
                                                                         "notDNE_notLOF",
                                                                         "unclass.",
                                                                         "NA"))

# create named annotations with colors for complexheatmap, rcolorbrewer numbers may not be right but doesn't matter as the named vector is what colors actually are assigned to what annotations
# annotationcolorsofttissuesmultsexpos <- list(Domain = longercolorSet2, 
#                                              Residue_function = RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(n = 12, name = "Paired"),
#                                              Rescuable = c("forestgreen", "ivory2"),
#                                              SIFTClass = c("hotpink3", "aliceblue", "dimgray"),
#                                              DNE_LOFclass = c("maroon", "sienna1", "slategray1", "linen", "darkslategray"))
annotationcolornamedsofttissuesmultsexpos <- list(
  Domain = c(PRD = "#E78AC3",
             DBD = "#FFD92F", 
             `DBD L2 loop` = "#8DA0CB", 
             `DBD L3 loop` = "brown",
             HD = "#A6D854", 
             OD = "#D3D3D3",
             `NA` = "black"), 
  Residue_function = c(Buried = "#FF10F0", 
                       `DNA binding` = "#6A3D9A", 
                       Exposed = "#1F78B4", 
                       `Partially exposed` = "#A6CEE3", 
                       `Phosphorylation site` = "#33A02C", 
                       `S-glutathionylation site` = "#B2DF8A", 
                       Tetramerisation = "#8B8000", 
                       `Ubiquitination site` = "lightpink",
                       `Zn binding` = "#E30B5C", 
                       `NA` = "#5A5A5A"),
  Rescuable = c(`Rescuable by ATO` = "forestgreen",
              `Not documented` = "ivory2"),
  SIFTClass = c(`Damaging` = "hotpink3", 
                `Tolerated` = "aliceblue",
                `NA` = "dimgray"),
  DNE_LOFclass = c(`DNE_LOF` = "maroon",    
                   `notDNE_LOF` = "sienna1",
                   `notDNE_notLOF` = "slategray1",
                   `unclass.` = "linen",
                   `NA` = "darkslategray"))

# order matrix for complexheatmap based on annotations for codon
softtissues_mult_sex_pos_matrix_ordered <- softtissues_mult_sex_pos_matrix[,rownames(softtissues_mult_sex_pos_info_annotate)]

# create heatmap annotation object for columns i.e. codons
column_ha_softtissuesmultsexpos <- ComplexHeatmap::columnAnnotation(df = softtissues_mult_sex_pos_info_annotate, 
                                                                    col = annotationcolornamedsofttissuesmultsexpos, 
                                                                    annotation_label = c("Domain", "Feature", "SIFT", "DNE", "Rescuable"), 
                                                                    na_col = "white", 
                                                                    show_annotation_name = TRUE, 
                                                                    annotation_name_side = c("left", "left", "left", "left", "left"), 
                                                                    annotation_name_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10,
                                                                                              fontface = "bold"),
                                                                    annotation_legend_param = list(Domain = list(direction = "horizontal",
                                                                                                                 ncol = 2),
                                                                                                   Residue_function = list(direction = "horizontal",
                                                                                                                           ncol = 2),
                                                                                                   
                                                                                                   DNE_LOFclass = list(direction = "horizontal",
                                                                                                                       ncol = 2)))

# make complexheatmap with mut annotations
# x <- scale(x) # scale and center columns
# x <- t(scale(t(x))) # scale and center rows

complexhm_softtissues_mult_sex_pos <- ComplexHeatmap::Heatmap(t(scale(t(softtissues_mult_sex_pos_matrix_ordered))),
                                                              # softtissues_mult_sex_pos_matrix_ordered,
                                                              # col = origdb_color,
                                                              col = circlize::colorRamp2(c(plyr::round_any(min(t(scale(t(softtissues_mult_sex_pos_matrix_ordered))), na.rm = TRUE), 0.1, f = floor),
                                                                                           0,
                                                                                           plyr::round_any(max(t(scale(t(softtissues_mult_sex_pos_matrix_ordered))), na.rm = TRUE), 0.1, f = ceiling)),
                                                                                         c("blue",
                                                                                           "white",
                                                                                           "red")),
                                                              name = "Row Z-Score",
                                                              # name = "Proportion",
                                                              na_col = "white",
                                                              row_names_side = "left",
                                                              column_names_side = "top",
                                                              row_dend_side = "left",
                                                              column_dend_side = "top",
                                                              clustering_distance_rows = "euclidean",
                                                              clustering_method_rows = "complete",
                                                              clustering_distance_columns = "euclidean",
                                                              clustering_method_columns = "complete",
                                                              # cluster_columns = FALSE,
                                                              cluster_rows = FALSE,
                                                              column_title = "# distinct individuals/# total distinct individuals, ≥ 1% proportion",
                                                              column_title_side = "top",
                                                              column_title_gp = gpar(fontface = "bold"),
                                                              row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10),
                                                              row_names_max_width = max_text_width(rownames(softtissues_mult_sex_pos_matrix_ordered), 
                                                                                                   gp = gpar(fontsize = 10)),
                                                              column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10),
                                                              top_annotation = column_ha_softtissuesmultsexpos,
                                                              heatmap_legend_param = list(at = c( plyr::round_any(min(t(scale(t(softtissues_mult_sex_pos_matrix_ordered))), na.rm = TRUE), 0.1, f = floor),
                                                                                                  0,
                                                                                                  plyr::round_any(max(t(scale(t(softtissues_mult_sex_pos_matrix_ordered))), na.rm = TRUE), 0.1, f = ceiling)))
)
draw(complexhm_softtissues_mult_sex_pos,
     heatmap_legend_side = "bottom",
```

```{r complexheatmap-softtissues-sole-agestrata-pos, message = FALSE, results = 'hide', fig.height = 4.9, fig.width = 10.5, include = FALSE}
# make matrix for complexheatmap
softtissues_sole_agestrata_pos_matrix <- softtissues_sole_agestrata_pos_pivot_melted %>% 
  reshape2::acast(Age ~ Mutation, 
                  value.var = 'Proportion', 
                  fill = '0')
class(softtissues_sole_agestrata_pos_matrix) <- "numeric"

# get annotations of domain and residue function
softtissues_sole_agestrata_pos_info_annotate <- solecancermutinfo %>% 
  subset(ProtDescription %in% softtissues_sole_agestrata_pos_pivot_melted$Mutation) %>%
  dplyr::select(-c(Codon_number, 
                   ProtDescription, 
                   Domain_function))

# define domains and residue functions as factors to order them properly in complexheatmap
unique(softtissues_sole_agestrata_pos_info_annotate$Domain) #to find list of domains in order to use as factors
softtissues_sole_agestrata_pos_info_annotate$Domain <- factor(softtissues_sole_agestrata_pos_info_annotate$Domain, 
                                                              levels = c("DBD",  
                                                                         "DBD L2 loop", 
                                                                         "DBD L3 loop", 
                                                                         "HD",
                                                                         "OD", 
                                                                         "CTD",
                                                                         "NA"))

sort(as.vector(unique(softtissues_sole_agestrata_pos_info_annotate$Residue_function))) #to find list of residue functions in order to use as factors
softtissues_sole_agestrata_pos_info_annotate$Residue_function <- factor(softtissues_sole_agestrata_pos_info_annotate$Residue_function, 
                                                                        levels = c("Buried", 
                                                                                   "DNA binding", 
                                                                                   "Exposed",
                                                                                   "Partially exposed", 
                                                                                   "Zn binding",
                                                                                   "NA"))

softtissues_sole_agestrata_pos_info_annotate$Rescuable <- factor(softtissues_sole_agestrata_pos_info_annotate$Rescuable, 
                                                               levels = sort(as.vector(unique(softtissues_sole_agestrata_pos_info_annotate$Rescuable)),
                                                                             decreasing = TRUE))

softtissues_sole_agestrata_pos_info_annotate$SIFTClass <- factor(softtissues_sole_agestrata_pos_info_annotate$SIFTClass,
                                                                 levels = c("Damaging",
                                                                            "Tolerated",
                                                                            "NA"))

softtissues_sole_agestrata_pos_info_annotate$DNE_LOFclass <- factor(softtissues_sole_agestrata_pos_info_annotate$DNE_LOFclass,
                                                                    levels = c("DNE_LOF",   
                                                                               "notDNE_LOF",
                                                                               "notDNE_notLOF",
                                                                               "unclass.",
                                                                               "NA"))

# create named annotations with colors for complexheatmap, rcolorbrewer numbers may not be right but doesn't matter as the named vector is what colors actually are assigned to what annotations
# annotationcolorsofttissuessoleagestratapos <- list(Domain = longercolorSet2, 
#                                                    Residue_function = RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(n = 12, name = "Paired"),
#                                                    Rescuable = c("forestgreen", "ivory2"),
#                                                    SIFTClass = c("hotpink3", "aliceblue", "dimgray"),
#                                                    DNE_LOFclass = c("maroon", "sienna1", "slategray1", "linen", "darkslategray"))
annotationcolornamedsofttissuessoleagestratapos <- list(
  Domain = c(DBD = "#FFD92F",
             `DBD L2 loop` = "#8DA0CB", 
             `DBD L3 loop` = "brown",
             HD = "#A6D854", 
             OD = "#D3D3D3",
             CTD = "red",
             `NA` = "black"), 
  Residue_function = c(Buried = "#FF10F0", 
                       `DNA binding` = "#6A3D9A", 
                       Exposed = "#1F78B4",
                       `Partially exposed` = "#A6CEE3", 
                       `Zn binding` = "#E30B5C", 
                       `NA` = "#5A5A5A"),
  Rescuable = c(`Rescuable by ATO` = "forestgreen",
              `Not documented` = "ivory2"),
  SIFTClass = c(`Damaging` = "hotpink3", 
                `Tolerated` = "aliceblue",
                `NA` = "dimgray"),
  DNE_LOFclass = c(`DNE_LOF` = "maroon",    
                   `notDNE_LOF` = "sienna1",
                   `notDNE_notLOF` = "slategray1",
                   `unclass.` = "linen",
                   `NA` = "darkslategray"))

# order matrix for complexheatmap based on annotations for codon
softtissues_sole_agestrata_pos_matrix_ordered <- softtissues_sole_agestrata_pos_matrix[,rownames(softtissues_sole_agestrata_pos_info_annotate)]

# create heatmap annotation object for columns i.e. codons
column_ha_softtissuessoleagestratapos <- ComplexHeatmap::columnAnnotation(df = softtissues_sole_agestrata_pos_info_annotate, 
                                                                          col = annotationcolornamedsofttissuessoleagestratapos, 
                                                                          annotation_label = c("Domain", "Feature", "SIFT", "DNE", "Rescuable"), 
                                                                          na_col = "white", 
                                                                          show_annotation_name = TRUE, 
                                                                          annotation_name_side = c("left", "left", "left", "left", "left"), 
                                                                          annotation_name_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10,
                                                                                                    fontface = "bold"),
                                                                          annotation_legend_param = list(Domain = list(direction = "horizontal",
                                                                                                                       ncol = 2),
                                                                                                         Residue_function = list(direction = "horizontal",
                                                                                                                                 ncol = 2),
                                                                                                         
                                                                                                         DNE_LOFclass = list(direction = "horizontal",
                                                                                                                             ncol = 2)))

# make complexheatmap with mut annotations
# x <- scale(x) # scale and center columns
# x <- t(scale(t(x))) # scale and center rows

complexhm_softtissues_sole_agestrata_pos <- ComplexHeatmap::Heatmap(t(scale(t(softtissues_sole_agestrata_pos_matrix_ordered))),
                                                                    # softtissues_sole_agestrata_pos_matrix_ordered,
                                                                    # col = origdb_color,
                                                                    col = circlize::colorRamp2(c(plyr::round_any(min(t(scale(t(softtissues_sole_agestrata_pos_matrix_ordered))), na.rm = TRUE), 0.1, f = floor),
                                                                                                 0,
                                                                                                 plyr::round_any(max(t(scale(t(softtissues_sole_agestrata_pos_matrix_ordered))), na.rm = TRUE), 0.1, f = ceiling)),
                                                                                               c("blue",
                                                                                                 "white",
                                                                                                 "red")),
                                                                    name = "Row Z-Score",
                                                                    # name = "Proportion",
                                                                    na_col = "white",
                                                                    row_names_side = "left",
                                                                    column_names_side = "top",
                                                                    row_dend_side = "left",
                                                                    column_dend_side = "top",
                                                                    clustering_distance_rows = "euclidean",
                                                                    clustering_method_rows = "complete",
                                                                    clustering_distance_columns = "euclidean",
                                                                    clustering_method_columns = "complete",
                                                                    # cluster_columns = FALSE,
                                                                    column_title = "# distinct individuals/# total distinct individuals, ≥ 1% proportion",
                                                                    column_title_side = "top",
                                                                    column_title_gp = gpar(fontface = "bold"),
                                                                    row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10),
                                                                    row_names_max_width = max_text_width(rownames(softtissues_sole_agestrata_pos_matrix_ordered), 
                                                                                                         gp = gpar(fontsize = 10)),
                                                                    column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10),
                                                                    top_annotation = column_ha_softtissuessoleagestratapos,
                                                                    heatmap_legend_param = list(at = c( plyr::round_any(min(t(scale(t(softtissues_sole_agestrata_pos_matrix_ordered))), na.rm = TRUE), 0.1, f = floor),
                                                                                                        0,

)
```

```{r multivariateGLM, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, results = 'hide', fig.show = 'asis', fig.width = 25, fig.height = 6}
# see if age, sex, cancer, or other variables could explain different mutational profiles seen in heatmaps
# to do this, need multivariate analysis incorporating these variables into GLM to see what is independently associated with mutations

# first need hierarchical clustering of mutations scaled data in heatmap to identify clusters
ACC_sole_agestrata_pos_hclust <- stats::hclust(dist(scale(t(ACC_sole_agestrata_pos_matrix_ordered)), # for muts as rows
                                                    method = "euclidean"),
                                               method = "complete")
plot(as.dendrogram(ACC_sole_agestrata_pos_hclust),
     ylim = c(0, plyr::round_any(max(ACC_sole_agestrata_pos_hclust$height), 1, f = ceiling)))
height_to_cut <- 3.5
abline(h = height_to_cut,
       col = "red",
       lty = 2,
       lwd = 2)

ACC_sole_agestrata_pos_clusters <- stats::cutree(ACC_sole_agestrata_pos_hclust, 
                                                 h = height_to_cut) # height to cut at for the clusters you visually think are best, if want to define number of clusters do k = # but bear in mind this is based on the clusters achieved from uniform height, not what you think the end result clusters are at the bottom

# color code clusters and add cluster group numbers to dendrogram
clust_cutree <- dendextend:::cutree(as.dendrogram(ACC_sole_agestrata_pos_hclust), 
                                    k = max(ACC_sole_agestrata_pos_clusters), 
                                    order_clusters_as_data = FALSE)
idx <- order(names(clust_cutree))
clust_cutree <- clust_cutree[idx]
df_merge <- merge(ACC_sole_agestrata_pos_clusters,
                  clust_cutree,
                  by = 'row.names')
df_merge_sorted <- df_merge[order(df_merge$y),]
lbls <- unique(df_merge_sorted$x)
plot(dendextend::color_branches(as.dendrogram(ACC_sole_agestrata_pos_hclust) %>% 
                                  dendextend::set("labels_cex", 
                                                  1.1) %>%
                                  dendextend::set("labels_col",
                                                  k = length(lbls)) %>%
                                  dendextend::set("branches_lwd",
                                                  2), 
                                k = max(ACC_sole_agestrata_pos_clusters), 
                                groupLabels = lbls,
                                cex = 10),
     ylim = c(0, plyr::round_any(max(ACC_sole_agestrata_pos_hclust$height), 1, f = ceiling)))





ACC_sole_sex_pos_hclust <- stats::hclust(dist(scale(t(ACC_sole_sex_pos_matrix_ordered)), # for muts as rows
                                              method = "euclidean"),

# summary(ACC_sole_sex_pos_lm)

ACC_sole_agestrata_pos_lm <- nnet::multinom(formula = Age_vs_mut_cluster ~ Age_stratum + Sex + Population + Region + SIFTClass + DNE_LOFclass + Effect + Domain + Residue_function + Rescuable,
                                            data = origdb_allACC_sole_pts_forGLM %>%
                                              drop_na(Age_vs_mut_cluster,
                                                      Age_stratum,
                                                      Sex,
                                                      Population,
                                                      Region,
                                                      SIFTClass,
                                                      DNE_LOFclass,
                                                      Effect,
                                                      Domain,
                                                      Residue_function,
                                                      Rescuable)
)
summary(ACC_sole_agestrata_pos_lm)
MASS::dropterm(ACC_sole_agestrata_pos_lm, 
               trace = FALSE, 
               test = "Chisq")

ACC_sole_sex_pos_lm <- nnet::multinom(formula = Sex_vs_mut_cluster ~ Age_stratum + Sex + Population + Region + SIFTClass + DNE_LOFclass + Effect + Domain + Residue_function + Rescuable,
```

```{r jaccard-ACC-sole-agestrata-pos, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, results = "hide", fig.width = 7.25, fig.height = 5.5, include = FALSE}
# calc jaccard similarity for all 1:ideal clusters' stabilities
bootres_all <- lapply(1:as.numeric(silhouette_ACC_sole_agestrata_pos$data$clusters[which.max(silhouette_ACC_sole_agestrata_pos$data$y)]),
                      FUN = function(x) clusterboot(scale(t(ACC_sole_agestrata_pos_matrix_ordered)), 
                                                    clustermethod = hclustCBI,
                                                    scaling = FALSE, # data already provided as scaled so don't need to rescale
                                                    method = "complete", 
                                                    k = x,
```

```{r jaccard-solecancersex-pos, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, results = "hide", fig.width = 8.5, fig.height = 5.5, include = FALSE}
# # plot jaccard similarity to assess cluster stability
# bootres <- clusterboot(scale(t(solecancersex_pos_matrix_ordered)), 
#                        clustermethod = hclustCBI,
#                        scaling = FALSE, # data already provided as scaled so don't need to rescale
#                        method = "complete", 
#                        k = max(solecancersex_pos_clusters), 
#                        seed = 1212,
#                        count = FALSE)
# 
# barplot(bootres$bootmean, 
#         ylim = c(0, 1),
#         names.arg = c(1:max(solecancersex_pos_clusters)),
#         main = "Cluster stability",
#         xlab = "Cluster", 
#         ylab = "Jaccard similarity",
#         col = ifelse(bootres$bootmean < 0.6, # Jaccard < 0.6 is unstable cluster, shouldn't be trusted
#                      "red",
#                      "gray"),
#         font.lab = 2,
#         las = 1)
# # abline(h = 0.6,
# #        col = "red",
# #        lty = 2,
# #        lwd = 2)
# abline(h = 0.75, # Jaccard >= 0.75 is valid and stable cluster
#        col = "forestgreen",
#        lty = 2,
#        lwd = 2)

# calc jaccard similarity for all 1:ideal clusters' stabilities
bootres_all <- lapply(1:as.numeric(silhouette_solecancersex_pos$data$clusters[which.max(silhouette_solecancersex_pos$data$y)]),
                      FUN = function(x) clusterboot(scale(t(solecancersex_pos_matrix_ordered)), 
                                                    clustermethod = hclustCBI,
                                                    scaling = FALSE, # data already provided as scaled so don't need to rescale
                                                    method = "complete", 
                                                    k = x, 
                                                    seed = 1212,
                                                    count = FALSE))

# plot all cluster numbers' jaccard barplots with lines indicating stable clusters
lapply(1:length(bootres_all),
       FUN = function(x) {barplot(bootres_all[[x]][["bootmean"]],
                                  xaxs = "i", # remove space between left side of bars and y axis 
                                  ylim = c(0, 1),
                                  names.arg = c(1:x),
                                  main = "Cluster stability",
                                  xlab = "Cluster", 
                                  ylab = "Jaccard similarity",
                                  col = ifelse(bootres_all[[x]][["bootmean"]] < 0.6, # Jaccard < 0.6 is unstable cluster, shouldn't be trusted
                                               "red",
                                               "gray"),
                                  font.lab = 2,
                                  las = 1)
         abline(h = 0.75, # Jaccard >= 0.75 is valid and stable cluster
                col = "forestgreen",
                lty = 2,
                lwd = 2)})
```

```{r fvizclusteroverlap-ACC-sole-agestrata-pos-kmeans, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, results = 'hide', fig.width = 12, fig.height = 10, include = FALSE}
# calc k-means clustering as alternative to hierarchical clustering
# calc kmeans clustering for 1:ideal hclust number of clusters from silhouette plot
set.seed(1212)
ACC_sole_agestrata_pos_kmeansclust_all <- lapply(X = 1:as.numeric(silhouette_ACC_sole_agestrata_pos$data$clusters[which.max(silhouette_ACC_sole_agestrata_pos$data$y)]), # ideal cluster number with max avg silhouette width (where the dashed line is on plot)
                                                 FUN = function(x) {set.seed(1212)
                                                   stats::kmeans(scale(t(ACC_sole_agestrata_pos_matrix_ordered)),
```

```{r fvizclusteroverlap-osteosarcoma-sole-sex-pos-kmeans, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, results = 'hide', fig.width = 12, fig.height = 10, include = FALSE}
                                                                 nstart = 50)})

# compare whether things clustered together even if cluster labels are different, hierarchical cluster is rows and kmeans is columns, so order kmeans columns by max hierarchical cluster so that diagonal is the maximal matching, since cluster labels won't be the same but which muts go into which clusters should be similar and maximized in diagonal
# do across all kmeans and hclust calculated; first make matrix of hclust vs kmeans, get way to reorder cols to make diagonal maximum, reorder matrices per these cols, add rowsums total at ends of matrices, convert each matrix to df, rename 1x1 df because of how R named it
consensus_hclust_kmeans_osteosarcoma_sole_sex_pos_all_prep <- 
  lapply(1:length(osteosarcoma_sole_sex_pos_kmeansclust_all),
         FUN = function(x) table(osteosarcoma_sole_sex_pos_clusters_all[, x], 
                                 osteosarcoma_sole_sex_pos_kmeansclust_all[[x]][["cluster"]]))

col_reordering <-
  lapply(1:length(consensus_hclust_kmeans_osteosarcoma_sole_sex_pos_all_prep),
         FUN = function(x) replace(max.col(consensus_hclust_kmeans_osteosarcoma_sole_sex_pos_all_prep[[x]],
```
