```{r fvizclusteroverlap-solecancerpos-kmeans, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, results = 'hide', fig.width = 12, fig.height = 10}
# fvizclusteroverlap_solecancerpos_kmeans

# calc k-means clustering as alternative to hierarchical clustering
# calc kmeans clustering for 1:ideal hclust number of clusters from silhouette plot
set.seed(1212)
solecancerpos_kmeansclust_all <- lapply(X = 1:5 # 5 close enough to ideal
                                        #as.numeric(silhouette_solecancerpos$data$clusters[which.max(silhouette_solecancerpos$data$y)])
                                        , # ideal cluster number with max avg silhouette width (where the dashed line is on plot)
                                        FUN = function(x) {set.seed(1212)
                                          stats::kmeans(scale(t(solecancerpos_matrix_ordered)),
                                                        centers = x, # num of clusters, 1:ideal
                                                        nstart = 50)})

# compare whether things clustered together even if cluster labels are different, hierarchical cluster is rows and kmeans is columns, so order kmeans columns by max hierarchical cluster so that diagonal is the maximal matching, since cluster labels won't be the same but which muts go into which clusters should be similar and maximized in diagonal
# do across all kmeans and hclust calculated; first make matrix of hclust vs kmeans, get way to reorder cols to make diagonal maximum, reorder matrices per these cols, add rowsums total at ends of matrices, convert each matrix to df, rename 1x1 df because of how R named it
consensus_hclust_kmeans_solecancerpos_all_prep <- 
  lapply(1:length(solecancerpos_kmeansclust_all),
         FUN = function(x) table(solecancerpos_clusters_all[, x], 
                                 solecancerpos_kmeansclust_all[[x]][["cluster"]]))

col_reordering <-
  lapply(1:length(consensus_hclust_kmeans_solecancerpos_all_prep),
         FUN = function(x) replace(max.col(consensus_hclust_kmeans_solecancerpos_all_prep[[x]], 
                                           "first"), 
                                   duplicated(max.col(consensus_hclust_kmeans_solecancerpos_all_prep[[x]], 
                                                      "first")), 
                                   setdiff(1:ncol(consensus_hclust_kmeans_solecancerpos_all_prep[[x]]), 
                                           max.col(consensus_hclust_kmeans_solecancerpos_all_prep[[x]], 
                                                   "first"))))

consensus_hclust_kmeans_solecancerpos_all_prep <- 
  lapply(1:length(consensus_hclust_kmeans_solecancerpos_all_prep),
         FUN = function(x) (consensus_hclust_kmeans_solecancerpos_all_prep[[x]])[,col_reordering[[x]]])

consensus_hclust_kmeans_solecancerpos_all_prep <- 
  lapply(rapply(list(cbind(consensus_hclust_kmeans_solecancerpos_all_prep[[1]],
                           Total = consensus_hclust_kmeans_solecancerpos_all_prep[[1]]),
                     lapply(2:length(consensus_hclust_kmeans_solecancerpos_all_prep), 
                            FUN = function(x) cbind(consensus_hclust_kmeans_solecancerpos_all_prep[[x]],
                                                    Total = rowSums(consensus_hclust_kmeans_solecancerpos_all_prep[[x]])))), 
                enquote, 
                how = "unlist"), 
         eval)

consensus_hclust_kmeans_solecancerpos_all <- 
  lapply(1:length(consensus_hclust_kmeans_solecancerpos_all_prep),
         FUN = function(x) as.data.frame(consensus_hclust_kmeans_solecancerpos_all_prep[[x]]))

names(consensus_hclust_kmeans_solecancerpos_all[[1]]) <- gsub("V",
                                                              "",
                                                              names(consensus_hclust_kmeans_solecancerpos_all[[1]])) 

# divide across for fraction of hierarchical that matched in kmeans, should be 1 if perfect match
# do for all dfs made
consensus_hclust_kmeans_solecancerpos_all_calc <- 
  lapply(1:length(consensus_hclust_kmeans_solecancerpos_all),
         FUN = function(x) consensus_hclust_kmeans_solecancerpos_all[[x]] %>% 
           mutate_at(vars(1:Total),
                     .funs = ~./Total) %>% 
           dplyr::select(-Total))

# calculate rand indices and adjusted rand indices across all dfs for clustering similarity for barplots
solecancerpos_all_rand_index <- unlist(lapply(1:length(consensus_hclust_kmeans_solecancerpos_all),
                                              FUN = function(x) fossil::rand.index(solecancerpos_clusters_all[, x], 
                                                                                   solecancerpos_kmeansclust_all[[x]][["cluster"]])))

solecancerpos_all_adj_rand_index <- unlist(lapply(1:length(consensus_hclust_kmeans_solecancerpos_all),
                                                  FUN = function(x) fossil::adj.rand.index(solecancerpos_clusters_all[, x], 
                                                                                           solecancerpos_kmeansclust_all[[x]][["cluster"]])))

# plot kmeans clusters overlap for all possible clusters
lapply(1:length(solecancerpos_kmeansclust_all),
       FUN = function(x) fviz_cluster(solecancerpos_kmeansclust_all[[x]],
                                      data = scale(t(solecancerpos_matrix_ordered)), 
                                      geom = c("point", 
                                               "text"), 
                                      ellipse.type = "convex",
                                      repel = TRUE) +
         theme_classic() +
         labs(col = "Cluster",
              fill = "Cluster",
              shape = "Cluster") +
         scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0.015, 0.015)) +
         scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0.015, 0.015)) +
         theme(axis.text = element_text(color = "black",
                                        size = 12),
               axis.title.x = element_text(margin = unit(c(5,0,0,0), "mm")),
               axis.title.y = element_text(margin = unit(c(0,5,0,0), "mm")),
               axis.title = element_text(face = "bold",
                                         color = "black",
                                         size = 14),
               legend.title = element_text(face = "bold",
                                           color = "black",
                                           size = 14),
               legend.text = element_text(color = "black",
                                          size = 12),
               plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5,
                                         face = "bold",
                                         color = "black",
                                         size = 16)))
```

```{r jaccard-ACC-sole-agestrata-pos-kmeans, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, results = "hide", fig.width = 7.25, fig.height = 5.5, eval = FALSE, include = FALSE}
# plot jaccard similarity to assess cluster stability
set.seed(1212)
bootres <- clusterboot(scale(t(ACC_sole_agestrata_pos_matrix_ordered)), 
                       clustermethod = kmeansCBI,
                       scaling = FALSE, # data already provided as scaled so don't need to rescale
                       krange = max(ACC_sole_agestrata_pos_clusters), 
                       runs = 50,
                       iter.max = 10,
                       scaledata = FALSE,
                       seed = 1212,
                       count = FALSE)

barplot(bootres$bootmean, 
        xaxs = "i", # remove space between left side of bars and y axis
        ylim = c(0, 1),
        names.arg = c(1:max(ACC_sole_agestrata_pos_clusters)),
        main = "Cluster stability",
        xlab = "Cluster", 
        ylab = "Jaccard similarity",
        col = ifelse(bootres$bootmean < 0.6, # Jaccard < 0.6 is unstable cluster, shouldn't be trusted
                     "red",
                     "gray"),
        font.lab = 2,
        las = 1)
# abline(h = 0.6,
#        col = "red",
#        lty = 2,
#        lwd = 2)
abline(h = 0.75, # Jaccard >= 0.75 is valid and stable cluster
       col = "forestgreen",
       lty = 2,
       lwd = 2)
```

```{r silhouette-bar-kmeans-ACC-sole-agestrata-pos, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, results = 'hide', fig.height = 6, fig.width = 8, include = FALSE}
silhouette_bar_kmeans_ACC_sole_agestrata_pos <- fviz_silhouette(silhouette(ACC_sole_agestrata_pos_kmeansclust$cluster, 
                                                                           dist = dist(scale(t(ACC_sole_agestrata_pos_matrix_ordered)), # for muts as rows
                                                                                       method = "euclidean"))) +
  theme_classic() + 
  labs(col = "Cluster",
       fill = "Cluster") +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-1, 1),
                     n.breaks = 11,
                     expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_x_discrete(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  theme(axis.text = element_text(color = "black",
                                 size = 12),
        axis.title.x = element_text(margin = unit(c(5,0,0,0), "mm")),
        axis.title.y = element_text(margin = unit(c(0,5,0,0), "mm")),
        axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
        axis.title = element_text(face = "bold",
                                  color = "black",
                                  size = 14),
        legend.title = element_text(face = "bold",
                                    color = "black",
                                    size = 14),
        legend.text = element_text(color = "black",
                                   size = 12),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5,
                                  face = "bold",
                                  color = "black",
                                  size = 16,
                                  margin = unit(c(0,0,5,0), "mm")))
silhouette_bar_kmeans_ACC_sole_agestrata_pos$layers[[2]]$aes_params$colour <- "black"
silhouette_bar_kmeans_ACC_sole_agestrata_pos
```

$~$

```{r silhouette-bar-kmeans-ACC-sole-sex-pos, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, results = 'hide', fig.height = 6, fig.width = 8, include = FALSE}
  theme(axis.text = element_text(color = "black",

        axis.title.y = element_text(margin = unit(c(0,5,0,0), "mm")),

        axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
        axis.title = element_text(face = "bold",

        legend.title = element_text(face = "bold",
                                    color = "black",
                                    size = 14),
        legend.text = element_text(color = "black",
                                   size = 12),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5,
                                  face = "bold",
                                  color = "black",
                                  size = 16,
                                  margin = unit(c(0,0,5,0), "mm")))
```

```{r complexhm-consensus-hclust-kmeans-ACC-sole-agestrata-pos, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, results = 'hide', fig.width = 3.75, fig.height = 3, include = FALSE}
       )
) # adding title makes maps generate in duplicate for some reason so will not add one
```

```{r ACC-sole-agestrata-pos-lm-multinomial, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, include = FALSE}
t <- MASS::dropterm(ACC_sole_agestrata_pos_lm, 
                    trace = FALSE, 
                    test = "Chisq") %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  drop_na() %>%
  rownames_to_column("Characteristic") %>%
  arrange(`Pr(Chi)`) %>%
  transform(Sig = dplyr::case_when(`Pr(Chi)` < 0.001 ~ paste0("***"),
                                   `Pr(Chi)` < 0.01 ~ paste0("**"),
                                   `Pr(Chi)` < 0.05 ~ paste0("*"),
                                   `Pr(Chi)` >= 0.05 ~ paste0("NS"))) %>%
  transform(Characteristic = dplyr::case_when(Characteristic == "Effect" ~ "Type",
                                              Characteristic == "Residue_function" ~ "Feature",
                                              Characteristic == "SIFTClass" ~ "SIFT",
                                              Characteristic == "DNE_LOFclass" ~ "DNE",
                                              TRUE ~ Characteristic)) %>% 
  transform(Characteristic = ifelse(grepl("_",
                                          Characteristic),
                                    gsub("_",
                                         " ",
                                         Characteristic),
                                    Characteristic)) %>%
  #dplyr::rename(`Pr(Chi)` = `Pr.Chi.`) %>%
  gt() %>% 
  tab_style(style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
            locations = cells_column_labels())
t
```

$~$

```{r save-ACC-sole-agestrata-pos-lm-multinomial, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, include = FALSE}
gt::gtsave(t, 
           file = paste0(fig_path, 
                         "ACC-sole-agestrata-pos-lm-multinomial.png"))
```

```{r ACC-sole-sex-pos-lm-multinomial, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, include = FALSE}
  transform(Sig = dplyr::case_when(`Pr(Chi)` < 0.001 ~ paste0("***"),
                                   `Pr(Chi)` < 0.01 ~ paste0("**"),
                                   `Pr(Chi)` < 0.05 ~ paste0("*"),
                                   `Pr(Chi)` >= 0.05 ~ paste0("NS"))) %>%
  transform(Characteristic = dplyr::case_when(Characteristic == "Effect" ~ "Type",
                                              Characteristic == "Residue_function" ~ "Feature",
                                              Characteristic == "SIFTClass" ~ "SIFT",
                                              Characteristic == "DNE_LOFclass" ~ "DNE",
```
```{r solecancer-type-lm-multinomial, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, include = FALSE}
                                              Characteristic %in% c("Short_topo",
```
```{r solecancer-sex-pos-lm-multinomial, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, include = FALSE}
                                                                    "Cancer_Label") ~ "Cancer",
                                              TRUE ~ Characteristic)) %>% 
  transform(Characteristic = ifelse(grepl("_",
                                          Characteristic),
                                    gsub("_",
                                         " ",
                                         Characteristic),
                                    Characteristic)) %>%
  #dplyr::rename(`Pr(Chi)` = `Pr.Chi.`) %>%
  gt() %>% 
  tab_style(style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
            locations = cells_column_labels())
t
```

```{r pts-splicing-prep, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
# indicate whether patients have splicing and isoform positions affected
origdbjustsolecancersover100_forsplice <- origdbjustsolecancersover100 %>% 
  transform(Isoform = ifelse(Effect %in% c("splice", "intronic") | Codon_number %in% (c(40, 133, 160)),
                             "yes",
                             "no")) %>% 
  transform(Isoform = ifelse(is.na(Isoform),
                             "no",
                             Isoform))

origdbjustmultcancersover100_forsplice <- origdbjustmultcancersover100 %>% 
  transform(Isoform = ifelse(Effect %in% c("splice", "intronic") | Codon_number %in% (c(40, 133, 160)),
                             "yes",
                             "no")) %>% 
  transform(Isoform = ifelse(is.na(Isoform),
                             "no",
                             Isoform))

origdbdefcancer_forsplice <- origdbdefcancer %>% 
  transform(Isoform = ifelse(Effect %in% c("splice", "intronic") | Codon_number %in% (c(40, 133, 160)),
                             "yes",
                             "no")) %>% 
  transform(Isoform = ifelse(is.na(Isoform),
                             "no",
                             Isoform))

breakdown_forsplice <- breakdown %>% 
  transform(Isoform = ifelse(Effect %in% c("splice", "intronic") | Codon_number %in% (c(40, 133, 160)),
                             "yes",
                             "no")) %>% 
  transform(Isoform = ifelse(is.na(Isoform),
                             "no",
                             Isoform))

# rename values in exon and intron column to follow typical intron # syntax instead of #-intron
origdbjustsolecancersover100_forsplice$ExonIntron <- str_replace(origdbjustsolecancersover100_forsplice$ExonIntron,
                                                                 "^(\\d+-)([a-z]+)", 
                                                                 "\\2 \\1") %>% # put any numbers and dash at front to back of string with space
  gsub("-", 
       "", 
       .)

origdbjustmultcancersover100_forsplice$ExonIntron <- str_replace(origdbjustmultcancersover100_forsplice$ExonIntron,
                                                                 "^(\\d+-)([a-z]+)", 
                                                                 "\\2 \\1") %>% # put any numbers and dash at front to back of string with space
  gsub("-", 
       "", 
       .)

origdbdefcancer_forsplice$ExonIntron <- str_replace(origdbdefcancer_forsplice$ExonIntron,
                                                    "^(\\d+-)([a-z]+)", 
                                                    "\\2 \\1") %>% # put any numbers and dash at front to back of string with space
  gsub("-", 
       "", 
       .)

# "i" or "e" in front means mut w/i indicated intron or exon but no info on precise location, so  need to add e#exon and i#intron to each exon or intron counts too, particularly for sole pts
origdbjustsolecancersover100_forsplice$ExonIntron <- str_replace(origdbjustsolecancersover100_forsplice$ExonIntron,
                                                                 "^e([0-9]+)exon", 
                                                                 "exon \\1")

origdbjustsolecancersover100_forsplice$ExonIntron <- str_replace(origdbjustsolecancersover100_forsplice$ExonIntron,
                                                                 "^i([0-9]+)intron", 
                                                                 "intron \\1") # no i#introns in dataset but just for completeness

solespliceperpos$addRowDataGroups("Isoform")

contingency_germ_som_splice <- rbind(contingency_germ_som_splice,
                                     c(NA, (last(solespliceperpos_pivot$Total) - contingency_germ_som_splice[1,] %>% as.numeric()) %>% head(-1))) %>%

# because need to subtract total minus each previous column, make intermediate df with all total pt numbers per cancer and subtract total from previous column to col of interest
blah <- left_join(contingency_germ_som_cancers_splice,
                  solesplicepercancerpos_pivot %>% # get total number of pts with each cancer
                    dplyr::select(-c(Isoform,
                                     Total,
                                     OTHER)) %>% 
                    last() %>% 
                    mutate(ProtDescription = "Total") %>%
                    remove_rownames() %>% 
                    column_to_rownames("ProtDescription") %>% 
                    t() %>% 
                    as.data.frame() %>% 
                    rownames_to_column("Cancer") %>% 
                    mutate(Cancer = paste0(Cancer,
                                           "_germline sole")),
                  by = "Cancer")

# define columns to be subtracted
columns_to_subtract <- colnames(blah)[grepl("_Not",
                                            colnames(blah))]

# subtract cols
blah[, columns_to_subtract] <- lapply(columns_to_subtract, 
                                      function(col) {
                                        index <- match(col, 
                                                       names(blah)) # index of current col
                                        blah[, "Total"] - blah[, index - 1] # total - prev col
                                      })

# pairwise prop test to confirm if percent of splice muts overall in cancers and total differ, so need to make matrix of 2 cols, first is success and second is failures i.e. yes and no, and then send to function, don't need multiple hypothesis correction with p adjustment because these are independent tests made
(solesplicepercancer_pivot %>% 
    dplyr::select(-c(OTHER)) %>% 
    subset(Isoform != "Total") %>% 
    remove_rownames() %>% 
    column_to_rownames("Isoform") %>% 
    t())[,c(2,1)] %>% 
  stats::pairwise.prop.test(., 
                            p.adjust.method = "none")

(solesplicepercancer_pivot %>% 
    dplyr::select(-c(OTHER)) %>% 
    subset(Isoform != "Total") %>% 
    remove_rownames() %>% 
    column_to_rownames("Isoform") %>% 
    t())[,c(2,1)] %>% 
  stats::pairwise.prop.test(., 
                            p.adjust.method = "BH")

# can also do general prop test to see overall if difference in percentages, not significant 
(solesplicepercancer_pivot %>% 
    dplyr::select(-c(OTHER,
                     Total)) %>% 
    subset(Isoform != "Total") %>% 
    remove_rownames() %>% 
    column_to_rownames("Isoform") %>% 
    t())[,c(2,1)] %>% 
  stats::prop.test(., 
                   alternative = "two.sided",
                   correct = TRUE)

    t())[,c(2,1)] %>% 
  stats::pairwise.prop.test(., 
                            p.adjust.method = "none")

    column_to_rownames("Isoform") %>%

  stats::pairwise.prop.test(., 
                            p.adjust.method = "BH")
```

```{r compare-mut-rates-germ-vs-som, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
# in stats::prop.test(), x can equal a vector of successes (i.e., total number of yes) and n can equal a vector of trials (i.e., total number of cases)

# compare intronic overall between germline and somatic
stats::prop.test(x = c(55, 875), n = c(842, 12793), 
                   alternative = "two.sided",
                   correct = TRUE)

# compare intron 4 between germline and somatic
stats::prop.test(x = c(7, 208), n = c(842, 12793), 
                   alternative = "two.sided",
                   correct = TRUE)

# compare intron 5 between germline and somatic
stats::prop.test(x = c(8, 139), n = c(842, 12793), 
                   alternative = "two.sided",
                   correct = TRUE)

# compare intron 6 between germline and somatic
stats::prop.test(x = c(12, 144), n = c(842, 12793), 
                   alternative = "two.sided",
                   correct = TRUE)

# compare intron 9 between germline and somatic
stats::prop.test(x = c(11, 132), n = c(842, 12793), 
                   alternative = "two.sided",
                   correct = TRUE)

# compare intron 6 consensus SD between germline and somatic
stats::prop.test(x = c(7, 61), n = c(842, 12793), 
                   alternative = "two.sided",
                   correct = TRUE)

# compare intron 8 consensus SD between germline and somatic
stats::prop.test(x = c(6, 51), n = c(842, 12793), 
                   alternative = "two.sided",
                   correct = TRUE)

# compare intron 5 consensus SA between germline and somatic
stats::prop.test(x = c(5, 54), n = c(842, 12793), 
                   alternative = "two.sided",
                   correct = TRUE)

# compare breast and brain cancer cohort compositions between germline and somatic
stats::prop.test(x = c(294+147, 1355+201+210+197), n = c(842, 12793), 
                   alternative = "two.sided",
                   correct = TRUE)

# compare lung, colorectal, pancreatic, and gastric cancer cohort compositions between germline and somatic
stats::prop.test(x = c(19+21+5+16, 2104+287+1543+892+767), n = c(842, 12793), 
                   alternative = "two.sided",
                   correct = TRUE)
```

```{r solecancer-age-splice-lm-multinomial, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
t <- MASS::dropterm(solecancer_age_splice_lm, 
               trace = FALSE, 
               test = "Chisq") %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  drop_na() %>%
  rownames_to_column("Characteristic") %>%
  arrange(`Pr(Chi)`) %>%
  transform(Sig = dplyr::case_when(`Pr(Chi)` < 0.001 ~ paste0("***"),
                                   `Pr(Chi)` < 0.01 ~ paste0("**"),
                                   `Pr(Chi)` < 0.05 ~ paste0("*"),
                                   `Pr(Chi)` >= 0.05 ~ paste0("NS"))) %>%
  transform(Characteristic = dplyr::case_when(Characteristic == "Effect" ~ "Type",
                                              Characteristic == "Residue_function" ~ "Feature",
                                              Characteristic == "SIFTClass" ~ "SIFT",
                                              Characteristic == "DNE_LOFclass" ~ "DNE",
                                              Characteristic %in% c("Short_topo",
                                                                    "Cancer_Label") ~ "Cancer",
                                              TRUE ~ Characteristic)) %>% 
  transform(Characteristic = ifelse(grepl("_",
                                          Characteristic),
                                    gsub("_",
                                         " ",
                                         Characteristic),
                                    Characteristic)) %>%
  #dplyr::rename(`Pr(Chi)` = `Pr.Chi.`) %>%
  gt() %>% 
  tab_style(style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
            locations = cells_column_labels())
t
```

```{r stackedbarchart-pts-spliceperpos, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, fig.height = 7, fig.width = 6}
# plot zoomed in stacked barchart with adjusted %
stackedbarchart_pts_spliceperpos <- ggplot(pt_spliceperpos_df_ggplot %>%
                                             mutate(Calc_label = Calc) %>%
                                             mutate(Calc_label = dplyr::case_when(Isoform == "no" & grepl("Multiple", 
                                                                                                          Patient) ~ to_fit_mult/nrow(pt_spliceperpos_df_ggplot %>%
                                                                                                                                        subset(Isoform == "no" & grepl("Multiple", 
                                                                                                                                                                       Patient))),
                                                                                  Isoform == "no" & grepl("All", 
                                                                                                          Patient) ~ to_fit_all/nrow(pt_spliceperpos_df_ggplot %>%
                                                                                                                                       subset(Isoform == "no" & grepl("All", 
                                                                                                                                                                      Patient))),
                                                                                  Isoform == "no" & grepl("One", 
                                                                                                          Patient) ~ to_fit_sole/nrow(pt_spliceperpos_df_ggplot %>%
                                                                                                                                        subset(Isoform == "no" & grepl("One", 
                                                                                                                                                                       Patient))),
                                                                                  TRUE ~ Calc_label)), 
                                           aes(x = factor(Patient,
                                                          levels = sort(unique(pt_spliceperpos_df_ggplot$Patient),
                                                                        decreasing = TRUE)[order(c(2,3,1))]), 
                                               y = Calc_label, 
                                               fill = factor(Label,
                                                             levels = c((pt_spliceperpos_df_ggplot %>%
                                                                           arrange(-Calc) %>%
                                                                           pull(Label) %>%
                                                                           unique())[(pt_spliceperpos_df_ggplot %>% 
                                                                                        arrange(-Calc) %>%
                                                                                        pull(Label) %>%
                                                                                        unique()) != "Other"], 
                                                                        "Other")))) + 
  geom_bar(position = "fill", 
           stat = "identity") + 
  ggtitle("Proportion of Germline Mutations Affecting \nTP53 Splicing in Individuals with Cancer") + 
  xlab("Patient type") +
  ylab("Proportion of distinct individuals") +
  labs(fill = "Mutation") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(), 
                     expand = c(0,0), 
                     breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 6)) +
  scale_x_discrete(expand = c(0,0)) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c((plyr::round_any(min(pt_splice_df_ggplot %>% 
                                                  subset(Isoform == "no") %>%
                                                  pull(Calc)), 
                                            0.02, 
                                            f = floor)), 1.0000001), # set axis limits in coord_cartesian to zoom in on percentages
                  expand = FALSE) + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#000000",
                               "#0072B2",
                               "#D55E00",
                               "#009E73",
                               "#E69F00",
                               "#56B4E9",
                               "#CC79A7",
                               #"#F0E442",
                               "lightgray")) +
  theme_classic() + 
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, 
                                   hjust = 1, 
                                   vjust = 1), 
        axis.text = element_text(color = "black",
                                 size = 12), 
        axis.title = element_text(color = "black",
                                  face = "bold",
                                  size = 14),
        axis.title.x = element_text(margin = unit(c(5,0,0,0), units = "mm")),
        axis.title.y = element_text(margin = unit(c(0,5,0,0), units = "mm")),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5,
                                  face = "bold",
                                  color = "black",
                                  size = 16,
                                  margin = margin(0,0,5,0, "mm")),
        legend.text = element_text(color = "black",
                                   size = 12),
        legend.title = element_text(color = "black",
                                    face = "bold",
                                    size = 14),
        plot.margin = margin(0,0,0,20, "mm"))
```

```{r stackedbarchart-sole-splice-cancers-total, fig.height = 7.25, fig.width = 7.25, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
# add total to df
df_total_ggplot <- solesplicepercancer_pivot %>% # add num pts to cancer colnames
  rename_at(vars(2:(ncol(.) 
                    #- 1
  )),
  ~ paste0(.,
           " (",
           solesplicepercancer_pivot[nrow(solesplicepercancer_pivot), .],
           " individuals)")) %>% # divide down each col by last value i.e. total pts
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric),
                ~ .x/last(.x))) %>% 
  subset(Isoform != "Total") %>%
  #dplyr::select(-Total) %>%

  dplyr::rename(Cancer = variable,

                        "yes; total",
```

```{r stackedbarchart-sole-splice-cancers-horiz, fig.height = 4.25, fig.width = 10, warning = FALSE}
                                                       y = Proportion,
                                                       fill = relevel(as.factor(Isoform),
                                                                      ref = "yes"))) +
  geom_bar(position = position_fill(reverse = TRUE),
           stat = "identity") +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(plyr::round_any(Proportion * 100,
                                               0.1
                                               #,
                                               #f = ceiling
  ),
  "%")),
  position = position_fill(reverse = TRUE),
  color = "black",
  size = 4.5,
  fontface = "bold",
  alpha = 0.5, # level of transparency (lower is more transparent)
  vjust = 0.5,
  hjust = -0.25) +
  ggtitle("Proportion of Germline Mutations Affecting \nTP53 Splicing in Individuals with Cancer") + 
  xlab("Cancer") +
  ylab("Proportion of distinct individuals") +
  labs(fill = "Splicing affected") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(), 
                     expand = c(0,0), 
                     breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 5),
                     position = "right") +
  scale_x_discrete(expand = c(0,0),
                   limits = rev) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#0072B2",
                               "lightgray")) +
  theme_classic() + 
  coord_flip(ylim = c(0, ((solesplicepercancer_pivot_melted %>% 
                             subset(!str_detect(Cancer, "OTHER")) %>% 
                             subset(Isoform == "yes") %>%
                             pull(Proportion) %>%
                             max() %>%
                             plyr::round_any(0.1,
                                             f = ceiling)) * 1.000001)
                      #0.200000001
  )) + # calls coord_cartesian to set axis limits to zoom in on percentages
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, 
                                   hjust = 0.5), 
        axis.text = element_text(color = "black",
                                 size = 12), 
        axis.title = element_text(color = "black",
                                  face = "bold",
                                  size = 14),
        axis.title.x.top = element_text(margin = unit(c(0,0,10,0), units = "mm")),
        axis.title.y = element_text(margin = unit(c(0,10,0,0), units = "mm")),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5,
                                  face = "bold",
                                  color = "black",
                                  size = 16,
                                  margin = margin(0,0,10,0, "mm")),
        legend.text = element_text(color = "black",
                                   size = 12),
        legend.title = element_text(color = "black",
                                    face = "bold",
                                    size = 14),
        axis.text.y = element_text(vjust = 0.5))
```

```{r barchart-facet-pts-splice-cancers-overall-germ-som-same, fig.height = 17, fig.width = 11, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE}
              vjust = -0.5,
              hjust = 0.5) +
    xlab("Dataset") +
    ylab("Proportion of distinct individuals") +
    labs(fill = "Dataset") + 
    ggtitle("Proportion of Isoform-Altering \nMutations in TP53 in \nIndividuals with Cancer") + # different facet_wrap function which allows conditional strip i.e. facet formatting
    facet_wrap2(~ Tissue, strip.position = "right",
                ncol = 2, #labeller = labeller(groupwrap = label_wrap_gen(10)),
    axes = "all", # show internal axes but without x labels
    remove_labels = "x", # show internal axes but without x labels
    drop = FALSE) + # ensure muts not in dataset still shown as blanks
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(), 
                       expand = c(0,0), 
                       breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 7), 
                       limits = c(0, ((germ_som_cancers_overall_same_splice_ggplot %>% 
                                           subset(Isoform == "yes" & Tissue != "Other")) %>% 
                                           pull(Proportion) %>% 
                                           max() %>%
                                           plyr::round_any(0.10, 
                                                           f = ceiling)) * 1.000001)) +
    scale_x_discrete(
        #limits = rev, 
        expand = c(0,0),
        drop = FALSE) + # ensure muts not in dataset are still shown as blanks
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("#0072B2",
                                 "#D55E00")) +
    theme_classic() + 
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, 
                                     hjust = 1, 
                                     vjust = 1), 
          axis.text = element_text(color = "black",
                                   size = 12), 
          axis.title = element_text(color = "black",
                                    face = "bold",
                                    size = 14),
          axis.title.x = element_text(margin = unit(c(10,0,0,0), units = "mm")),
          axis.title.y = element_text(margin = unit(c(0,10,0,0), units = "mm")),
          plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5,
                                    face = "bold",
                                    color = "black",
                                    size = 16,
                                    margin = margin(0,0,10,0, "mm")),
          legend.text = element_text(color = "black",
                                     size = 12),
          legend.title = element_text(color = "black",
                                      face = "bold",
                                      size = 14),
          legend.box.spacing = margin(30), # increase space between legend and plot
          legend.justification = "top", # put legend in top right of plot
          #legend.position = c(,), # c(0,0) bottom left, c(1,1) top-right within plot
          strip.background = element_blank(),
          strip.text = element_text(color = "black",
                                    size = 14,
                                    face = "bold",
                                    margin = margin(10,10,10,10, "mm")),
          panel.spacing.x = unit(5, "lines"),
          #panel.spacing.y = unit(-10, "lines"),
          plot.margin = margin(0,0,0,35, unit = "mm"))
barchart_facet_pts_splice_cancers_overall_germ_som_same
```

```{r sole-splice-age-boxplot-stats, warning = FALSE, fig.height = 7.5, fig.width = 8.5}
# boxplot of whether splicing affects ages of dx
sole_splice_age_boxplot <- ggplot(
  # origdbjustsolecancersover100_forsplice %>% 
  #                                   dplyr::select(c(Individual_code,
  #                                                   Age_at_diagnosis,
  #                                                   Isoform,
  #                                                   Sex,
  #                                                   Cancer_Label)) %>% 
  #                                   distinct() %>% # remove pts with mult muts where one has splice 
  #                                   subset(!(Individual_code %in% (origdbjustsolecancersover100_forsplice %>% 
  #                                              dplyr::select(c(Individual_code,
  #                                                              Age_at_diagnosis,
  #                                                              Isoform,
  #                                                              Sex,
  #                                                              Cancer_Label)) %>% 
  #                                              distinct() %>% 
  #                                              count(Individual_code) %>% 
  #                                              subset(n > 1) %>% 
  #                                              pull(Individual_code))))
  splicechisq_df %>% 
    subset(!str_detect(Cancer_Label, 
                       "OTHER")),
  aes(y = Age_at_diagnosis,
      x = relevel(as.factor(Isoform), 
                  ref = "yes"))) + 
  stat_boxplot(geom = "errorbar", # to put bars at end of IQRs
               width = 0.4) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
  stat_compare_means(method = "wilcox.test",
                     paired = FALSE,
                     hjust = -0.25) +
  geom_jitter(aes(color = Cancer_Label,
                  shape = Sex),
              width = 0.3,
              height = 0,
              alpha = 0.5,
              size = 2) + 
  scale_color_manual(values = c("maroon","#D55E00","#009E73","#0072B2","darkgray"
                                #,
                                #"purple"
                                #"black"
  ),
  name = "Cancer") + 
  scale_y_continuous(n.breaks = 7,
                     limits = c(0, 100)) +
  ylab("Age when diagnosed (years)") +
  xlab("Mutation affecting splicing") +
  ggtitle("Ages of diagnosis in Individuals \nwith Mutations Affecting Splicing") + 
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text = element_text(color = "black",
                                 size = 12),
        axis.title = element_text(color = "black",
                                  size = 14,
                                  face = "bold"),
        axis.title.x = element_text(margin = unit(c(5,0,0,0), "mm")),
        axis.title.y = element_text(margin = unit(c(0,5,0,0), "mm")),
        legend.title = element_text(color = "black",
                                    size = 14,
                                    face = "bold"),
        legend.text = element_text(color = "black",
                                   size = 12),
        plot.title = element_text(color = "black",
                                  size = 16,
                                  face = "bold",
                                  margin = unit(c(0,0,5,0), "mm"),
                                  hjust = 0.5))
sole_splice_age_boxplot
```

```{r sole-splice-age-brain-boxplot-stats, warning = FALSE, fig.height = 5.5, fig.width = 4.5}
# boxplot of whether splicing affects ages of dx
sole_splice_age_brain_boxplot <- ggplot(
  # origdbjustsolecancersover100_forsplice %>% 
  #                                   dplyr::select(c(Individual_code,
  #                                                   Age_at_diagnosis,
  #                                                   Isoform,
  #                                                   Sex,
  #                                                   Cancer_Label)) %>% 
  #                                   distinct() %>% # remove pts with mult muts where one has splice 
  #                                   subset(!(Individual_code %in% (origdbjustsolecancersover100_forsplice %>% 
  #                                              dplyr::select(c(Individual_code,
  #                                                              Age_at_diagnosis,
  #                                                              Isoform,
  #                                                              Sex,
  #                                                              Cancer_Label)) %>% 
  #                                              distinct() %>% 
  #                                              count(Individual_code) %>% 
  #                                              subset(n > 1) %>% 
  #                                              pull(Individual_code)))) 
  splicechisq_df %>% 
    subset(Cancer_Label == "BRAIN"),
  aes(y = Age_at_diagnosis,
      x = relevel(as.factor(Isoform), 
                  ref = "yes"))) + 
  stat_boxplot(geom = "errorbar", # to put bars at end of IQRs
               width = 0.4) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
  stat_compare_means(method = "wilcox.test",
                     paired = FALSE,
                     hjust = -0.1) +
  geom_jitter(aes(color = Sex),
              width = 0.3,
              height = 0,
              alpha = 0.5,
              size = 2) + 
  scale_y_continuous(n.breaks = 7,
                     limits = c(0, 100)) +
  ylab("Age when diagnosed (years)") +
  xlab("Mutation affecting splicing") +
  ggtitle("Ages of diagnosis \nin Individuals with \nMutations Affecting Splicing \nand Brain Tumors") + 
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text = element_text(color = "black",
                                 size = 12),
        axis.title = element_text(color = "black",
                                  size = 14,
                                  face = "bold"),
        axis.title.x = element_text(margin = unit(c(5,0,0,0), "mm")),
        axis.title.y = element_text(margin = unit(c(0,5,0,0), "mm")),
        legend.title = element_text(color = "black",
                                    size = 14,
                                    face = "bold"),
        legend.text = element_text(color = "black",
                                   size = 12),
        plot.title = element_text(color = "black",
                                  size = 16,
                                  face = "bold",
                                  margin = unit(c(0,0,5,0), "mm"),
                                  hjust = 0.5))
```

```{r top-splice-sole-damaging-grid, fig.height = 3.5, fig.width = 12.75, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
top_splice_sole_damaging_gridprep <- condformat(origdbjustsolecancersover100_forsplice %>% 
                                               subset(ProtDescription %in% c("M133T",
                                                                             "M133R",
                                                                             "T125T")) %>%
                                               dplyr::select(c(ProtDescription, 
                                                               TransactivationClass,
                                                               SIFTClass,
                                                               DNE_LOFclass, 
                                                               BayesDel,
                                                               REVEL, 
                                                               Polyphen2,
                                                               AGVGDClass, 
                                                               DNEclass)) %>% 
                   mutate(Polyphen2 = dplyr::case_when(Polyphen2 == "D" ~ "Probably damaging",
                                                       Polyphen2 == "P" ~ "Possibly damaging",
                                                       Polyphen2 == "B" ~ "Benign",
                                                       TRUE ~ Polyphen2)) %>% 
                                               dplyr::rename(Mutation = ProtDescription, 
                                                             `Transactivation Class` = TransactivationClass,
                                                             `SIFT Class` = SIFTClass, 
                                                             `DNE_LOF Class` = DNE_LOFclass, 
                                                             PolyPhen2 = Polyphen2,
                                                             `Align-GVGD Class` = AGVGDClass, 
                                                             DNE = DNEclass) %>%
                                               arrange(abs(parse_number(Mutation))) %>%
                                               replace(is.na(.),
                                                       "") %>% 
                                               distinct()) %>% 
  theme_grob(rows = NULL, 
             theme = ttheme_default(base_size = 10,
                                    core = list(padding = unit(c(15, 4), "mm")))) %>%
  condformat2grob(draw = FALSE)

top_splice_sole_damaging_grid <- grid.arrange(top_splice_sole_damaging_gridprep,
                                  top = textGrob("Selected p53 Mutants Tests or Predictions of Damaging Function",
                                                 hjust = 0.5,
                                                 gp = gpar(fontface = "bold")))
```

```{r gt-summary-splice-vs-transact, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE}
t <- tbl_summary(splicechisq_df %>% 
                   subset(!str_detect(Cancer_Label,
                                      "OTHER")) %>%
                   mutate(TransactivationClass = factor(TransactivationClass, 
                                                        levels = c("non-functional",
                                                                   "partially functional",
                                                                   "functional",
                                                                   "supertrans"))) %>% 
                   mutate(Cancer_Label = as.character(Cancer_Label)) %>% 
                   dplyr::select(c(Isoform,
                                   TransactivationClass)), 
                 by = Isoform,
                 label = list(TransactivationClass ~ "Transactivation Class")
                 #,
                 #sort = list(everything() ~ "frequency")
                 ) %>% 
  add_p(test.args = all_tests("fisher.test") ~ list(workspace = 2e9),
        pvalue_fun = pvalue_with_stars) %>% 
  add_stat_label() %>% 
  bold_labels() %>%
  as_gt()
t
```

$~$

```{r save-gt-summary-splice-vs-transact, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE}

           file = paste0(fig_path, 
                         "sole-splice-vs-transact.png"))
```

```{r pts-ATO-prep, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
# indicate whether patients have Rescuable by ATO mutations
origdbjustsolecancersover100_forATO <- origdbjustsolecancersover100 %>% 
  transform(ATO = ifelse(ProtDescription %in% mut_rescued,
                         "yes",
                         "no")) %>% 
  mutate(ATO_not = ifelse(ProtDescription %in% mut_not_rescued, 
                          "no",
                          "notyet")) %>% 
  mutate(PAT = ifelse(ProtDescription %in% mut_rescue_PAT,
                      "yes",
                      "no"))

origdbjustmultcancersover100_forATO <- origdbjustmultcancersover100 %>% 
  transform(ATO = ifelse(ProtDescription %in% mut_rescued,
                         "yes",
                         "no")) %>% 
  mutate(ATO_not = ifelse(ProtDescription %in% mut_not_rescued, 
                          "no",
                          "notyet")) %>% 
  mutate(PAT = ifelse(ProtDescription %in% mut_rescue_PAT,
                      "yes",
                      "no"))

origdbdefcancer_forATO <- origdbdefcancer %>% 
  transform(ATO = ifelse(ProtDescription %in% mut_rescued,
                         "yes",
                         "no")) %>% 
  mutate(ATO_not = ifelse(ProtDescription %in% mut_not_rescued, 
                          "no",
                          "notyet")) %>% 
  mutate(PAT = ifelse(ProtDescription %in% mut_rescue_PAT,
                      "yes",
                      "no"))

breakdown_forATO <- breakdown %>% 
  transform(ATO = ifelse(ProtDescription %in% mut_rescued,
                         "yes",
                         "no")) %>% 
  mutate(ATO_not = ifelse(ProtDescription %in% mut_not_rescued, 
                          "no",
                          "notyet")) %>% 
  mutate(PAT = ifelse(ProtDescription %in% mut_rescue_PAT,
                      "yes",
                      "no"))

# rename values in exon and intron column to follow typical intron # syntax instead of #-intron
origdbjustsolecancersover100_forATO$ExonIntron <- str_replace(origdbjustsolecancersover100_forATO$ExonIntron,
                                                              "^(\\d+-)([a-z]+)", 
                                                              "\\2 \\1") %>% # put any numbers and dash at front to back of string with space
  gsub("-", 
       "", 
       .)

origdbjustmultcancersover100_forATO$ExonIntron <- str_replace(origdbjustmultcancersover100_forATO$ExonIntron,
                                                              "^(\\d+-)([a-z]+)", 
                                                              "\\2 \\1") %>% # put any numbers and dash at front to back of string with space
  gsub("-", 
       "", 
       .)

origdbdefcancer_forATO$ExonIntron <- str_replace(origdbdefcancer_forATO$ExonIntron,
                                                 "^(\\d+-)([a-z]+)", 
                                                 "\\2 \\1") %>% # put any numbers and dash at front to back of string with space
  gsub("-", 
       "", 
       .)

# make pivot tables for specific Rescuable by ATO and other positions proportions across pts
soleATOperpos <- PivotTable$new()
soleATOperpos$addData(origdbjustsolecancersover100_forATO)
soleATOperpos$addRowDataGroups("ATO") 
soleATOperpos$addRowDataGroups("ProtDescription", addTotal = FALSE) # don't keep overall totals
soleATOperpos$defineCalculation(calculationName = "Count of distinct individuals",
                                summariseExpression = "n_distinct(Individual_code)")
soleATOperpos$sortRowDataGroups(levelNumber = 2,
                                orderBy = "calculation",
                                sortOrder = "desc")
soleATOperpos$evaluatePivot() #doing this instead of renderPivot() which takes too long as it shows an actual pivot table, but we need this as a dataframe anyways for calculations later so we don't need to print a pivot table

multATOperpos <- PivotTable$new()
multATOperpos$addData(origdbjustmultcancersover100_forATO)
multATOperpos$addRowDataGroups("ATO") 
multATOperpos$addRowDataGroups("ProtDescription", addTotal = FALSE) # don't keep overall totals
multATOperpos$defineCalculation(calculationName = "Count of distinct individuals",
                                summariseExpression = "n_distinct(Individual_code)")
multATOperpos$sortRowDataGroups(levelNumber = 2,
                                orderBy = "calculation",
                                sortOrder = "desc")
multATOperpos$evaluatePivot() #doing this instead of renderPivot() which takes too long as it shows an actual pivot table, but we need this as a dataframe anyways for calculations later so we don't need to print a pivot table

noneATOperpos$addRowDataGroups("ATO") 
noneATOperpos$addRowDataGroups("ProtDescription", addTotal = FALSE) # don't keep overall totals
noneATOperpos$defineCalculation(calculationName = "Count of distinct individuals",
                                summariseExpression = "n_distinct(Individual_code)")

soleATOperpos_pivot_calc <- soleATOperpos_pivot %>%
  transform(Calc = Total/as.numeric(soleATOperpos_pivot[nrow(soleATOperpos_pivot), "Total"])) %>% 
  transform(Patient = paste0("One cancer (",
                             as.numeric(soleATOperpos_pivot[nrow(soleATOperpos_pivot), "Total"]),
                             " individuals)")) %>%
  transform(Label = ifelse(ATO == "yes",
                           ProtDescription,
                           "Other")) %>%
  subset(ATO != "Total") %>%
  dplyr::select(-Total)

soleATO_pivot_calc <- soleATO_pivot %>%
  transform(Calc = Total/as.numeric(soleATO_pivot[nrow(soleATO_pivot), "Total"])) %>% 
  transform(Patient = paste0("One cancer (",
                             as.numeric(soleATO_pivot[nrow(soleATO_pivot), "Total"]),
                             " individuals)")) %>%
  subset(ATO != "Total") %>%
  dplyr::select(-Total)

  rename_at(vars(2:7),
            ~ paste0(.,
                     " (",
                     soleATOpercancer_pivot[nrow(soleATOpercancer_pivot), .],
                     " individuals)")) %>% # divide down each col by last value i.e. total pts
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric),
                ~ .x/last(.x))) %>% 
  subset(ATO != "Total") %>%
  dplyr::select(-Total)

  dplyr::select(-Total)

# color code muts exclusively in germ or som, and keep common muts as black 
# setdiff syntax matters, here saying check which elements of first vector i.e germline muts not in second vector i.e the overlap of germline and somatic, would need to reverse terms for other way or do union(setdiff(1,2), setdiff(2,1)) to get what is not common in in either vector
# setdiff(x, y) returns the elements of x that are not in y but asymmetric difference, so setdiff(y, x) gives what elements of y are not in x and could be different answer

# which germline muts not in germ and som overlap i.e. exclusive to germline
top_ATO_combined_germ_exclusive <- setdiff(top_ATO_in_germline_vector,

# which somatic muts not in germ and som overlap i.e. exclusive to somatic

# best models are binomial for follow up testing, so define clinical question with binary outcome, make logistic regressions where outcome is binomial, ensure variables used are not collinear with adjusted GVIF < sqrt(5) i.e. 2.23, then rerun regression on training fraction of data and predict on test fraction of data

# first, want to see if demographics predict ATO rescuable mutation status which is binary

# make binomial logistic regression
solecancer_ATO_binom_lm <- stats::glm(formula = ATO ~ Sex + Age_stratum + Cancer_Label + 
                                        #Population + 
                                        Region #+ 
                                      #SIFTClass + DNE_LOFclass + 
                                      #Effect 
                                      #+ Domain + Residue_function
                                      ,
                                      family = "binomial",
                                      data = origdbjustsolecancersover100_forATO %>% 
                                        drop_na(ATO,
                                                Sex,
                                                Age_stratum,
                                                Cancer_Label,
                                                #Population,
                                                Region,
                                                #SIFTClass,
                                                #DNE_LOFclass,
                                                #Effect
                                                #,
                                                #Domain,
                                                #Residue_function
                                        )
)
summary(solecancer_ATO_binom_lm)

# check collinearity of variables used with car::vif
car::vif(solecancer_ATO_binom_lm)

# remove variables with adjusted GVIF > 2.23 i.e. sqrt(5) and likely collinear, and rerun modified model
# modifying model not needed, so create 80% test & 20% train fractions of data for predictive strength of model
set.seed(1212)
# Splitting the data into train and test
index <- caret::createDataPartition(origdbjustsolecancersover100_forATO$ATO, # vector of outcomes
                                    times = 1, # number of partitions to make
                                    p = 0.8, # fraction for training
                                    list = FALSE)
train_data <- origdbjustsolecancersover100_forATO[index, ]
test_data <- origdbjustsolecancersover100_forATO[-index, ]

# Training the model
solecancer_ATO_binom_training_lm <- stats::glm(formula = ATO ~ Sex + Age_stratum + Cancer_Label + 
                                        #Population + 
                                        Region #+ 
                                      #SIFTClass + DNE_LOFclass + 
                                      #Effect 
                                      #+ Domain + Residue_function
                                      ,
                                      family = "binomial",
                                      data = train_data %>% 
                                        drop_na(ATO,
                                                Sex,
                                                Age_stratum,
                                                Cancer_Label,
                                                #Population,
                                                Region,
                                                #SIFTClass,
                                                #DNE_LOFclass,
                                                #Effect
                                                #,
                                                #Domain,
                                                #Residue_function
                                        )
)
summary(solecancer_ATO_binom_training_lm)

# Predicting in the test dataset
pred_prob_solecancer_ATO_binom <- predict(solecancer_ATO_binom_training_lm,
                                          newdata = test_data %>% 
                                            drop_na(ATO,
                                                    Sex,
                                                    Age_stratum,
                                                    Cancer_Label,
                                                    #Population,
                                                    Region,
                                                    #SIFTClass,
                                                    #DNE_LOFclass,
                                                    #Effect
                                                    #,
                                                    #Domain,
                                                    #Residue_function
                                            ),
                                          type = "response")

pred_classes_solecancer_ATO_binom <- ifelse(pred_prob_solecancer_ATO_binom >= 0.5,
                                            "yes", 
                                            "no")

# Create the confusion matrix
# not predicting properly so not pursued further
# cm_solecancer_ATO_binom <- caret::confusionMatrix(table(pred_classes_solecancer_ATO_binom, 
#                                                         test_data$ATO),
#                                                   positive = "yes")

# pairwise prop test to confirm if percent of ATO muts overall in cancers and total differ, so need to make matrix of 2 cols, first is success and second is failures i.e. yes and no, and then send to function, don't need multiple hypothesis correction with p adjustment because these are independent tests made
(soleATOpercancer_pivot %>% 
    dplyr::select(-c(OTHER)) %>% 
    subset(ATO != "Total") %>% 
    remove_rownames() %>% 
    column_to_rownames("ATO") %>% 
    t())[,c(2,1)] %>% 
  stats::pairwise.prop.test(., 
                            p.adjust.method = "none")

(soleATOnotpercancer_pivot %>% 
    dplyr::select(-c(OTHER)) %>% 
    subset(ATO_not != "Total") %>% 
    remove_rownames() %>% 
    column_to_rownames("ATO_not") %>% 
    t())[,c(2,1)] %>% 
  stats::pairwise.prop.test(.,
```

```{r solecancer-age-ATO-lm-multinomial, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
t <- MASS::dropterm(solecancer_age_ATO_lm, 
               trace = FALSE, 
               test = "Chisq") %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  drop_na() %>%
  rownames_to_column("Characteristic") %>%
  arrange(`Pr(Chi)`) %>%
  transform(Sig = dplyr::case_when(`Pr(Chi)` < 0.001 ~ paste0("***"),
                                   `Pr(Chi)` < 0.01 ~ paste0("**"),
                                   `Pr(Chi)` < 0.05 ~ paste0("*"),
                                   `Pr(Chi)` >= 0.05 ~ paste0("NS"))) %>%
  transform(Characteristic = dplyr::case_when(Characteristic == "Effect" ~ "Type",
                                              Characteristic == "Residue_function" ~ "Feature",
                                              Characteristic == "SIFTClass" ~ "SIFT",
                                              Characteristic == "DNE_LOFclass" ~ "DNE",
                                              Characteristic %in% c("Short_topo",
                                                                    "Cancer_Label") ~ "Cancer",
                                              TRUE ~ Characteristic)) %>% 
  transform(Characteristic = ifelse(grepl("_",
                                          Characteristic),
                                    gsub("_",
                                         " ",
                                         Characteristic),
                                    Characteristic)) %>%
  #dplyr::rename(`Pr(Chi)` = `Pr.Chi.`) %>%
  gt() %>% 
  tab_style(style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
            locations = cells_column_labels())
t
```

```{r barchart-pts-ATO-none, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, fig.height = 7, fig.width = 6.75}
barchart_pts_ATO_none <- ggplot(pt_none_ATO_df_ggplot %>% 
                                  subset(ATO == "yes"),
                                aes(x = factor(Patient,
                                               levels = sort(unique(pt_none_ATO_df_ggplot$Patient),
                                                             decreasing = TRUE)[order(c(2,1,3))]), # none, sole, mult
                                    y = Calc, 
                                    fill = factor(Patient,
                                                  levels = sort(unique(pt_none_ATO_df_ggplot$Patient),
                                                                decreasing = TRUE)[order(c(2,1,3))]))) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +   
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(plyr::round_any(Calc * 100, 
                                               0.1),
                               "%")),
            color = "black",
            size = 3.5,
            fontface = "bold",
            alpha = 0.75, # level of transparency (lower is more transparent)
            vjust = -0.5,
            hjust = 0.5) +
  geom_text(aes(label = c(soleATO_pivot %>% subset(ATO == "yes") %>% pull(Total),
                          multATO_pivot %>% subset(ATO == "yes") %>% pull(Total),
                          noneATO_pivot %>% subset(ATO == "yes") %>% pull(Total)
                          ) # original order in dataframe
                ),
            color = "white",
            size = 4,
            fontface = "bold",
            alpha = 0.75, # level of transparency (lower is more transparent)
            y = 0.01,
            hjust = 0.5) + 
  ggtitle("Proportion of Rescuable by ATO Germline Mutations \nin TP53 in Individuals") + 
  xlab("Patient type") +
  ylab("Proportion of distinct individuals") +
  labs(fill = "Patient type") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(), 
                     expand = c(0,0), 
                     breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 6),
                     limits = c(0, plyr::round_any(pt_none_ATO_df_ggplot %>% 
                                                     subset(ATO == "yes") %>%
                                                     pull(Calc) %>%
                                                     max(),
                                                   0.20,
                                                   ceiling) * 1.0000001)) +
  scale_x_discrete(expand = c(0,0)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("darkgray",
                               "#0072B2",
                               "#D55E00")) +
  theme_classic() + 
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, 
                                   hjust = 1, 
                                   vjust = 1), 
        axis.text = element_text(color = "black",
                                 size = 12), 
        axis.title = element_text(color = "black",
                                  face = "bold",
                                  size = 14),
        axis.title.x = element_text(margin = unit(c(10,0,0,0), units = "mm")),
        axis.title.y = element_text(margin = unit(c(0,10,0,0), units = "mm")),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5,
                                  face = "bold",
                                  color = "black",
                                  size = 16,
                                  margin = margin(0,0,10,0, "mm")),
        legend.text = element_text(color = "black",
                                   size = 12),
        legend.title = element_text(color = "black",
                                    face = "bold",
                                    size = 14),
        plot.margin = margin(0,0,0,20, "mm"))
barchart_pts_ATO_none
```

```{r stackedbarchart-pts-ATOperpos, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, fig.height = 7, fig.width = 6}
                                                                                                                                subset(ATO == "no" & grepl("All", 
                                                                                                                                                           Patient))),
                                                                               ATO == "no" & grepl("One", 
                                                                                                   Patient) ~ to_fit_sole/nrow(pt_ATOperpos_df_ggplot %>%
                                                                                                                                 subset(ATO == "no" & grepl("One", 
                                                                                                                                                            Patient))),
                                                                               TRUE ~ Calc_label)), 
                                        aes(x = factor(Patient,
                                                       levels = sort(unique(pt_ATOperpos_df_ggplot$Patient),
                                                                     decreasing = TRUE)[order(c(2,3,1))]), 
                                            y = Calc_label, 
                                            fill = factor(Label,
                                                          levels = c((pt_ATOperpos_df_ggplot %>%
                                                                        arrange(-Calc) %>%
                                                                        pull(Label) %>%
                                                                        unique())[(pt_ATOperpos_df_ggplot %>% 
                                                                                     arrange(-Calc) %>%
                                                                                     pull(Label) %>%
                                                                                     unique()) != "Other"], 
                                                                     "Other")))) + 
  geom_bar(position = "fill", 
           stat = "identity") + 
  ggtitle("Proportion of Rescuable by ATO Germline Mutations \nin TP53 in Individuals with Cancer") + 
  xlab("Patient type") +
  ylab("Proportion of distinct individuals") +
  labs(fill = "Mutation") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(), 
                     expand = c(0,0), 
                     breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 6)) +
  scale_x_discrete(expand = c(0,0)) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c((plyr::round_any(min(pt_ATO_df_ggplot %>% 
                                                  subset(ATO == "no") %>%
                                                  pull(Calc)), 
                                            0.02, 
                                            f = floor)), 1.0000001), # set axis limits in coord_cartesian to zoom in on percentages
                  expand = FALSE) + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(hue_pal()(length(c((pt_ATOperpos_df_ggplot %>%
                                                     arrange(-Calc) %>%
                                                     pull(Label) %>%
                                                     unique())[(pt_ATOperpos_df_ggplot %>% 
                                                                  arrange(-Calc) %>%
                                                                  pull(Label) %>%
                                                                  unique()) != "Other"], 
                                                  "Other"))) %>% 
                                 head(-1),
                               "lightgray")) + # extract automatic gradient colors and replace final one i.e. other with lightgray
  theme_classic() + 
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, 
                                   hjust = 1, 
                                   vjust = 1), 
        axis.text = element_text(color = "black",
                                 size = 12), 
        axis.title = element_text(color = "black",
                                  face = "bold",
                                  size = 14),
        axis.title.x = element_text(margin = unit(c(5,0,0,0), units = "mm")),
        axis.title.y = element_text(margin = unit(c(0,5,0,0), units = "mm")),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5,
                                  face = "bold",
                                  color = "black",
                                  size = 16,
                                  margin = margin(0,0,5,0, "mm")),
        legend.text = element_text(color = "black",
                                   size = 12),
        legend.title = element_text(color = "black",
                                    face = "bold",
                                    size = 14),
        plot.margin = margin(0,0,0,20, "mm"))
```

```{r distribution-ATO-sole, fig.height = 5.5, fig.width = 7.5}
# vectors for pie chart
prop <- n_distinct(pt_ATOperpos_df_ggplot %>%
                     filter(str_detect(Patient, 
                                       "One") & ATO == "yes") %>% 
                     arrange(-Calc) %>%
                     head() %>% 
                     pull(Label) %>%
                     as.vector()) / n_distinct(pt_ATOperpos_df_ggplot %>%
                                                 filter(str_detect(Patient, 
                                                                   "One") & ATO == "yes") %>% 
                                                 arrange(-Calc) %>%
                                                 pull(Label) %>%
                                                 as.vector())
vec <- c(prop,
         1 - prop)
raw <- c(n_distinct(pt_ATOperpos_df_ggplot %>%
                      filter(str_detect(Patient, 
                                        "One") & ATO == "yes") %>% 
                      arrange(-Calc) %>%
                      head() %>% 
                      pull(Label) %>%
                      as.vector()),
         n_distinct(setdiff(unique(pt_ATOperpos_df_ggplot %>%
                                     filter(str_detect(Patient, 
                                                       "One") & ATO == "yes") %>% 
                                     arrange(-Calc) %>%
                                     pull(Label) %>%
                                     as.vector()),
                            unique(pt_ATOperpos_df_ggplot %>%
                                     filter(str_detect(Patient, 
                                                       "One") & ATO == "yes") %>% 
                                     arrange(-Calc) %>%
                                     head() %>% 
                                     pull(Label) %>%
                                     as.vector()))))

# make prevalence waterfall plots (base R barplots + abline at 1%) of all ATO muts in solecancer to justify why 1% chosen for focus in table
barplot(height = sort(as.numeric(pt_ATOperpos_df_ggplot %>%
                                                 filter(str_detect(Patient, 
                                                                   "One") & ATO == "yes") %>% 
                                                 pull(Calc)) %>% na.omit(),
                      decreasing = TRUE),
        xaxs = "i", # remove space between left side of bars and y axis
        ylab = "Proportion of distinct individuals with cancer", 
        xlab = "", # "p53 mutation" text is cutting into labels otherwise
        main = "ATO-Rescuable p53 Mutations in Individuals with Cancer",
        names.arg = pt_ATOperpos_df_ggplot %>% filter(str_detect(Patient, "One") & ATO == "yes") %>% arrange(-Calc) %>% pull(Label) %>% as.vector(),
        font.lab = 2,
        ylim = c(0, plyr::round_any(max(pt_ATOperpos_df_ggplot %>%
                                                 filter(str_detect(Patient, 
                                                                   "One") & ATO == "yes") %>% 
                                                 pull(Calc),
                                        na.rm = TRUE),
                                    0.05,
                                    f = ceiling)),
        col = ifelse((pt_ATOperpos_df_ggplot %>%
                        filter(str_detect(Patient, 
                                          "One") & ATO == "yes") %>% 
                        arrange(-Calc) %>%
                        pull(Label) %>%
                        as.vector()) %in% (pt_ATOperpos_df_ggplot %>%
                                             filter(str_detect(Patient, 
                                                               "One") & ATO == "yes") %>% 
                                             arrange(-Calc) %>%
                                             head() %>% 
                                             pull(Label) %>%
                                             as.vector()),
                     "black",
                     "grey"),
        las = 2,
        space = 0,
        border = NA)
abline(h = 0.01,
       col = "red",
       lty = 2,
       lwd = 2)
legend("right",
       legend = c("Subset", 
                  "Other"),
       col = c("black", 
               "gray"),
       bty = "n", # no border around legend
       pch = 15, # filled square shape
       pt.cex = 1.75) # increase shape size in legend
axis(side = 1, 
     at = seq(0.5, 
              length(pt_ATOperpos_df_ggplot %>%
                       filter(str_detect(Patient, 
                                         "One") & ATO == "yes") %>% 
                       arrange(-Calc) %>%
                       pull(Label) %>%
                       as.vector()) - 0.5, 
              1), 
     tick = TRUE, 
     labels = FALSE)

# pie chart
pie(vec,
    main = "ATO-Rescuable p53 Mutations in Individuals with Cancer",
    labels = paste0(plyr::round_any(vec * 100,
                                    0.1),
                    "% (",
                    format(raw, 
                           big.mark = ",", 
                           trim = TRUE),
                    " mutations)"),
    col = c("black", "grey"),
    border = NA,
    clockwise = TRUE)
```

```{r top-ATO-sole-damaging-grid, fig.height = 4.75, fig.width = 12.75, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
                                                               DNE_LOFclass, 
                                                               BayesDel,
                                                               REVEL, 
                                                               Polyphen2,
                                                               AGVGDClass, 
                                                               DNEclass)) %>% 
                   mutate(Polyphen2 = dplyr::case_when(Polyphen2 == "D" ~ "Probably damaging",
                                                       Polyphen2 == "P" ~ "Possibly damaging",
                                                       Polyphen2 == "B" ~ "Benign",
                                                       TRUE ~ Polyphen2)) %>% 
                                               dplyr::rename(Mutation = ProtDescription, 
                                                             `Transactivation Class` = TransactivationClass,
                                                             `SIFT Class` = SIFTClass, 
                                                             `DNE_LOF Class` = DNE_LOFclass, 
                                                             PolyPhen2 = Polyphen2,
                                                             `Align-GVGD Class` = AGVGDClass, 
                                                             DNE = DNEclass) %>%
                                               arrange(abs(parse_number(Mutation))) %>%
                                               replace(is.na(.),
                                                       "") %>% 
                                               distinct()) %>% 
  theme_grob(rows = NULL, 
             theme = ttheme_default(base_size = 10,
                                    core = list(padding = unit(c(15, 4), "mm")))) %>%
  condformat2grob(draw = FALSE)

top_ATO_sole_damaging_grid <- grid.arrange(top_ATO_sole_damaging_gridprep,
                                  top = textGrob("Selected p53 Mutants Tests or Predictions of Damaging Function",
                                                 hjust = 0.5,
                                                 gp = gpar(fontface = "bold")))
```

```{r stackedbarchart-sole-ATO-cancers-horiz, fig.height = 4.25, fig.width = 10, warning = FALSE}
stackedbarchart_pts_ATO_cancers_horiz <- ggplot(soleATOpercancer_pivot_melted %>%

  geom_bar(position = position_fill(reverse = TRUE),

  ),

  position = position_fill(reverse = TRUE),
  color = "black",

  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0,

        axis.title = element_text(color = "black",
```
