```{r stackedbarchart-sole-ATO-cancers-pos, fig.height = 6.75, fig.width = 8, results = 'hide', warning = FALSE}
                                                                                                                                                                                subset(ATO == "no" & Cancer == as.character(to_fit$Cancer[3]))),
                                                                                           ATO == "no" & Cancer == as.character(to_fit$Cancer[4]) ~ to_fit$Proportion[4]/nrow(soleATOpercancerpos_pivot_melted %>%
                                                                                                                                                                                subset(ATO == "no" & Cancer == as.character(to_fit$Cancer[4]))),
                                                                                           ATO == "no" & Cancer == as.character(to_fit$Cancer[5]) ~ to_fit$Proportion[5]/nrow(soleATOpercancerpos_pivot_melted %>%
                                                                                                                                                                                subset(ATO == "no" & Cancer == as.character(to_fit$Cancer[5]))),
                                                                                           ATO == "no" & Cancer == as.character(to_fit$Cancer[6]) ~ to_fit$Proportion[6]/nrow(soleATOpercancerpos_pivot_melted %>%
                                                                                                                                                                                subset(ATO == "no" & Cancer == as.character(to_fit$Cancer[6]))),
                                                                                           TRUE ~ Proportion_label)), 
                                              aes(x = factor(Cancer,
                                                             levels = soleATOpercancer_pivot_melted %>%

                                                               arrange(-Proportion) %>% 
                                                               pull(Cancer) %>% 
                                                               unique() %>%

                                                                levels = c((soleATOpercancerpos_pivot_melted %>%

                                                                                           unique()) != "Other"], 
                                                                           "Other")))) + 
  geom_bar(position = "fill", 
           stat = "identity") + 
  ggtitle("Proportion of Rescuable by ATO Germline Mutations \nin TP53 in Individuals with Cancer") + 
  xlab("Cancer") +
  ylab("Proportion of distinct individuals") +
  labs(fill = "Mutation") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(), 
                     expand = c(0,0), 
                     breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 7)) +
  scale_x_discrete(expand = c(0,0)) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c((plyr::round_any(min(to_fit$Proportion), 
                                            0.05, 
                                            f = floor)), 1.0000001), # set axis limits in coord_cartesian to zoom in on percentages
                  expand = FALSE) + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(hue_pal()(length(c((soleATOpercancerpos_pivot_melted %>%
                                                     arrange(-Proportion) %>%
                                                     pull(Label) %>%
                                                     unique())[(soleATOpercancerpos_pivot_melted %>% 
                                                                  arrange(-Proportion) %>%
                                                                  pull(Label) %>%
                                                                  unique()) != "Other"],

                                 head(-1),

  theme_classic() +

        axis.title.x = element_text(margin = unit(c(5,0,0,0), units = "mm")),

        legend.title = element_text(color = "black",
```

```{r sole-ATO-age-boxplot-stats, warning = FALSE, fig.height = 7.5, fig.width = 8.5}
# boxplot of whether Rescuable by ATO mutations affects ages of dx
sole_ATO_age_boxplot <- ggplot(
  # origdbjustsolecancersover100_forATO %>% 
  #                                   dplyr::select(c(Individual_code,
  #                                                   Age_at_diagnosis,
  #                                                   ATO,
  #                                                   Sex,
  #                                                   Cancer_Label)) %>% 
  #                                   distinct() %>% # remove pts with mult muts where one has ATO 
  #                                   subset(!(Individual_code %in% (origdbjustsolecancersover100_forATO %>% 
  #                                              dplyr::select(c(Individual_code,
  #                                                              Age_at_diagnosis,
  #                                                              ATO,
  #                                                              Sex,
  #                                                              Cancer_Label)) %>% 
  #                                              distinct() %>% 
  #                                              count(Individual_code) %>% 
  #                                              subset(n > 1) %>% 
  #                                              pull(Individual_code))))
  ATOchisq_df %>% 
    subset(!str_detect(Cancer_Label, 
                       "OTHER")),
  aes(y = Age_at_diagnosis,
      x = relevel(as.factor(ATO), 
                  ref = "yes"))) + 
  stat_boxplot(geom = "errorbar", # to put bars at end of IQRs
               width = 0.4) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
  stat_compare_means(method = "wilcox.test",
                     paired = FALSE,
                     hjust = -0.25) +
  geom_jitter(aes(color = Cancer_Label,
                  shape = Sex),
              width = 0.3,
              height = 0,
              alpha = 0.5,
              size = 2) + 
  scale_color_manual(values = c("maroon","#D55E00","#009E73","#0072B2","darkgray"
                                #,
                                #"purple"
                                #"black"
  ),
  name = "Cancer") + 
  scale_y_continuous(n.breaks = 7,
                     limits = c(0, 100)) +
  ylab("Age when diagnosed (years)") +
  xlab("Rescuable by ATO Mutation") +
  ggtitle("Ages of diagnosis in Individuals \nwith Rescuable by ATO Germline Mutations") + 
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text = element_text(color = "black",
                                 size = 12),
```

```{r ATO-chisq-tests}
# chi square tests for associations between Rescuable by ATO alterations and sex, cancer, age strata, or pts in general

                                  ATOchisq_df$ATO)))

stats::chisq.test(as.matrix(table(ATOchisq_df$Cancer_Label, 
                                  ATOchisq_df$ATO)))

stats::chisq.test(as.matrix(table(ATOchisq_df$Age_stratum, 
                                  ATOchisq_df$ATO)))

stats::chisq.test(as.matrix(table(ATOchisq_df$Dead, 
                                  ATOchisq_df$ATO)))

stats::chisq.test(as.matrix(table(ATOchisq_df$AGVGDClass, 
                                  ATOchisq_df$ATO)))

stats::chisq.test(as.matrix(table(ATOchisq_df$BayesDel, 
                                  ATOchisq_df$ATO)))

stats::chisq.test(as.matrix(table(ATOchisq_df$REVEL, 
                                  ATOchisq_df$ATO)))

stats::chisq.test(as.matrix(table(ATOchisq_df$SIFTClass, 
                                  ATOchisq_df$ATO)))

stats::chisq.test(as.matrix(table(ATOchisq_df$Polyphen2, 
                                  ATOchisq_df$ATO)))
```

```{r gt-summary-ATO-vs-transact, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE}
t <- tbl_summary(ATOchisq_df %>% 
                   subset(!str_detect(Cancer_Label,
                                      "OTHER")) %>%
                   mutate(TransactivationClass = factor(TransactivationClass, 
                                                        levels = c("non-functional",
                                                                   "partially functional",
                                                                   "functional",
                                                                   "supertrans"))) %>% 
                   dplyr::select(c(ATO,
                                   TransactivationClass)), 
                 by = ATO,
                 label = list(TransactivationClass ~ "Transactivation Class")
                 #,
                 #sort = list(everything() ~ "frequency")
                 ) %>% 
  add_p(test.args = all_tests("fisher.test") ~ list(workspace = 2e9),
        pvalue_fun = pvalue_with_stars) %>% 
  add_stat_label() %>% 
  bold_labels() %>%
  as_gt()
t
```

$~$

```{r save-gt-summary-ATO-vs-transact, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE}
gt::gtsave(t, 
           file = paste0(fig_path, 
                         "sole-ATO-vs-transact.png"))
```

```{r corrplot-resid-ATO-vs-cancers, fig.height = 5, fig.width = 5, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE}
chisq <- stats::chisq.test(as.matrix((ATOchisq_df %>% 
                                        subset(!str_detect(Cancer_Label,
                                                           "OTHER")) %>% 
                                        dplyr::select(c(Cancer_Label, 
                                                        ATO)) %>% 
                                        table())
                                     ))

# Contibution in percentage (%)
contrib <- 100*chisq$residuals^2/chisq$statistic

corrplot::corrplot(chisq$residuals, 
                   is.corr = FALSE,
                   tl.col = "black", # label colors
                   cl.cex = 1, # legend font size
                   cl.ratio = 0.75, # legend scale width
                   tl.srt = 45, # rotate top labels
                   cl.align.text = "l") # align numbers to side of legend
```

# **Drawing Sole vs Multiple Pt Ages of Diagnosis Boxplots** {#solevsmultagesboxplots}

$~$

```{r sole-vs-mult-ages-of-dx-prep, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, results = 'hide'}
# create dataframe for boxplots with stats of sole pts vs mult pts first ages of dx to see if mult have cancers earlier
sole_vs_mult_ages_boxplot_df <- rbind(origdbjustsolecancersover100 %>% 
                                        dplyr::select(c(Individual_code,
                                                        Age_at_diagnosis,
                                                        Sex,
                                                        Cancer_Label)) %>% 
                                        distinct() %>% 
                                        transform(Patient = paste0("One cancer (",
                                                                   nrow(.),
                                                                   " individuals)")),
                                      origdbjustmultcancersover100 %>% 
                                        dplyr::select(c(Individual_code,
                                                        Age_at_diagnosis,
                                                        Sex,
                                                        Cancer_Label)) %>% 
                                        distinct() %>% 
                                        transform(Patient = paste0("First of multiple cancers (",
                                                                   nrow(.),
                                                                   " individuals)")))

sole_mult_none_ages_boxplot_df <- full_join(breakdown %>% subset(Unaffected == "true") %>% 
                                              dplyr::select(c(Individual_code,
                                                              Age,
                                                              Sex,
                                                              Cancer_Label)) %>% 
                                              mutate(Cancer_Label = ifelse(Cancer_Label != "OTHER", 
                                                                           Cancer_Label, 
                                                                           "No cancer")) %>% 
                                              distinct() %>% 
                                              mutate(Patient = paste0("No cancer (",
                                                                      nrow(.),
                                                                      " individuals)")),
                                            sole_vs_mult_ages_boxplot_df %>% 
                                              dplyr::rename(Age = Age_at_diagnosis) %>% 
                                              distinct())
```

$~$

```{r sole-vs-mult-ages-of-dx-boxplot, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, fig.height = 10, fig.width = 8, include = FALSE}
set.seed(1212) # for consistent jitter

# draw boxplots with stats of sole vs mult first cancer ages
sole_vs_mult_ages_of_dx_boxplot <- ggplot(sole_vs_mult_ages_boxplot_df %>%
                                            mutate(Patient = gsub(" \\(.*", "", Patient)) %>% 
                                            mutate(Sex = dplyr::case_when(Sex == "F" ~ "Female",
                                                                          Sex == "M" ~ "Male",
                                                                          TRUE ~ "notyet")) %>% 
                                            subset(!str_detect(Cancer_Label,
                                                               "OTHER"))
                                          ,
                                          aes(y = Age_at_diagnosis,
                                              x = # Patient
                                                relevel(as.factor(Patient),
                                                        ref = "One cancer")
                                          )
) + 
  stat_boxplot(geom = "errorbar", # to put bars at end of IQRs
               width = 0.4) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
  stat_summary(fun.data = stat_box_data, 
               geom = "text", 
               hjust = 0.5,
               vjust = 0.1) + 
  stat_compare_means(method = "wilcox.test",
                     paired = FALSE,
                     hjust = -0.25) +
  geom_jitter(aes(color = Cancer_Label,
                  shape = Sex),
              width = 0.3,
              height = 0,
              alpha = 0.5,
              seed = 1212,
              size = 2) + 
  scale_color_manual(values = c("maroon","#D55E00","#009E73","#0072B2","purple", "darkgray"
                                #,
                                #"purple"
                                #"black"
  ),
  name = "Cancer") + 
  scale_y_continuous(n.breaks = 7,
                     limits = c(0, 100)) +
  ylab("Age when (first) diagnosed (years)") +
  xlab("Individuals") +
  ggtitle("Ages of (first) diagnoses in Individuals with Cancer") + 
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text = element_text(color = "black",
                                 size = 12),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45,
                                   hjust = 1),
        axis.title = element_text(color = "black",
                                  size = 14,
                                  face = "bold"),
        axis.title.x = element_text(margin = unit(c(5,0,0,0), "mm")),
        axis.title.y = element_text(margin = unit(c(0,5,0,0), "mm")),
        legend.title = element_text(color = "black",
                                    size = 14,
                                    face = "bold"),
        legend.text = element_text(color = "black",
                                   size = 12),
        plot.title = element_text(color = "black",
                                  size = 16,
                                  face = "bold",
                                  margin = unit(c(0,0,5,0), "mm"),
                                  hjust = 0.5))
sole_vs_mult_ages_of_dx_boxplot
```

```{r sole-mult-none-ages-of-dx-followup-boxplot, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, fig.height = 11, fig.width = 9, include = FALSE}
set.seed(1212) # for consistent jitter

# draw boxplots with stats of sole vs mult vs none first cancer ages or followup
sole_mult_none_ages_of_dx_followup_boxplot <- ggplot(sole_mult_none_ages_boxplot_df %>%
                                                       mutate(Patient = gsub(" \\(.*", "", Patient)) %>% 
                                                       mutate(Sex = dplyr::case_when(Sex == "F" ~ "Female",
                                                                                     Sex == "M" ~ "Male",
                                                                                     TRUE ~ "notyet")) %>% 
                                                       subset(!str_detect(Cancer_Label,
                                                                          "OTHER"))
                                                     ,
                                                     aes(y = Age,
                                                         x = # Patient
                                                           relevel(as.factor(Patient),
                                                                   ref = "One cancer")
                                                     )
) + 
  stat_boxplot(geom = "errorbar", # to put bars at end of IQRs
               width = 0.4) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
  stat_summary(fun.data = stat_box_data, 
               geom = "text", 
               hjust = 0.5,
               vjust = 0.1) + 
    stat_compare_means(paired = FALSE,
                       label.y = 142) + # Add global p-value
    geom_pwc(method = "dunn_test", # stat_compare_means w/ comparisons for Kruskal Wallis does not show p-adj
             p.adjust.method = "BH", # thus must manually add pairwise Dunn with BH adjustment
             bracket.nudge.y = 0.2, # nudge brackets by fraction of total height
             vjust = 0.3, # decrease gaps between labels and brackets
             tip.length = 0.02, # set length of tips on brackets
             size = 0.5, # change width of bracket lines
             label.size = 4, # change size of label text
             step.increase = 0.1, # decrease gaps between brackets
             hide.ns = TRUE,
             label = "p.adj.signif") + # to just show stars for significance
  geom_jitter(aes(color = Cancer_Label,
                  shape = Sex),
              width = 0.3,
              height = 0,
              alpha = 0.5,
              seed = 1212,
              size = 2) + 
  scale_color_manual(values = c("maroon","#D55E00","#009E73", "black","#0072B2","purple"
                                #,
                                #"purple"
                                #"slategray"
  ),
  name = "Cancer") + 
  scale_y_continuous(n.breaks = 7,
                     limits = c(0, 150)) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off"
                  # , # prevent y-axis extending when brackets added so brackets drawn outside plot
                  # ylim = c(0, 100)
                  ) +
  ylab("Age when (first) diagnosed or at last follow up (years)") +
  xlab("Individuals") +
  ggtitle("Ages of (first) diagnoses or last follow up \nin Individuals with Cancer") + 
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text = element_text(color = "black",
                                 size = 12),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45,
                                   hjust = 1),
        axis.title = element_text(color = "black",
                                  size = 14,
                                  face = "bold"),
        axis.title.x = element_text(margin = unit(c(5,0,0,0), "mm")),
        axis.title.y = element_text(margin = unit(c(0,5,0,0), "mm")),
        legend.title = element_text(color = "black",
                                    size = 14,
                                    face = "bold"),
        legend.text = element_text(color = "black",
                                   size = 12),
        plot.title = element_text(color = "black",
                                  size = 16,
                                  face = "bold",
                                  margin = unit(c(0,0,5,0), "mm"),
                                  hjust = 0.5))
sole_mult_none_ages_of_dx_followup_boxplot
```

```{r sole-mult-none-ages-of-dx-followup-pval-boxplot, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, fig.height = 11, fig.width = 9, include = FALSE}
                                                       mutate(Sex = dplyr::case_when(Sex == "F" ~ "Female",
                                                                                     Sex == "M" ~ "Male",
                                                                                     TRUE ~ "notyet")) %>% 
                                                       subset(!str_detect(Cancer_Label,
                                                                          "OTHER"))
                                                     ,
                                                     aes(y = Age,
                                                         x = # Patient
                                                           relevel(as.factor(Patient),
                                                                   ref = "One cancer")
                                                     )
) + 
  stat_boxplot(geom = "errorbar", # to put bars at end of IQRs
               width = 0.4) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
  stat_summary(fun.data = stat_box_data, 
               geom = "text", 
               hjust = 0.5,
               vjust = 0.1) + 
    stat_compare_means(paired = FALSE,
                       label.y = 142) + # Add global p-value
    geom_pwc(method = "dunn_test", # stat_compare_means w/ comparisons for Kruskal Wallis does not show p-adj
             p.adjust.method = "BH", # thus must manually add pairwise Dunn with BH adjustment
             bracket.nudge.y = 0.2, # nudge brackets by fraction of total height
             vjust = 0.1, # decrease gaps between labels and brackets
             tip.length = 0.02, # set length of tips on brackets
             size = 0.5, # change width of bracket lines
             label.size = 4, # change size of label text
             step.increase = 0.1, # decrease gaps between brackets
             hide.ns = TRUE,
             label = "p = {p.adj}") +
  geom_jitter(aes(color = Cancer_Label,
                  shape = Sex),
              width = 0.3,
              height = 0,
              alpha = 0.5,
              seed = 1212,
              size = 2) + 
  scale_color_manual(values = c("maroon","#D55E00","#009E73", "black","#0072B2","purple"
                                #,

  name = "Cancer") + 
  scale_y_continuous(n.breaks = 7,

  ylab("Age when (first) diagnosed or at last follow up (years)") +
  xlab("Individuals") +

  theme(axis.text = element_text(color = "black",
```

```{r sole-vs-mult-ACC-ages-of-dx-boxplot, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, fig.height = 8, fig.width = 7, include = FALSE}
set.seed(1212) # for consistent jitter

# draw boxplots with stats of sole vs mult first cancer ages
sole_vs_mult_ACC_ages_of_dx_boxplot <- ggplot(sole_vs_mult_ages_boxplot_df %>% 
                                                subset(Cancer_Label == "Adrenal cortical carcinoma") %>% 
                                                transform(Patient = gsub(" \\(.*", 
                                                                         "",
                                                                         Patient)),
                                              aes(y = Age_at_diagnosis,
                                                  x = relevel(as.factor(Patient), ref = "One cancer"))) + 
  stat_boxplot(geom = "errorbar", # to put bars at end of IQRs
               width = 0.4) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
  stat_compare_means(method = "wilcox.test",
                     paired = FALSE,
                     hjust = -0.25) +
  geom_jitter(aes(color = Sex),
              width = 0.3,
              height = 0,
              alpha = 0.5,
              seed = 1212,
              size = 2) + 
  scale_y_continuous(n.breaks = 7,
                     limits = c(0, 100)) +
  ylab("Age when (first) diagnosed (years)") +
  xlab("Individuals") +
  ggtitle("Ages of (first) diagnoses in Individuals with ACC") + 
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text = element_text(color = "black",
                                 size = 12),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45,
                                   hjust = 1),
        axis.title = element_text(color = "black",
                                  size = 14,
                                  face = "bold"),
        axis.title.x = element_text(margin = unit(c(5,0,0,0), "mm")),
        axis.title.y = element_text(margin = unit(c(0,5,0,0), "mm")),
        legend.title = element_text(color = "black",
                                    size = 14,
                                    face = "bold"),
        legend.text = element_text(color = "black",
                                   size = 12),
        plot.title = element_text(color = "black",
                                  size = 16,
                                  face = "bold",
                                  margin = unit(c(0,0,5,0), "mm"),
                                  hjust = 0.5))
```

```{r sole-vs-mult-other-ages-of-dx-boxplot, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, fig.height = 8, fig.width = 7, include = FALSE}
  stat_compare_means(method = "wilcox.test",
                     paired = FALSE,
                     hjust = -0.25) +
  geom_jitter(aes(color = Sex),
              width = 0.3,
              height = 0,
              alpha = 0.5,
              seed = 1212,
              size = 2) + 
  scale_y_continuous(n.breaks = 7,
                     limits = c(0, 100)) +
  ylab("Age when (first) diagnosed (years)") +
  xlab("Individuals") +
  ggtitle("Ages of (first) diagnoses in Individuals with Other Tumors") + 
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text = element_text(color = "black",
                                 size = 12),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45,
                                   hjust = 1),
        axis.title = element_text(color = "black",
                                  size = 14,
                                  face = "bold"),
        axis.title.x = element_text(margin = unit(c(5,0,0,0), "mm")),
        axis.title.y = element_text(margin = unit(c(0,5,0,0), "mm")),
        legend.title = element_text(color = "black",
                                    size = 14,
                                    face = "bold"),
        legend.text = element_text(color = "black",
                                   size = 12),
        plot.title = element_text(color = "black",
                                  size = 16,
                                  face = "bold",
                                  margin = unit(c(0,0,5,0), "mm"),
                                  hjust = 0.5))
sole_vs_mult_other_ages_of_dx_boxplot
```

```{r time-to-event-prep, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
  transform(ACC = ifelse(Short_topo == "Adrenal cortical carcinoma",

  # transform(Cancer_vs_mut_cluster_coxph = dplyr::case_when(Cancer_vs_mut_cluster %in% c(1, 6) ~ "clusters 1 and 6",

  dplyr::select(c(Individual_code,

  )) %>%
  distinct()

# df for Kaplan-Meier survival of certain muts i.e. age for follow up, death noted, specific muts examined
KMdf <- origdbjustsolecancersover100 %>%
  subset(ProtDescription %in% c("R248Q",
                                "G245S",
                                "R248W")) %>%
  mutate(Dead_KM = ifelse(Dead == "true",
                          1,
                          0)) %>%
  dplyr::select(c(Individual_code,
                  Dead, 
                  Dead_KM,
                  # Age, # at follow up but not annotated for all patients
                  Age_at_diagnosis,
                  # Age_dx_follow,
                  ProtDescription,
  )) %>%
  mutate_at(c('ProtDescription'),
            as.factor) %>%
  distinct() 

KMdf$ProtDescription <- relevel(KMdf$ProtDescription,
                                ref = "R248Q")


# want to now see that if specific ACC-enriched mutations but did not have ACC first, how likely are they to get ACC at some point? thus, retain age of last cancer dx in mult pts, 
curvedf_mult <- origdbmultcancer %>% 
  dplyr::select(c(Individual_code,
                  Age_at_diagnosis,
                  Sex,
                  Short_topo,
                  ProtDescription,
                  cancer_incidence)) %>% 
  transform(ACCfirst = ifelse(cancer_incidence == 1 & Short_topo == "Adrenal cortical carcinoma",
                              "ACC-first",
                              "Other-first")) %>% # carry over to all pts' entries
  transform(ACCfirst = ifelse(Individual_code %in% (.[which(.$ACCfirst == "ACC-first"),
                                                      "Individual_code"]),
                              "ACC-first",
                              ACCfirst)) %>% 
  transform(ACC = ifelse(Short_topo == "Adrenal cortical carcinoma",
                         1,
                         0)) %>% # carry over to all pts' entries
  transform(ACC = ifelse(Individual_code %in% (.[which(.$ACC == 1),
                                                 "Individual_code"]),
                         1,
                         ACC)) %>% 
  transform(Mutation = ifelse(ProtDescription %in% c("T125T",
                                                     "P152L",
                                                     "R158H"),
                              "T125T, P152L, R158H",
                              "Other-mut")) %>% # carry over to all pts' entries
  transform(Mutation = ifelse(Individual_code %in% (.[which(.$Mutation == "T125T, P152L, R158H"),
                                                      "Individual_code"]),
                              "T125T, P152L, R158H",
                              Mutation)) %>% 
  group_by(Individual_code) %>% # get latest cancer for each pt rows only
  slice(which.max(cancer_incidence)) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  dplyr::select(c(Age_at_diagnosis,
                  ACC,
                  Mutation,
                  Sex,
                  ACCfirst)) %>%
  mutate_at(c('Mutation',
              'Sex',
              'ACCfirst'),
            as.factor)
```

```{r gt-summary-ACC-sole-clustermuts-vs-age, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE}
t <- tbl_summary(origdbjustsolecancersover100 %>% 
                   subset(Short_topo == "Adrenal cortical carcinoma") %>% 
                   mutate(keymuts_or_not = ifelse(ProtDescription %in% c("T125T",
                                                                         "P152L",
                                                                         "R158H"),
                                                  "yes",
                                                  "no")) %>% 
                   distinct() %>% 
                   dplyr::select(c(Age_at_diagnosis,
                                   keymuts_or_not)), 
                 by = keymuts_or_not,
                 label = list(Age_at_diagnosis ~ "Age of cancer diagnosis")

                 #sort = list(everything() ~ "frequency")

  add_p(pvalue_fun = pvalue_with_stars) %>% 
  add_stat_label() %>% 
  bold_labels() %>%
  as_gt()
```

```{r ACC-sole-clustermuts-vs-age-boxplot, fig.height = 8, fig.width = 6.5, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE}
# define df for plot
df_cluster_age_plot <- origdbjustsolecancersover100 %>% 
  subset(Short_topo == "Adrenal cortical carcinoma") %>% 
  mutate(keymuts_or_not = ifelse(ProtDescription %in% c("T125T",
                                                        "P152L",
                                                        "R158H"),
                                 "T125T, P152L, or R158H",
                                 "Other")) %>% 
  mutate(Sex = dplyr::case_when(Sex == "F" ~ "Female",
                                Sex == "M" ~ "Male",
                                TRUE ~ "notyet")) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  dplyr::select(c(Age_at_diagnosis,
                  keymuts_or_not,
                  Sex))

# plot
set.seed(1212) # for consistent jitter
ACC_sole_clustermuts_vs_age_boxplot <- ggplot(df_cluster_age_plot,
                                              aes(y = Age_at_diagnosis,
                                                  x = relevel(as.factor(keymuts_or_not), 
                                                              ref = "T125T, P152L, or R158H"))) + 
  stat_boxplot(geom = "errorbar", # to put bars at end of IQRs
               width = 0.4) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
  stat_summary(fun.data = stat_box_data, 
               geom = "text", 
               hjust = 0.5,
               vjust = 0.1) + 
  stat_compare_means(method = "wilcox.test",
                     paired = FALSE,
                     hjust = -0.25) +
  geom_jitter(aes(color = Sex),
              width = 0.3,
              height = 0,
              alpha = 0.5,
              seed = 1212,
              size = 2) + 
  scale_color_manual(values = c("maroon", 
                                "#0072B2"), 
                     labels = c("F" = "Female",
                                "M" = "Male"),
                     name = "Sex") + 
  scale_y_continuous(n.breaks = 7,
                     limits = c(0, 60)) +
  ylab("Age when diagnosed (years)") +
  xlab("p53 mutant") +
  ggtitle("Ages of diagnoses in Individuals with ACC") + 
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text = element_text(color = "black",
                                 size = 12),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45,
                                   hjust = 1),
        axis.title = element_text(color = "black",
                                  size = 14,
                                  face = "bold"),
        axis.title.x = element_text(margin = unit(c(5,0,0,0), "mm")),
        axis.title.y = element_text(margin = unit(c(0,5,0,0), "mm")),
        legend.title = element_text(color = "black",
                                    size = 14,
                                    face = "bold"),
        legend.text = element_text(color = "black",
                                   size = 12),
        plot.title = element_text(color = "black",
                                  size = 16,
                                  face = "bold",
                                  margin = unit(c(0,0,5,0), "mm"),
                                  hjust = 0.5))
```

```{r time-to-ACC-coxforest, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, fig.height = 15, fig.width = 14}
# forest plot of Cox proportional hazard model of predictors tested in time to event
# install this fork to survminer to allow very large or small HR and CIs to plot
detach("package:survminer", unload = TRUE)
remotes::install_github("rschauner/survminer")
library(survminer)

# change function to allow proper plotting
# trace(ggforest, edit = TRUE) and copy and paste current function code to remove Error in `[.data.frame`(data, , var, with = FALSE) : unused argument (with = FALSE)
ggforest2 <- function (model, data = NULL, main = "Hazard ratio", cpositions = c(0.02, 
                                                                                 0.22, 0.4), fontsize = 0.7, refLabel = "reference", noDigits = 2) 
{
  conf.high <- conf.low <- estimate <- NULL
  stopifnot(inherits(model, "coxph"))
  data <- survminer:::.get_data(model, data = data)
  terms <- attr(model$terms, "dataClasses")[-1]
  coef <- as.data.frame(broom::tidy(model, conf.int = TRUE))
  gmodel <- broom::glance(model)
  allTerms <- lapply(seq_along(terms), function(i) {
    var <- names(terms)[i]
    if (terms[i] %in% c("factor", "character")) {
      adf <- as.data.frame(table(data[, var])) # removed with = FALSE here
      cbind(var = var, adf, pos = 1:nrow(adf))
    }
    else if (terms[i] == "numeric") {
      data.frame(var = var, Var1 = "", Freq = nrow(data), 
                 pos = 1)
    }
    else {
      vars <- grep(paste0("^", var, "*."), coef$term, 
                   value = TRUE)
      data.frame(var = vars, Var1 = "", Freq = nrow(data), 
                 pos = seq_along(vars))
    }
  })
  allTermsDF <- do.call(rbind, allTerms)
  colnames(allTermsDF) <- c("var", "level", "N", "pos")
  inds <- apply(allTermsDF[, 1:2], 1, paste0, collapse = "")
  rownames(coef) <- gsub(coef$term, pattern = "`", replacement = "")
  toShow <- cbind(allTermsDF, coef[inds, ])[, c("var", "level", 
                                                "N", "p.value", "estimate", "conf.low", "conf.high", 
                                                "pos")]
  toShowExp <- toShow[, 5:7]
  toShowExp[is.na(toShowExp)] <- 0
  toShowExp <- format(exp(toShowExp), digits = noDigits)
  toShowExpClean <- data.frame(toShow, pvalue = signif(toShow[, 
                                                              4], noDigits + 1), toShowExp)
  toShowExpClean$stars <- paste0(round(toShowExpClean$p.value, 
                                       noDigits + 1), " ", ifelse(toShowExpClean$p.value < 
                                                                    0.05, "*", ""), ifelse(toShowExpClean$p.value < 0.01, 
                                                                                           "*", ""), ifelse(toShowExpClean$p.value < 0.001, "*", 
                                                                                                            ""))
  toShowExpClean$ci <- paste0("(", toShowExpClean[, "conf.low.1"], 
                              " - ", toShowExpClean[, "conf.high.1"], ")")
  toShowExpClean$estimate.1[is.na(toShowExpClean$estimate)] <- refLabel
  toShowExpClean$stars[which(toShowExpClean$p.value < 0.001)] <- "<0.001 ***"
  toShowExpClean$stars[is.na(toShowExpClean$estimate)] <- ""
  toShowExpClean$ci[is.na(toShowExpClean$estimate)] <- ""
  toShowExpClean$estimate[is.na(toShowExpClean$estimate)] <- 0
  toShowExpClean$var <- as.character(toShowExpClean$var)
  toShowExpClean$var[duplicated(toShowExpClean$var)] <- ""
  toShowExpClean$N <- paste0("(N=", toShowExpClean$N, ")")
  toShowExpClean <- toShowExpClean[nrow(toShowExpClean):1, 
  ]
  ci_h <- toShowExpClean$conf.high[is.finite(as.numeric(toShowExpClean$conf.high.1))]
  ci_l <- toShowExpClean$conf.low[!near(as.numeric(toShowExpClean$conf.low.1), 
                                        0)]
  toShowExpClean$conf.high[is.infinite(as.numeric(toShowExpClean$conf.high.1))] <- max(ci_h, 
                                                                                       na.rm = TRUE)
  toShowExpClean$conf.low[near(as.numeric(toShowExpClean$conf.low.1), 
                               0)] <- min(ci_l, na.rm = TRUE)
  rangeb <- range(toShowExpClean$conf.low, toShowExpClean$conf.high, 
                  na.rm = TRUE)
  breaks <- axisTicks(rangeb/2, log = TRUE, nint = 7)
  rangeplot <- rangeb
  rangeplot[1] <- rangeplot[1] - diff(rangeb)
  rangeplot[2] <- rangeplot[2] + 0.15 * diff(rangeb)
  width <- diff(rangeplot)
  y_variable <- rangeplot[1] + cpositions[1] * width
  y_nlevel <- rangeplot[1] + cpositions[2] * width
  y_cistring <- rangeplot[1] + cpositions[3] * width
  y_stars <- rangeb[2]
  x_annotate <- seq_len(nrow(toShowExpClean))
  annot_size_mm <- fontsize * as.numeric(grid::convertX(unit(theme_get()$text$size, 
                                                             "pt"), "mm"))
  p <- ggplot(toShowExpClean, aes(seq_along(var), exp(estimate))) + 
    geom_rect(aes(xmin = seq_along(var) - 0.5, xmax = seq_along(var) + 
                    0.5, ymin = exp(rangeplot[1]), ymax = exp(rangeplot[2]), 
                  fill = ordered(seq_along(var)%%2 + 1))) + scale_fill_manual(values = c("#FFFFFF33", 
                                                                                         "#00000033"), guide = "none") + geom_point(pch = 15, 
                                                                                                                                    size = 4) + geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = exp(conf.low), 
                                                                                                                                                                  ymax = exp(conf.high)), width = 0.15) + geom_hline(yintercept = 1, 
                                                                                                                                                                                                                     linetype = 3) + coord_flip(ylim = exp(rangeplot)) + 
    ggtitle(main) + scale_y_log10(name = "", labels = sprintf("%g", 
                                                              breaks), expand = c(0.02, 0.02), breaks = breaks) + 
    theme_bw() + theme(panel.grid.minor.y = element_blank(), 
                       panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(), 
                       panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(), 
                       legend.position = "none", 
                       panel.border = element_blank(), 
                       axis.title.y = element_blank(), 
                       axis.text.y = element_blank(), 
                       axis.ticks.y = element_blank(), 
                       axis.text = element_text(color = "black",
                                                size = 14), 
                       plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5,
                                                 size = 18,
                                                 face = "bold",
                                                 color = "black")) + 
    xlab("") + annotate(geom = "text", x = x_annotate, y = exp(y_variable), 
                        label = toShowExpClean$var, fontface = "bold", hjust = 0, 
                        size = annot_size_mm) + annotate(geom = "text", x = x_annotate, 
                                                         y = exp(y_nlevel), hjust = 0, label = toShowExpClean$level, 
                                                         vjust = -0.1, size = annot_size_mm) + annotate(geom = "text", 
                                                                                                        x = x_annotate, y = exp(y_nlevel), label = toShowExpClean$N, 
                                                                                                        fontface = "italic", hjust = 0, vjust = ifelse(toShowExpClean$level == 
                                                                                                                                                         "", 0.5, 1.1), size = annot_size_mm) + annotate(geom = "text", 
                                                                                                                                                                                                         x = x_annotate, y = exp(y_cistring), label = toShowExpClean$estimate.1, 
                                                                                                                                                                                                         size = annot_size_mm, vjust = ifelse(toShowExpClean$estimate.1 == 
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                "reference", 0.5, -0.1)) + annotate(geom = "text", 
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    x = x_annotate, y = exp(y_cistring), label = toShowExpClean$ci, 
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    size = annot_size_mm, vjust = 1.1, fontface = "italic") + 
    annotate(geom = "text", x = x_annotate, y = exp(y_stars), 
             label = toShowExpClean$stars, size = annot_size_mm, 
             hjust = -0.2, fontface = "italic") + annotate(geom = "text", 
                                                           x = 0.5, y = exp(y_variable), label = paste0("# Events: ", 
                                                                                                        gmodel$nevent, "; Global p-value (Log-Rank): ", 
                                                                                                        format.pval(gmodel$p.value.log, eps = ".001"), " \nAIC: ", 
                                                                                                        round(gmodel$AIC, 2), "; Concordance Index: ", round(gmodel$concordance, 
                                                                                                                                                             2)), size = annot_size_mm, hjust = 0, vjust = 1.2, 
                                                           fontface = "italic")
  gt <- ggplot_gtable(ggplot_build(p))
  gt$layout$clip[gt$layout$name == "panel"] <- "off"
  ggpubr::as_ggplot(gt)
}
```

# **Drawing Sole Pts Ages of Diagnoses Across Cancers Boxplot** {#soleagesvscancersboxplot .hidden .unlisted .unnumbered}

$~$

```{r sole-cancers-vs-ages-boxplot-stats, fig.height = 10, fig.width = 7.5, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, include = FALSE}
# similar information as stacked barchart of sole age strata vs cancers, but do as boxplots with kruskal-wallis multiple groups nonparametric test for stats, each cancer is boxplot so that multiple groups form and compare means across cancers
# define comparisons to add stats, ordered based on best looking stacking of brackets on plot, first comparison is lowest bracket i.e. closest to data, and last comparison is closest to title and farthest from data
# however, providing comparisons in the stat_compare_means function for kruskal wallis does not reflect adjusted p-values even when specified, so need to use a separate geom_pwc function that does show adjusted p-values for the subsequent pairwise wilcox tests after overall kruskal-wallis 
comparisons_kruskal_wallis <- list(
  c("Adrenal cortical carcinoma", "BRAIN"),
  c("BRAIN", "SOFT TISSUES"),
  c("Osteosarcoma", "SOFT TISSUES"),
  c("BREAST", "Osteosarcoma"),
  c("OTHER", "BREAST"),
  c("OTHER", "Osteosarcoma"),
  c("BRAIN", "Osteosarcoma"),
  c("Adrenal cortical carcinoma", "Osteosarcoma"),
  c("Adrenal cortical carcinoma", "SOFT TISSUES"),
  c("BREAST", "SOFT TISSUES"),
  c("OTHER", "SOFT TISSUES"),
  c("OTHER", "BRAIN"),
  c("Adrenal cortical carcinoma", "BREAST"),
  c("BRAIN", "BREAST"),
  c("OTHER" , "Adrenal cortical carcinoma")
)

sole_cancers_vs_ages_boxplot_stats <- ggplot(origdbjustsolecancersover100_forGLM %>%
                                               dplyr::select(c(Individual_code,
                                                               Cancer_Label,
                                                               Age_at_diagnosis,
                                                               Sex)) %>%
                                               distinct(),
                                             aes(x = reorder(Cancer_Label,
                                                             Age_at_diagnosis, 
                                                             FUN = median, 
                                                             decreasing = FALSE),
                                                 y = Age_at_diagnosis)) + 
  stat_boxplot(geom = "errorbar", # to put bars at end of IQRs
               width = 0.4) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) + # to avoid plotting outliers twice
  geom_jitter(aes(color = relevel(Sex, 
                                  ref = "F")),
              width = 0.3,
              height = 0,
              alpha = 0.5) + # set transparency of points
  # stat_compare_means(paired = FALSE,
  #                    label = "p.signif", # to just show stars for significance
  #                    tip.length = 0.01, # set length of tips on brackets
  #                    step.increase = 0.06, # decrease gaps between brackets
  #                    vjust = 0.3, # decrease gaps between labels and brackets
  #                    # hide.ns = TRUE,
  #                    comparisons = comparisons_kruskal_wallis) + # Add pairwise comparisons p-value
  stat_compare_means(paired = FALSE,
                     label.y = 105) + # Add global p-value
    geom_pwc(method = "dunn_test", # stat_compare_means w/ comparisons for Kruskal Wallis does not show p-adj
             p.adjust.method = "BH", # thus must manually add pairwise Dunn with BH adjustment
             bracket.nudge.y = 0.2, # nudge brackets by fraction of total height
             vjust = 0.3, # decrease gaps between labels and brackets
             tip.length = 0.02, # set length of tips on brackets
             size = 0.5, # change width of bracket lines
             label.size = 4, # change size of label text
             step.increase = 0.1, # decrease gaps between brackets
             hide.ns = TRUE,
             label = "p.adj.signif") + # to just show stars for significance
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off", # prevent y-axis extending when brackets added so brackets drawn outside plot
                  ylim = c(0, 100)) +
  ggtitle("Ages of Diagnoses in Individuals with \nGermline Mutations in TP53 and One Cancer") +
  xlab("Cancer") +
  ylab("Age when diagnosed (years)") + 
  labs(color = "Sex") + 
  scale_y_continuous(n.breaks = 8) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45,
                                   hjust = 1),
        axis.text.y = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
        axis.text = element_text(color = "black",
                                 size = 14),
        axis.title = element_text(color = "black",
                                  face = "bold",
                                  size = 14),
```

# **Drawing Alluvial Plots** {#alluvialplots .hidden .unlisted .unnumbered}

$~$

As another way to represent data from the clustered heatmaps, and to get a sense of how the proportions "flow" between the annotations, i.e. key information of the data, I have created alluvial plots as below. These alluvial plots are plotted both for mutation types and positions, as well as colored by tissue, germ layer, age, sex, or p53 domain.

$~$

```{r alluvialplot-type, fig.height = 10, fig.width = 10.5, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, eval = FALSE, include = FALSE}
# draw alluvial plots with tissue as coloring
alluvialplot_type <- ggplot(data = alluvial_type,
                            aes(axis1 = `Germ Layer`,   # First variable on the X-axis
                                axis2 = Tissue, # Second variable on the X-axis
                                axis3 = `Mutation Type`,   # Third variable on the X-axis
                                y = Proportion)) +
  geom_alluvium(aes(fill = Tissue),
                aes.bind = "alluvia") +
  geom_stratum(alpha = 0.2) +     # makes strata somewhat transparent so can see colors feeding into them
  geom_text(stat = "stratum",
            aes(label = after_stat(stratum)),
            min.y = 0.05,
            size = 5) + # so that very small categories are not labeled which are getting too tight to see
  ggtitle(paste0("# muts/# total muts (",
                 format(nrow(origdbjustcancersover100), 
                        big.mark = ",", 
                        trim = TRUE),
                 " muts)")) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:3, 
                     labels = c("Germ Layer", "Tissue", "Mutation Type"),
                     expand = c(0,0)) +
  theme_classic() + 
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0,0)) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5,
                                  face = "bold",
                                  size = 16),
        plot.title.position = "plot",
        axis.text = element_text(color = "black",
                                 size = 14,
                                 face = "bold"),
        axis.text.y = element_blank(),
        axis.title.y = element_blank(),
        axis.line = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks = element_blank(),
        legend.title = element_text(face = "bold",
                                    size = 14,
                                    color = "black"),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 14,
                                   color = "black"))
alluvialplot_type
```

$~$

```{r alluvialplot-pos-age-sole, fig.height = 10, fig.width = 14, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, eval = FALSE, include = FALSE}
# draw alluvial plots with age as coloring in sole cancer
alluvialplot_pos_age_sole <- ggplot(data = alluvial_age_pos_sole,
                                    aes(axis1 = Age,   # First variable on the X-axis
                                        axis2 = Type, # Second variable on the X-axis
                                        axis3 = `p53 Domain`, # Third variable on the X-axis
                                        axis4 = Mutation,   # Fourth variable on the X-axis
                                        y = Proportion)) +
  geom_alluvium(aes(fill = Age),
                aes.bind = "alluvia") +
  geom_stratum(alpha = 0.2) +     # makes strata somewhat transparent so can see colors feeding into them
  geom_text(stat = "stratum",
            aes(label = after_stat(stratum)),
            min.y = 0.03,
            size = 5) + # so that very small categories are not labeled which are getting too tight to see
  ggtitle("# distinct individuals/# total distinct individuals, ≥ 1% proportion") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:4, 
                     labels = c("Age", "Mutation Type", "p53 Domain", "Mutation"),
                     expand = c(0,0)) +
  theme_classic() + 
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0,0)) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5,
                                  face = "bold",
                                  size = 16),
        plot.title.position = "plot",
        axis.text = element_text(color = "black",
                                 size = 14,
                                 face = "bold"),
        axis.text.y = element_blank(),
        axis.title.y = element_blank(),
        axis.line = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks = element_blank(),
        legend.title = element_text(face = "bold",
                                    size = 14,
                                    color = "black"),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 14,
                                   color = "black"))
```

# **Session Info** {#sessioninfo}

$~$

Here is the R version used and all packages loaded for analysis (indicated as an asterisk).

$~$

```{r session-info}
devtools::session_info()
```

$~$

At the end of the page are references for all packages and papers referenced, in APA style. The following code allows for the automatic compilation of package references, while papers are manually inputted into a germlinepapers.bib file. Papers are added in the Visual editor by DOI and included as in-text citations.

$~$

```{r refs, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
knitr::write_bib(c(.packages()), 
                 file = paste0(table_path, "germlinepkgs.bib"))
```
